title: Manager, Solutions Engineering | NorBen | Remote
description:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.
   

  

 We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.
   

  

 You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 As a Manager of Solutions Engineering for the NEMEA region at Grafana Labs, you will be responsible for all aspects of building and managing a team of high performing Solution Engineers. You will own the regional build-out with your sales leader counterparts, adopting existing OSS Specific GTM strategies and developing new ones as needed. You’ll work with your Customer Experience counterparts to ensure that your customers are successful after the sale, in their adoption and rollout of Grafana products through professional services, support, training and customer success. You’ll work with marketing to drive community and adoption programs in the region designed to broaden the adoption of both OSS and commercial/cloud versions of our products. You’ll also work closely with Product Management and Engineering to ensure that we are constantly delivering value to our customers by influencing the roadmap, based on your customers and team feedback, as well as leveraging your own experience in the Monitoring and Observability space. All of this will be required for you to hit and then exceed your region's financial targets and ultimately, our company's goals. Your impact will be felt globally when the job is done well.
   

  

**What You'll Be Doing**
* Attract, recruit, ramp and mentor a team of great Presales SE’s from diverse backgrounds and experiences.
* Get the best out of your team with a servant based leadership approach. Adopting a player/coach mentality will be critical here, ensuring that you balance your field responsibilities with the needs of your team. Mentoring and career development will be critical to your team's success over the long term
* Direct the bulk of your day to day work based on guidance and goals from leadership, owning the planning, actions and outcomes of the region.
* Partner with the Benelux / NEMEA Sales leadership on customer programs, marketing initiatives and community/company events to drive adoption and expansion within our customer base.
* Executive sponsorship of key accounts in the region will be key to your success. Being a thought leader/partner to your customers and the company within EMEA.
* Understanding your key customers’ strategies for adoption of Grafana technologies and developing programs and collateral to enable them to be successful.
* Ensure that your customers’ requirements are being met with our product through partnership with Product Management and Engineering, helping them prioritize their team's time with a data-driven approach to wins/losses/needs vs wants, etc.
* Own and report on the quarter over quarter cadence of your team while they help prospects evaluate our software with demonstrations, technical deep dives, trials and POVs.
* Find and drive enablement and sell with/through channel partners in the region. Both at a local, geo and global level with both RSI’s and GSI’s.


**What Makes You a Great Fit**
* Some experience leading a team, 5-10 years in the high tech industry having held roles such as Developer, Architect, Sales Engineer/Architect, Manager, etc.
* Proven success working in a fast-paced, high growth startup environment that is remote-first
* Proven track record of mentoring, developing people and managing performance over time. Has successfully mentored individual contributors.
* Open Source selling or Cloud first/Product led sales go to market motion a big plus.
* Direct experience implementing and/or executing a formal sales methodology, eg COM, Value selling, qualification frameworks like MEDDPICC
* Direct experience selling monitoring/data/visualisation products.
* Proven ability to own a book of business, direct your own and your team's work and initiatives to exceed your quarterly targets.
* English fluency required, and a second European language is preferred
* Located in Sweden


 In Sweden, the OTE compensation range for this role is SEK 1,480,000 - SEK 1,775,000. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed in the interview process. Benefits include equity, bonus (if applicable), and other benefits listed on our careers page.
   

  

* Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process.


**Why You’ll Thrive At Grafana Labs**
* 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.
* Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.
* Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.
* Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.
* Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work.
* Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics.
* Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.
* Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.
* Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.
* In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it.
* Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. \*We will comply with local legislation where applicable.


**Equal Opportunity Employer:** 
*Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. We believe that equality and diversity build a strong organisation, and we work hard to ensure that is the foundation of our organisation as we grow.*
*Grafana Labs may utilize AI tools in its recruitment process to assist in matching information provided in CVs to job postings. The recruitment team will continue to review inbound CVs manually to identify alignment with current openings.*
*For information about how your personal data is used once you’ve applied to a job, check out our privacy policy.*

title: Co-founder CTO
description:
**CTO & co-founder, Venture Engine** 
 Stockholm | co-founder seat | equal split
   

  

 Hi, I'm Robin. I run Spucce Venture (spucceventure.com), a venture studio in Stockholm. I'm looking for two co-founders to build the next chapter with me: a tech partner and a business partner. This post is about the tech/CTO seat.
   

  

**How It's Set Up**
 There are two parts.
   

  

 Spucce Venture is the studio. It builds, runs, and scales companies. It holds the network, the partners, the pilot customers, the investors, the brand. That part is already standing.
   

  

 The Venture Engine is the first company the studio builds. It's the operating system that every venture we launch will run on. Not a SaaS tool. Not another AI wrapper. A digital twin of the whole process of building a company, from idea to formation to daily operations.
   

  

 The Venture Engine is where you come in. Three co-founders. Equal split. One seat is yours.
   

  

**What It Is, Technically**
 Persistent memory that compounds over time. Agent orchestration. Modular workspaces. Automation layers. A credit economy. Identity and permissions. Cross-venture intelligence.
   

  

 The better the engine, the more companies we can run with fewer people and less capital. That's the whole point.
   

  

**Where we are**
 I've done a lot of the groundwork so you don't start from zero.
   

  

* working prototype and live demo
* backend architecture mostly in place
* product architecture documented
* concept, vision, and brand done
* investor materials and investor portal live
* pre-seed closed, seed in progress
* 10 + pilot customers ready to test
* 100+ verified entrepreneurs ready for alfa
* 600+ verified entrepreneurs ready for beta


**What I Need From You**
 A builder. Someone who can take the car apart on the garage floor, understand every part and put it back together so it runs better. Not someone who just can drive it.
   

  

* you open the current codebase and know within days what stays, what goes, and why
* you set the architecture and the stack, then write the first version yourself
* you take a product idea from a whiteboard sketch to a build plan to running code, in the same week
* you build AI first. Agents, memory, and orchestration are the core of the system, not a layer on top
* memory returns the wrong context, you trace it through the pipeline and fix the design, not the symptom
* an agent loop is slow and expensive, you rewrite it so it costs less and runs faster
* ten ventures need workspaces on one engine, you design the permission model so it holds at a hundred
* you close loops. Data flows in, the system learns, the next decision is better. You design for that from day one
* you know when to build, when to buy, and when to wait, and you can explain the cost of each
* you see where the tech is going before it's obvious. Models get cheaper, agents get autonomous, code writes itself. You build for that world, not the current one


 Prompting is not engineering. You read code. You write code. You understand systems from the database up to the interface.
   

  

 Just as important: you have your shit together. You can hold yourself when things get rough. You don't need someone to manage your mood or your motivation. You work on yourself the same way you work on the code. You keep your word. You show up.
   

  

**You**
* full-stack engineer with strong system design instincts
* shipped production AI or ML systems
* RAG, vector databases, memory architecture
* multi-agent coordination, event-driven systems
* cloud infrastructure, security, identity at scale
* has led engineers and shipped 0 to 1
* calm when things are unclear, quick when things need to change
* based in Stockholm. This one is not negotiable'


**What You Own**
 The entire technical layer. Architecture, stack, priorities, AI infrastructure, security, performance. You take the engine from alpha to full system.
   

  

**The deal**
* equity: equal split of the Venture Engine between three co-founders
* salary: none until we close the investment round. This is a startup. We work until the money is in. Then salaries follow.
* location: Stockholm, in person. The early phase needs it.
* role: CTO and co-founder. Board involvement. Real say in product, capital, and direction.
* after that: the Venture Engine is company one. The studio builds more. If we continue to keep on working what we created in the venture engine, we move your equity/shares to the studio to scale more ventures .


 The engine is the start. Once it runs, we use it to build the next company. Then the next. Every venture adds memory to the engine. Every launch makes the next one faster and cheaper. In a few years the studio runs a portfolio of companies on infrastructure we built ourselves, with a small team, and most of the world still thinks that's impossible.
   

  

 That's the adventure. Not a product launch. A new way of building companies, tested on ourselves first and our first pilot/alfa/beta testers.
   

  

 It won't be smooth. There will be months with no money, weeks where everything breaks, days where we wonder why we started. That's the deal. I'd rather do it with someone who wants that than someone who wants comfort.
   

  

 If this sounds like your kind of trip, write to me.
   

  

 Robin

 Förmåga att bygga långsiktiga kund- och partnerrelationer
   

  

 Målinriktad och självgående arbetsstil

 Flytande svenska och engelska, både muntligt och skriftligt
   

  

 Kommersiell eller teknisk utbildning
   

  

**En fördel**
 Erfarenhet av HPE Aruba Networking, Mist AI och Juniper Networks lösningar
   

  

 Kunskap om den svenska IT-kanalen
   

  

 Erfarenhet av att sälja nätverksinfrastruktur, säkerhets- eller datacenterlösningar

title: Manhattan Scale Consultant / Solution Architect
description:
**OM ROLLEN // MAKE IMPACT WHERE IT MATTERS**
 Wise IT söker en erfaren Manhattan Scale Consultant / Solution Architect för ett projektbaserat konsultuppdrag hos kund. Uppdraget innebär att genomföra en oberoende granskning av kundens befintliga Manhattan Scale-implementation ur ett funktionellt, tekniskt, arkitekturellt och operativt perspektiv.
   

  

 Målet är att bedöma lösningens nuläge och molnberedskap, identifiera förbättringsområden samt lämna rekommendationer som stärker stabilitet, prestanda, skalbarhet och långsiktig förvaltningsbarhet.
   

  

 Du kommer att granska den övergripande lösningsarkitekturen och bedöma designen utifrån etablerade arbetssätt. I ansvaret ingår att identifiera arkitekturella risker, teknisk skuld och onödiga anpassningar samt utvärdera lösningens skalbarhet, motståndskraft, förvaltningsbarhet och operativa stabilitet. Du tar även fram rekommendationer kring arkitekturella förbättringar och modernisering.
   

  

 En central del av uppdraget är att analysera integrationerna mellan Manhattan Scale och omgivande system, däribland Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central, EDI, API:er, middleware, transportsystem och andra verksamhetsapplikationer. Granskningen omfattar integrationsarkitektur, dataflöden, gränssnittens tillförlitlighet, felhantering, övervakning, loggning, synkronisering och operativ support.
   

  

 Du granskar även Manhattan Scale-konfigurationen och lageruppsättningen samt bedömer systemprestanda, bakgrundsbearbetning, integrationer och operativa flaskhalsar. Utifrån analysen identifierar du möjligheter att förbättra lösningens prestanda och skalbarhet.
   

  

 I uppdraget ingår dessutom en bedömning av lösningens molnberedskap. Du identifierar migrationsbegränsningar och moderniseringsmöjligheter, granskar molnkompatibiliteten i integrationer och anpassningar samt tar fram rekommendationer och en övergripande roadmap för molntransformation.
   

  

 Den funktionella granskningen omfattar lagerprocesserna från inbound till outbound, inklusive lagerstyrning, lagerverksamhet och systemkonfiguration. Du utvärderar implementationen utifrån Manhattan Scale best practices och identifierar processförbättringar samt återkommande operativa problem.
   

  

**Uppdragets Leveranser Omfattar**
* nulägesanalys
* lösnings- och arkitekturgranskning
* granskning av Manhattan Scale-konfigurationen
* integrationsanalys
* prestandaanalys
* bedömning av molnberedskap
* risk- och gapanalys
* prioriterad förbättringsroadmap
* rekommendationer för målarkitektur
* sammanfattning för beslutsfattare
* kunskapsöverföring.


 Uppdraget är ett projektbaserat konsultuppdrag med en uppskattad längd på cirka 4–8 veckor.
   

  

**DIN PROFIL // YOU BRING THE EDGE**
**För att lyckas i uppdraget behöver du ha:**
* Gedigen erfarenhet av Manhattan Scale WMS.
* Erfarenhet av att implementera eller granska Manhattan Scale-lösningar i större verksamhetsmiljöer.
* Djup kunskap om lagerverksamhet och WMS best practices.
* Erfarenhet av lösningsarkitektur och integrationer i komplexa verksamhetsmiljöer.
* Erfarenhet av att integrera Manhattan Scale med ERP-system.
* Erfarenhet av API:er, EDI, middleware och distribuerade system.
* Erfarenhet av att genomföra health checks, rotorsaksanalyser och tekniska bedömningar.
* Förståelse för molnarkitektur och moderniseringsstrategier.
* Stark analytisk förmåga.
* God förmåga att dokumentera analyser och rekommendationer.
* Förmåga att kommunicera tydligt med olika intressenter.


 Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av integrationer mellan Manhattan Scale och Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central eller Dynamics NAV.
   

  

**OM ORGANISATIONEN // CULTURE WITH REAL CHARACTER**
 Uppdraget genomförs hos en kund med en befintlig Manhattan Scale-implementation och en systemmiljö som omfattar ERP, EDI, API:er, middleware, transportsystem och andra verksamhetsapplikationer. Kunden söker ett oberoende perspektiv på lösningens funktion, teknik, arkitektur, drift och framtida utveckling.
   

  

**DIN ANSÖKAN // TALENT SPEAKS LOUDER**
 För att söka rollen klickar du på ”Ansök nu” och bifogar ditt CV. Notera att vi inte kan ta emot ansökningar via mejl. I konsultvärlden går det ofta snabbt och tjänsten kan därför komma att tillsättas före sista ansökningsdatum. Vänta därför inte med din ansökan.
   

  

 Har du frågor om rollen är du välkommen att kontakta ansvarig konsultchef.

title: Decision Analyst
description:
**About The Role**
 As a Decision Analyst at Instabee, you’ll play a key role in helping us make smarter, faster decisions across the business. You’ll partner with teams across the company from product, operations, to tech and beyond - to understand challenges, gather insights, and co-create solutions. Whether it’s structuring an ambiguous problem, evaluating new data sources, or communicating a compelling recommendation, you’ll bring clarity and impact. This role is perfect for someone who loves solving problems, is comfortable navigating complexity, and sees data as a powerful tool, not an end in itself.
   

  

**Some of the things you’ll do**
* Tackle complex and ambiguous problems by bringing structure and taking clear, decisive action
* Translate complex data and information into concise, actionable insights using both qualitative and quantitative methods
* Collaborate across diverse teams to co-create smart solutions and drive real change
* Communicate insights clearly and confidently to stakeholders at all levels, from junior teams to senior leadership
* Continuously explore and integrate new internal and external data sources to strengthen our decision-making foundation
* Analyze data from multiple sources to identify trends, patterns, and opportunities
* Partner with teams to understand business challenges and build tailored tools or frameworks that improve how we work
* Act as a go-to person for analytical support—sharing knowledge, guiding ad-hoc analysis, and elevating decision quality across the company


**Your future team**
 You’ll join a tight-knit team working on Instabee’s most critical challenges. We collaborate across departments, drive clarity in ambiguity, and value real-world impact over theoretical perfection. Curiosity, humility, and a strong drive to make things better are what bring us together.
   

  

**What We’re Looking For**
* Bachelor’s degree within engineering, information technology, finance, economics or other relevant field
* Experience presenting solutions to senior management
* Experience working within a data heavy environment for at least 4 years
* Experience working with solving business problems and improving ways of working
* Experience driving real impact, leading stakeholders to materialise the change that the insight points to
* Experience using AI coding tools
* Experience working with data processing tools including Front End visualization tools (e.g. Tableau, PowerBI, PowerPoint, Google Slides) and generic tools (e.g. SQL, Python, Excel/Google Sheets)


**The cherry on top**
* You bring a strong blend of business and data understanding—and know how to connect the two
* You’re curious, always learning, and stay on top of evolving best practices
* You care about creating real-world results and know when “good enough” is enough
* You’re confident challenging the status quo and backing it up with structured thinking
* You communicate clearly and effectively in English—even when things get complex


 If this is you, then we can’t wait to meet you!
   

  

**What You’ll Get**
 We can promise you that you will be challenged, develop your skills and have the opportunity to work with truly amazing and competent colleagues. If you like change and want to set new processes and ways of working—this is the place for you!
   

  

 Of course, we have all the necessary and standard benefits in place, but in addition to this, we also offer:
   

  

 🌇 Sky-High Office: Modern and newly renovated with a 360-degree view around Stockholm
   

  

 🐶 Puppy Friendly: Bring your dog to work—we’ve got a whole floor for our furry friends!
   

  

 🏓 Fun & Games: Ping pong, shuffleboard, foosball—even a karaoke room!
   

  

 👶 Parental Pay: Paid leave for six months to spend time with your little one
   

  

 🎂 Birthday Day Off: Celebrate your birthday with a well-earned break
   

  

 ⏰ Flexible Hours: Hybrid setup and hours that work with your life
   

  

**Get to know us**
 In 2022, Instabee was founded after combining Budbee and Instabox - two leading last-mile delivery companies with three consumer-facing brands: Budbee, Instabox, and Porterbuddy. Instabee serves millions of consumers across Europe with convenient deliveries and is on track to become the leading European e-commerce enabler. Always with the consumer at heart.
   

  

 We’re fast, both in terms of parcel delivery and when it comes to growing our business. So far our journey has taken us from Sweden to the rest of Scandinavia and parts of continental Europe, but we have no plans on stopping anytime soon. As we continue to expand, the complexity of Instabee grows in parallel. With that in mind, we’re now looking for you to help us on the journey ahead.
   

  

*This recruitment process consists of background checks via Svensk Bakgrundsanalys as a review of previous public criminal records. The result is public information that is handled confidentially. This is mandatory for all recruitment processes at Instabee in Sweden.*
 Instabee Group, with consumer-facing brands Budbee, Instabox, and Porterbuddy, brings together years of experience in delivery. Today, Instabee Group is present in five markets, serving thousands of online merchants and millions of consumers with seamless home deliveries and convenient parcel locker deliveries, using the best fuel available. With smart technology, a strong focus on sustainability, and a secure supply chain, Instabee has become a trusted partner for online merchants and a preferred choice for consumers.

description:
**Description & Requirements**
 Electronic Arts creates next-level entertainment experiences that inspire players and fans around the world. Here, everyone is part of the story. Part of a community that connects across the globe. A place where creativity thrives, new perspectives are invited, and ideas matter. A team where everyone makes play happen.
   

  

**Location:** 
 Stockholm - Hybrid 3 times per week
   

  

**Report into** 
 : Engineering lead
   

  

 Electronic Arts creates next-level entertainment experiences that inspire players and fans around the world. Here, everyone is part of the story. Part of a community that connects across the globe. A place where creativity thrives, new perspectives are invited, and ideas matter. A team where everyone makes play happen.
   

  

 At our core, Electronic Arts is a game maker connecting hundreds of millions of players globally to some of the world's greatest games. The EAX team is crucial to creating that connection through products that grow and engage our community of players. Some of our work includes: EA PLAY, our multi-platform subscription for PC, PS4, Xbox One and Steam; the EA desktop app, EA's direct-to-consumer PC games platform; and a host of other consumer experiences and strategies, all with the goal of engaging players across platforms and within our games.
   

  

 EAX In-game Experiences team is responsible for EA Connect, our social overlay facilitating cross-platform party, voip, quick messaging and game invites, used by multiple games such as FC, Battlefield, Madden and NHL.
   

  

 We are looking for someone to help us build experiences like these, using JavaScript/React.

**Responsibilities**
* You will help develop products used in multiple EA games
* You will work with an embedded JavaScript engine inside various game engines such as Frostbite
* You will partner with game teams and ensure the code works in multiple configurations and on several platforms
* You will be part of the broader engineering group, and an important contributor to the EAX team based in Sweden.
* You will design systems and APIs and contribute to technical design and reviews


**Qualifications**
* 3+ years of JavaScript programming experience
* Experience using TypeScript
* Experience using React and/or React Native
* Experience of web and/or mobile applications

 We’re proud to have an extensive portfolio of games and experiences, locations around the world, and opportunities across EA. We value adaptability, resilience, creativity, and curiosity. From leadership that brings out your potential, to creating space for learning and experimenting, we empower you to do great work and pursue opportunities for growth.
   

  

 We adopt a holistic approach to our benefits programs, emphasizing physical, emotional, financial, career, and community wellness to support a balanced life. We nurture environments where our teams can always bring their best to what they do.

 förmåner.
   

  

**Vill du vara med och göra studier möjligt? Välkommen till CSN.** 
  

  


 CSN befinner sig i ett omfattande förändringsarbete och etablerar en ny Utvecklingsavdelning för att stärka myndighetens förmåga att styra, leda och genomföra utveckling.
 


  


 Som chef för Innovation och metodutveckling får du ett myndighetsövergripande uppdrag att utveckla CSN:s förmåga att bedriva utveckling och förändring. Enheten ansvarar för arbetssätt och metoder, att driva och accelerera användningen av AI samt att leda innovationsarbetet. På enheten arbetar cirka 15 medarbetare.
 


  


 Du har verksamhets-, budget- och medarbetaransvar och ingår i Utvecklingsavdelningens ledningsgrupp. Tillsammans med övriga chefer bidrar du till att utveckla agila arbetssätt, skapa bättre flöden från behov till genomförd förändring och etablera en mer sammanhållen modell för hur CSN styr, leder och genomför utveckling.
 


  

 Du ansvarar för
   

  
* att leda, utveckla och följa upp enhetens verksamhet, medarbetare och resultat,
  
* att leda utvecklingen av myndighetens arbetssätt och metoder för utveckling,
  
* att driva utvecklingen mot mer agila och ändamålsenliga arbetssätt för utveckling,
  
* att driva och accelerera myndighetens användning av AI,
  
* att leda och utveckla myndighetens arbete med innovation,
  
* att skapa förutsättningar för att nya metoder, teknik och idéer kan prövas, utvecklas och omsättas till nytta,
  
* att tillsammans med övriga chefer bidra till hela Utvecklingsavdelningens resultat och utveckling.
  



  
 


  

 Om dig
   


 Som chef och ledare skapar du engagemang, delaktighet och tydlig riktning. Du leder, motiverar och ger andra förutsättningar och befogenheter att nå gemensamma mål. Du är trygg, stabil och har god självinsikt, med förmåga att skilja på det personliga och professionella och anpassa ditt agerande efter situationen.
 


  


 Du samarbetar väl med andra, är lyhörd och kommunikativ och hanterar konflikter konstruktivt. Du har ett tydligt helhetsperspektiv och ser till verksamhetens bästa i beslut och agerande. Du kommunicerar tydligt, skapar klara förväntningar och följer upp.
 


  


 Du är utvecklingsinriktad och ser vad som behöver förbättras för att utveckla verksamheten. Du är mål- och resultatorienterad, prioriterar och agerar utifrån mål och anpassar din inriktning när förutsättningarna förändras.
 


  

 Vi söker dig som har:
   

  
* akademisk utbildning eller motsvarande arbetslivserfarenhet som arbetsgivaren bedömer likvärdig,
  
* flerårig aktuell och relevant chefserfarenhet med verksamhets-, budget- och medarbetaransvar,
  
* flerårig erfarenhet av att leda förändring av hur en organisation bedriver agil utveckling,
  
* mycket goda kunskaper om hur AI och innovation kan bidra till verksamhetsutveckling och skapa verksamhetsnytta
  
* god förmåga att kommunicera på svenska i tal och skrift.
  



  
 


  

 Det är meriterande om du har
   

  
* erfarenhet av SAFe eller andra ramverk för att organisera och skala agil utveckling,
  
* erfarenhet av att utveckla arbetssätt för större utvecklingsorganisationer med flera team och beroenden,
  
* erfarenhet av att leda införande och användning av AI i verksamhet,
  
* erfarenhet av innovationsledning.
  



  
 


  


 Vi lägger stor vikt vid personlig lämplighet.
 


  


 Tillträde 1 december eller enligt överenskommelse.
 


  


**Placeringsort är:** 
 Sundsvall eller Stockholm.
 


  


 CSN erbjuder distansarbete utifrån verksamhetens behov. Arbetet utgår från placeringsorten, vilket innebär att du behöver kunna närvara på kontoret.
   




**Chef på CSN** 
  

  

 Att arbeta i staten innebär att du följer den statliga värdegrunden. Det ställs också särskilda krav på omdöme, säkerhetstänkande och att du följer gällande lagar. Vi ställer frågor vid intervju om tidigare eventuell brotts­lighet och brister i tidigare anställning. För slutkandidater ställs även dessa frågor till referenspersoner. Framkomna uppgifter vägs in vid helhetsbedömningen av din lämplighet för den aktuella anställ­ningen.
   

  

 CSN tillämpar ett tidsbegränsat chefsförordnande. Det innebär att du blir tillsvidareanställd med en grundbefattning som utredare och får därtill ett förordnande som chef.
   

  

 Läs gärna mer om ledarskap på CSN här: https://www.csn.se/om-csn/jobba-hos-oss/ledarskap.html.
   

  

**Anställningsform** 
  

 Tillsvidareanställning, provanställning kan komma att tillämpas
   

  

 Lönesättningen på CSN sker i enlighet med de centrala löneavtalen RALS/RALS-T och är individuell samt differentierad.
   

  

**Omfattning** 
  

 Heltid
   

  

**Referens** 
  

 HR/2026:96
   

  

**Övrigt** 
  

  

 Handlingar i anställningsärenden hos en myndighet är allmänna handlingar.
   

  

 Läs mer om vår rekryteringsprocess.
   

  

 Läs om hur du ansöker om du har skyddade personuppgifter.
   

  

 Så behandlar vi dina personuppgifter.
   

  

 Vi undanber oss alla erbjudanden om rekryterings- och annonshjälp.
   

  

 Varmt välkommen med din ansökan!

title: Accounting Professional / SAP Finance Process Expert
description:
Till vår kund, ett världsledande företag inom tillverkning av lastbilar och bussar, söker SJR en Accounting Professional / SAP Finance Process Expert till en av deras redovisningsenheter. Bolaget erbjuder moderna och attraktiva lokaler i Södertälje med goda kommunikationsmöjligheter. Detta är en hyrrekrytering på heltid där du initialt arbetar som konsult under en period om cirka sex månader med start så snart som möjligt. Därefter är ambitionen att du erbjuds en direktanställning hos kunden. Rollen är placerad i Södertälje och arbetet bedrivs på plats på kontoret fem dagar i veckan.
 



  





**Om tjänsten** 




 Som Accounting Professional / SAP Finance Process Expert kombinerar du kvalificerat redovisningsarbete med ett nyckelansvar inom SAP Finance. Rollen passar dig som har en stark redovisningsbakgrund och samtidigt trivs med att utveckla, förbättra och effektivisera finansiella processer i SAP-miljö. Du kommer att fungera som en viktig länk mellan ekonomi, verksamhet och IT, där du bidrar till både den dagliga finansiella verksamheten och den långsiktiga utvecklingen av processer, systemstöd och arbetssätt.
 



  





**Ansvarsområden** 




 - Delta i månadsbokslut, finansiell rapportering, kontoavstämningar och analyser.
 



 - Säkerställa kvalitet och korrekthet i redovisnings- och rapporteringsprocesser.
 



 - Identifiera och driva förbättringsinitiativ med fokus på effektivisering, automatisering och standardisering.
 



 - Vara specialiststöd för användare inom SAP FI/GL och hantera systemrelaterade frågor.
 



 - Genomföra felsökning, rotorsaksanalyser och koordinera lösningar med relevanta intressenter.
 



 - Utbilda och stötta användare i SAP-relaterade processer och arbetssätt.
 



 - Översätta affärs- och redovisningsbehov till tydliga krav för IT, processägare och systemspecialister.
 



 - Delta i testning, validering och implementering av förändringar i SAP-miljön.
 



 - Samarbeta med IT, konsulter och processägare för att utveckla och förbättra end-to-end-processer inom finance.
 



 - Dokumentera processer och säkerställa efterlevnad av interna kontroller, behörighetsstyrning och revisionskrav.
 



  





**Lämplig bakgrund** 




 Vi söker dig som har en akademisk utbildning inom ekonomi, redovisning, finans eller motsvarande och som har minst tre till fem års erfarenhet av kvalificerat redovisningsarbete. Du har god vana av bokslut, finansiell rapportering och ekonomiprocesser i större organisationer. Vidare har du stark erfarenhet av SAP och har arbetat med SAP S/4HANA, systemimplementationer, testning och utveckling av finansiella processer. Du har förståelse för hur olika moduler, processer och integrationer samverkar och trivs med att omsätta verksamhetens behov till effektiva lösningar. Erfarenhet av Power Query, Power BI, avancerad Excel eller andra analys- och rapporteringsverktyg är meriterande. Du kommunicerar obehindrat på både svenska och engelska.
 



  





**Personliga egenskaper** 




 Som person är du analytisk, kommunikativ och lösningsorienterad. Du har förmågan att göra komplexa ekonomiska och systemrelaterade frågor begripliga för olika målgrupper och trivs i rollen som länken mellan verksamhet och IT. Du är strukturerad, initiativtagande och drivs av att förbättra processer och arbetssätt. Vidare har du lätt för att samarbeta, bygger förtroendefulla relationer och bidrar med ett positivt förhållningssätt i teamet. Du tycker om förändring och utveckling och motiveras av att skapa långsiktigt hållbara lösningar som gör verklig skillnad i verksamheten.
 



  





**Ansökan** 




 Vi intervjuar löpande och tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan ansökningstiden har gått ut. Sista ansökningsdag är 2026-10-24.
 



 Varmt välkommen med din ansökan!
 



  





**Konsult hos SJR** 




 Du drivs av att utvecklas och inspireras av nya utmaningar och miljöer. Du har en förmåga och känsla för att verka i olika verksamheter och grupper. Vi arbetar i nära samarbete med dig och är lyhörda för dina önskade utmaningar. Tillsammans med vårt goda renommé och varumärke samt med våra framgångsrika kunder kan vi matcha rätt uppdrag för dig och stödja dig i din önskade karriär.
 



  





 Om företaget SJR in Sweden (SJR) är ett av Sveriges ledande rekryterings- och konsultföretag och har sedan 1993 byggt upp ett brett kontaktnät i näringslivet inom denna sektor. Personlig service och kvalitet är utmärkande för SJR. Vi är idag ca 550 anställda och har kontor i Stockholm, Malmö, Göteborg och Helsingborg. Vår främsta resurs är vår personal och vår vision är att vara förstahandsvalet för ekonomer som vill byta arbete och för företag som behöver personalresurser inom Ekonomi och Bank & Finans. SJR är noterat på First North. Vi hjälper våra kunder att tillsätta tjänster på chef-, specialist- och assistentnivå.

title: Mid-Market Account Executive - Stockholm
description:
*To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.*
 Job Category
   

  

 Sales
   

  

 Job Details
   

  

**About Salesforce**
 Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
   

  

 Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
   

  

**Overview Of The Role**
 As a Mid Market Account Executive at Salesforce in Sweden, you will own a named set of mid-market accounts — acting as a trusted digital advisor and the central point of coordination across the full Salesforce AI CRM and Agentforce platform. You will work closely with co-prime product specialists, solution architects, and sales engineers to map account strategies and help customers solve their most pressing business challenges. This is a role for someone who combines strategic thinking with hands-on execution and a genuine curiosity for technology.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Own the full sales cycle across a named set of mid-market accounts in Sweden, from opportunity identification and account planning through to deal closure and customer success
* Act as the central coordinator of internal resources — including co-primes, solution architects, and sales engineers — to build and execute the right strategy for each customer
* Develop deep understanding of each customer's business challenges and goals, translating these into compelling Salesforce and Agentforce solutions that deliver measurable value
* Build and maintain trusted relationships with current and prospective customers, evangelising the full Salesforce platform and identifying expansion opportunities


**Required Qualifications**
* Demonstrated track record of quota attainment in a technology solution sales role, with experience across the full sales cycle including account planning, discovery, solutioning, and commercial negotiation
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to engage clearly and effectively with stakeholders at all levels using written, verbal, and presentation formats
* Proven ability to work within and coordinate a team selling motion, aligning internal and partner resources to support deal progression and customer outcomes
* Fluent in Swedish and English, with the right to work in Sweden


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Formal sales methodology training or certification
* Experience developing strategic alliances or managing partner-involved sales cycles
* Degree or equivalent relevant experience; backgrounds will be evaluated based on core competencies for the role (e.g. extracurricular leadership, military experience, volunteer roles, work experience)


 Unleash Your Potential
   

  

 When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and
 *be your best* 
 , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can
 *do your best* 
 . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.
   

  

 Accommodations
   

  

 If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form.
   

  

 Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates’ resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options.
   

  

 Posting Statement
   

  

 Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education.

title: Project Manager DTO
description:
**Help shape the future of advertising at Schibsted**
 We are looking for a Project Manager to join the Ad Solutions team within Schibsted Marketing Services for a 12-month temporary position, working across projects within DTO (Data, Tech and Operations) and the wider organization.
   

  

 This is a great opportunity for someone who thrives on creating structure, enabling progress, and connecting people and processes across functions. You’ll play a key role in ensuring that projects are delivered efficiently, on time, and with clear alignment — contributing to Schibsted’s mission to fund independent journalism across the Nordics.
   

  

**What You’ll Be Doing**
 As Project Manager in DTO, you’ll oversee and drive projects that cut across product, tech, commercial, and operational areas — ensuring progress, transparency, and impact.
   

  

**In This Role, You Will**
* Plan, coordinate, and follow up on projects and workstreams across multiple stakeholders
* Create structure and drive progress by defining timelines, deliverables, and milestones
* Facilitate cross-functional collaboration and communication between product, tech, and business units
* Support prioritization and ensure dependencies and risks are identified and handled proactively
* Prepare and maintain project documentation, reports, and status updates for relevant forums (e.g., steerco)
* Contribute to building efficient ways of working within DT&O — improving processes, documentation, and communication routines


**Who We Think You Are**
 You are a structured and proactive person who enjoys turning complex initiatives into clear plans and measurable progress. You likely have experience managing projects in a digital, product, or technology-driven environment — or you’ve worked as a consultant driving similar change processes.
   

  

**You’ll Likely Thrive In This Role If You**
* Hold an MSc or equivalent degree in business or another relevant field
* Are organized and detail-oriented, with the ability to juggle multiple projects and priorities
* Have strong communication skills and can translate between business and technical stakeholders
* Enjoy working collaboratively and facilitating progress across different disciplines
* Are comfortable leading meetings, documenting decisions, and following up on actions
* Bring experience or curiosity for digital products, advertising, or ad tech


**What We Offer**
* A supportive team with strong product and tech expertise—and space to grow
* Professional development through learning sessions, internal mobility, and mentorship
* Meaningful work that helps fund high-quality journalism in the Nordics


**Location**
* Oslo or Stockholm

title: Account Director – Nordics
description:
**Job title: Account Director – Nordics**
**Location: Stockholm, SWE (hybrid, 3 days in office)**
**Who We Are**
 At Tricentis, we’re redefining what’s possible in software testing and quality engineering. Our AI-driven, codeless, and continuous testing platform empowers enterprises to accelerate innovation, deliver higher-quality releases, and transform digital velocity at scale.
   

  

 Recognized as a global leader by Gartner, Forrester, and IDC, Tricentis partners with the world’s largest and most innovative companies. We’re a team of curious learners, ambitious achievers, and collaborative competitors who believe in constant growth—both for our customers and ourselves.
   

  

 If you’re motivated by challenge, feedback, and the pursuit of excellence, you’ll thrive here.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We’re looking for an accomplished and strategic Account Director to join the Tricentis Enterprise Sales team in Stockholm supporting the Nordic region. This role owns the growth and expansion of strategic enterprise accounts, leading complex sales cycles and building trusted relationships with senior executives to connect Tricentis’ testing and automation solutions to meaningful business outcomes.
   

  

 Success requires enterprise SaaS sales expertise, rigorous forecasting and pipeline management, and the ability to influence C-suite and senior IT stakeholders. This is an opportunity to shape account strategy, create long-term customer value, and deliver measurable revenue impact in a complex enterprise environment.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Own and expand strategic enterprise accounts by identifying new opportunities, shaping account strategy, building executive relationships, and closing complex, multi-stakeholder deals.
* Develop a deep understanding of the Tricentis platform and translate technical capabilities into clear business value for enterprise customers.
* Engage C-level and senior IT decision-makers to understand strategic priorities, quantify business challenges, and align solutions to transformation goals.
* Drive disciplined pipeline management and accurate forecasting, creating visibility into deal progress, risks, and the actions required to achieve revenue goals.
* Partner with Pre-Sales, Customer Growth, Marketing, and other stakeholders to deliver coordinated account plans, increase customer value, and support long-term success.


**Qualifications**
**Must Have:**
* Demonstrated success selling complex enterprise B2B SaaS solutions to senior IT stakeholders in large organizations, with evidence of operating across long sales cycles and multiple decision-makers.
* A consistent record of achieving or exceeding revenue goals and closing six-figure transactions, including deals above $500K ACV.


**Nice To Have**
* Knowledge of and/or experience with Tricentis products
* Knowledge of Tricentis products or comparable enterprise software platforms.


 Experience in software quality, testing, automation, DevOps, or another relevant technical domain.
   

  

**Skills You Bring**
* Ownership and expansion of strategic enterprise accounts — identifying opportunities, building exec relationships, and closing complex multi-stakeholder deals.
* Strategic account ownership: Evidence of identifying whitespace, developing focused account plans, building executive sponsorship, and converting opportunities into sustainable growth.
* Forecasting and pipeline discipline: Experience using data, qualification criteria, and clear next steps to improve revenue predictability and execution.
* Executive influence and value selling: Ability to engage senior IT leaders, uncover business drivers, and connect technical solutions to strategic and financial outcomes.
* Business and technical translation: Ability to turn complex customer challenges into quantified business impact and position Tricentis solutions against measurable outcomes.
* Complex deal execution: Demonstrated use of structured sales methodologies such as MEDDPICC and value-based selling to navigate multi-stakeholder decisions.
* Cross-functional execution: Experience working with Pre-Sales, Customer Growth, Marketing, and peers to strengthen account strategy and customer outcomes.
* Sales technology fluency: Practical experience with CRM, forecasting, sales enablement, and AI tools, such as Salesforce, Clari, Outreach, or comparable platforms.


**Who You Are**
* Coachable: You actively seek feedback, apply new learning, and refine your approach based on evidence and customer insight.
* Resilient: You maintain focus through long, complex sales cycles, adapt when conditions change, and turn setbacks into informed next steps.
* Driven for Results: You set ambitious goals, take ownership of outcomes, and combine strategic thinking with disciplined execution.
* Resourceful: You find practical ways through ambiguity and constraints while keeping account strategy, customer value, and scale in view.
* Collaborative: You share information, invite expertise, and work across teams to solve customer problems and deliver shared success.


**Tricentis Core Values:**
 At Tricentis, we strive for success while inspiring those around us by knowing what we need to achieve and how we’ll achieve it. Our core values serve as our guiding light to drive our every action and define our ways of working so that we can create and enjoy a successful journey and reach higher heights together.
   

  

* Demonstrate Self-Awareness: Own your strengths and limitations.
* Finish What We Start: Do what we say we are going to do.
* Move Fast: Create momentum and efficiency.
* Run Towards Change: Challenge the status quo.
* Serve Our Customers & Communities: Create a positive experience with each interaction.
* Solve Problems Together: We win or lose as one team.
* Think Big & Believe: Set extraordinary goals and believe you can achieve them.


 Tricentis is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, ethnicity, gender, religious affiliation, age, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or physical and mental disability and other statuses protected by law.
   

  

**Global Sanctions Compliance**
 We comply with all applicable global sanctions and export control laws. Candidates must not be listed on any government restricted party lists (including OFAC SDN List and U.S. Commerce Department restricted lists) and must certify that their employment would not violate any sanctions or export control regulations. Candidates must notify us of any changes to their status during the application process or subsequent employment.

title: Staff Data Scientist - Experience
description:
We design Spotify’s consumer experience—end to end, moment to moment, across every screen, platform, and partner integration. Our mission is to make listening feel effortless, personal, and joyful for billions of users around the world. That means turning complexity into clarity across hundreds of touchpoints—from our mobile and desktop apps to the smart speakers, TVs, cars, and integrations where Spotify shows up every day. If it touches a consumer, we shape it. We bring deep insight into human behavior, design, and technology to craft experiences that feel intuitive, expressive, and unmistakably Spotify.
   

  

 Content Platform is responsible for the full content lifecycle at Spotify — from ingestion through to delivery — across music, podcasts, and audiobooks. We ensure content is structured, evaluated, and delivered reliably at global scale, powered by deep content understanding. We bring valuable content to users while ensuring it remains trusted and high-quality over time. The Product Insights team works across the full content lifecycle to improve decision-making, improve our catalog understanding and ensure one of the world’s largest content catalogs is safe and engaging.
   

  

 We’re looking for a Staff Data Scientist to join the team and tackle complex, high-impact problems by combining strategic thinking with hands-on, tactical execution.
   

  

 What You'll Do
   

  

* Lead analyses across user behavior and content data to shape product and strategy decisions.
* Shape how we evaluate and improve content classification and taxonomy, with a particular focus on safety, combining analytical depth with a broader view of product and business needs.
* Design evaluation frameworks, including sampling strategies, setting baselines, metrics, and annotation-based approaches, and guide how these methods are applied across the team.
* Build scalable analytical foundations, including metrics, dashboards, and the data and context needed to enable effective self-serve analysis and agents.
* Partner with Product, Engineering, and Operations leadership to shape priorities and how data informs product strategy.
* Raise the analytical bar across Product Insights through methodological leadership, mentorship, and by identifying opportunities to improve how we work with data across domains.


 Who You Are
   

  

* You have deep experience as a product data scientist and have operated at Staff level or equivalent.
* You have a strong foundation in statistics and experience designing evaluation and measurement approaches, including annotation-based methods and settings where controlled experiments are not feasible.
* You have experience in building metrics and reporting systems that support product or policy decision-making.
* You have built self-serve analytical tools or data agents that enable others to answer questions effectively.
* You are proficient in SQL and experienced with Python, DBT, or similar tools for building and maintaining reliable analytical datasets
* You leverage state of the art LLM models to do your analysis while ensuring quality and accuracy in the output
* You communicate clearly across functions, influence decisions with senior stakeholders, and help raise analytical standards through mentorship and methodological leadership.
* You have experience working on content classification, taxonomy, safety, policy, or adjacent domains where data quality and judgment are important to product decisions.


 Where You'll Be
   

  

* This role is based in Stockholm or London.
* We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.


 We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us. Find our AI notice here: https://lifeatspotify.com/ai-notice
   

  

 Today, we are the world’s most popular audio streaming subscription service.

title: System- och kvalitetskoordinator – Telge Återvinning
description:
Välj Telge – här får du kombinera affärsmässighet med samhällsnytta och som medarbetare får du frihet under ansvar och möjlighet att påverka.
   

  

 Så här säger Robert Rekonius om rollen, avdelningschef materialåtervinning:
   

  

 "Vågen är navet för anläggningen på Tveta och informationen som hanteras här påverkar allt från drift och kundservice till ekonomi och miljörapportering. I den här rollen får du möjlighet att kombinera operativ förståelse med system, analys och kvalitetssäkring och vara med och utveckla ett område som är viktigt för hela verksamheten."
   

  

**Uppdrag och kompetenskrav:**
 Vill du bli en del av ett team som verkligen gör skillnad?
   

  

 Som system- och kvalitetskoordinator i vågen på vår anläggning på Tveta har du en central roll i vår avfalls- och återvinningsverksamhet. Du arbetar främst med system, data, kvalitetssäkring och utveckling, samtidigt som du deltar i det operativa arbetet och stöttar den dagliga driften vid behov. Du ser till att informationen från vågen är korrekt, aktuell och användbar för bland annat fakturering, statistik, miljörapportering och uppföljning. Vi söker dig som är noggrann, ansvarstagande och strukturerad och som tycker om att analysera, lösa problem och samarbeta med andra.
   

  

 I rollen är våra kärnvärden öppen, modig, personlig och enkel en naturlig del av ditt arbete. Du är öppen i samarbetet mellan olika delar av verksamheten, vågar uppmärksamma fel och föreslå förbättringar och har ett personligt och professionellt bemötande. Du gör komplex information enkel att förstå och hjälper till att skapa tydliga arbetssätt.
   

  

**Ditt uppdrag innebär att:**
* kvalitetssäkra data, order, register och underlag kopplade till vågen
* se till att information som används för fakturering, statistik, miljörapportering och uppföljning är korrekt och aktuell
* hantera ärenden och följa upp avvikelser
* identifiera felkällor och bidra till bättre arbetssätt, rutiner och systemstöd
* delta i det operativa arbetet i vågen och stötta den dagliga driften vid behov
* samarbeta med kollegor inom bland annat drift, kundservice, ekonomi och andra stödfunktioner
* bidra till att utveckla informationsflödet från inpassering vid vågen till kvalitetssäkrade underlag och rapporter
* över tid kunna arbeta med andra verksamhetsnära system och liknande samordnings-, kvalitets- och
* utvecklingsuppgifter inom avdelningen.


**Du behöver ha:**
* gymnasieutbildning eller motsvarande
* erfarenhet av administrativt arbete med höga krav på noggrannhet, kundkontakt och ärendehantering
* erfarenhet av verksamhetsnära system och av att hantera information som används för fakturering, statistik eller uppföljning
* god systemvana och förmåga att arbeta strukturerat med register, orderflöden, artiklar, kundupplägg och underlag
* god svenska i tal och skrift
* god dator- och systemvana
* B-körkort.


 Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet från våg, återvinning, avfallsverksamhet, materialflöden, ekonomiunderlag eller annan driftadministrativ verksamhet. Erfarenhet av avvikelsehantering, felsökning, kvalitetssäkring eller processförbättring är också värdefull.
   

  

 Det är även en fördel om du har arbetat med Thor, ScanX eller andra våg- eller verksamhetssystem. Kunskaper i Excel, Power BI, avfallsskatt, transportdokument, materialklassning, provtagning eller krav kopplade till miljötillstånd är ytterligare meriter.
   

  

 Du trivs med att växla mellan operativt arbete och utveckling och vill bidra till långsiktig kvalitet och samhällsnytta.
   

  

 Hos oss är det viktigt att du bidrar till en inkluderande arbetsmiljö där vi tillsammans gör skillnad för Södertälje.
   

  

 Välj Telge
   

  

 Inom Telge finns alla möjligheter för dig att själv forma din framtid. Här finns det plats att växa, både i din yrkesroll och som människa. Telge är en arbetsplats med trygga anställningsvillkor. Du som anställd hos oss omfattas av kollektivavtal där viktiga saker som försäkringar och pension ingår.
   

  

 Här får du mindre pussel och mer liv. Att ha balans mellan arbetslivet och den privata sfären är viktig för ett hållbart liv. Så långt det är möjligt har vi flexibla arbetstider där var och en styr över sin tid. Vi erbjuder flera förmåner som gör vardagen lite lättare – som 3 000 kronor i friskvårdsbidrag per år, föräldrapenningtillägg och utökad sjuklön. Hos oss får du trygghet, balans och möjligheten att må bra – både på och utanför jobbet.
   

  

 Läs mer om några av våra medarbetare som valt Telge: Vi valde Telge.
   

  

 Mångfald inkludering och trygghet
   

  

 Vi på Telge arbetar aktivt för mångfald och inkludering och välkomnar därför medarbetare med olika erfarenheter, bakgrunder och kompetenser. En trygg och säker arbetsmiljö är vår högsta prioritet. Arbetspsykologiska tester ingår i våra rekryteringsprocesser till chefs- och specialisttjänster och vi genomför återkommande, slumpmässiga drogtester bland alla våra medarbetare.
   

  

 Sista ansökningsdatum
   

  

 4 oktober 2026
   

  

 Några frågor?
   

  

 Vill du veta mer om tjänsten eller har frågor om rekryteringsprocessen? Då är det rekryterande chef Robert Rekonius, avdelningschef materialåtervinning, du ska kontakta på 08-550 228 10 eller robert.rekonius@telge.se.
   

  

 Fackliga kontaktpersoner är Robert Holm för Vision och Magnus Enderin för SACO, du når båda på 08-550 220 00.
   

  

 Är du nyfiken på att läsa mer om oss?
   

  

 Läs mer om oss som arbetsgivare: Jobba hos oss
   

  

 Läs mer om: Telge Återvinning
   

  

 Så här skickar du in din ansökan
   

  

 Du söker tjänsten via Telges digitala ansökningssystem där du bifogar ditt CV och en kort motivering till varför du är rätt person för rollen som system- och kvalitetskoordinator på Vågen. Vi ser gärna att du också beskriver relevant erfarenhet av system, kvalitetssäkring och driftadministration. Urval och intervjuer sker löpande, vilket innebär att vi går igenom ansökningar allt eftersom de kommer in.

title: Senior PV Expert
description:
*PharmaRelations is the Nordic market leader within talent services for the life science industry. We specialize in partnering with some of the top and most innovative organizations exclusively in the Life Science sector across our region. We add value to our clients and candidates with our consultancy services, outsourcing solutions and recruitment of specialists and leaders.* 




*We are a Nordic organization with over 200 colleagues and with offices in Sweden, Norway, Denmark and Finland.* 




  





 We are now looking for a
 **Senior PV-expert** 
 to join our experienced and skilled PV-team. As a member or the team you will have the opportunity to work with different projects and customers in an nordic/international set up.
 



 You will have the opportunity to work in a team of PV specialists, helping our clients with the best solutions depending on their needs. You will work with several clients in parallel giving you great variation in your daily work. You may also have the opportunity to mentor and support other PV consultants within PharmaRelations.
 



  





**Who are you?** 




 We think you have several years of experience of project- and client account management within PV/drug safety. You have a strong knowledge and experience working with safety databases and Quality Management Systems. You have a great understanding in the regulatory requirements in the PV area. You have ability and interest to work both strategic and operational duties with a solution-oriented mindset.
 



 You are fluent in Swedish and English, both written and spoken.
 



 You may be based anywhere in Sweden, though a preference is that you live close to one of our offices in Solna or Lund as our in-house consultants are based at PharmaRelations and not at our clients sites, even though visits to clients occur as needed.
 



 To thrive at PharmaRelations and with our clients, we believe that you are a non-prestigious person who both has the eagerness to learn as well as to share your experiences. We believe you enjoy working together with the team, building strategies and new relationships. At the same time, you have a strong drive of your own and like to structure and influence your own work
 



  





**Why?** 




 This is your chance to work with a number of our different clients at the same time, helping with your expertise, while having a permanent employment with PharmaRelations. You will primarily be working on remote assignments, occasionally visiting customer sites, giving you a flexible, varied and stimulating workday every day!
 



 At PharmaRelations we also offer a great place to work. You will get the chance to develop your skills, and to work with a team of highly intelligent, innovative and passionate experts across the Nordics. PharmaRelations offer a place where there is room for you to excel, be valued and make a difference. Not just to us, but ultimately indirectly to the patients’ lives we help improve and save every day by servicing the life science industry.
 



  





**Apply today!** 




 Applications will be handled continuously so apply today!
 



*Due to GDPR, we cannot receive any CVs via e-mail.*

title: Insurance Portfolio Solutions Owner
description:
We are looking for a driven Insurance Portfolio Solutions Owner to take end-to-end ownership of our portfolio solutions across the Swedish business. This is a business-responsibility role– a position focused on internal impact, strategic development, and acting as a placement specialist supporting our teams with property and casualty solutions
   

  

 The Role
   

  

 You will work closely with stakeholders across the organisation to ensure our portfolio solutions are commercially strong, well-structured, and fit for purpose. This is an ideal role for someone who enjoys internal work, driving improvements, and creating structure in a complex environment – rather than spending most of the time in external client meetings.
   

  

 Your Responsibilities
   

  

* Own and develop Marsh Sweden's full set of Insurance portfolio solutions, ensuring clear value proposition, governance, and commercial performance
* Drive prioritisation and continuous improvement of portfolio offerings, including identifying gaps and opportunities
* Coordinate internal stakeholders (e.g., Sales, Placement/Market Management, Specialty, Operations) to ensure alignment and execution
* Monitor portfolio performance and business outcomes, and translate insights into actions and recommendations
* Support internal communication, documentation, and ways of working related to the portfolio solutions
* Act as a placement specialist responsible for placing FINPRO's property and casualty insurance solutions


 What You Bring
   

  

* Broad, generalist understanding of the insurance business and how products/solutions are built, positioned, and managed
* Strong commercial mindset and ability to take ownership and drive work forward in a structured way
* Confident and resilient style – comfortable challenging and influencing stakeholders
* Enjoy internal collaboration and working cross-functionally with multiple teams and priorities


**Experience and/or strong interest in one or more of the following areas:**
* Property
* Liability
* KOFF


 What We Offer
   

  

* A key role with broad visibility across Marsh Sweden and real impact on our portfolio direction and performance
* A collaborative environment with strong expertise across specialties and functions
* The opportunity to shape ways of working and drive improvements across a critical part of our offering
* A competitive salary and an attractive benefits package, aligned with the responsibilities and impact of the position


 Are you a driven problem-solver who sees opportunities to build and improve? We are looking for you!
   

  

 Marsh (NYSE: MRSH) is a global leader in risk, reinsurance and capital, people and investments, and management consulting, advising clients in 130 countries. With annual revenue of over $27 billion and more than 95,000 colleagues, Marsh helps build the confidence to thrive through the power of perspective. For more information, visit marsh.com, or follow us on LinkedIn and X.
   

  

 Marsh is committed to creating a diverse, inclusive and flexible work environment. We aim to attract and retain the best people and embrace diversity of age, background, disability, ethnic origin, family duties, gender orientation or expression, marital status, nationality, parental status, personal or social status, political affiliation, race, religion and beliefs, sex/gender, sexual orientation or expression, skin color, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.
   

  

 Marsh is committed to hybrid work, which includes the flexibility of working remotely and the collaboration, connections and professional development benefits of working together in the office. All Marsh colleagues are expected to be in their local office or working onsite with clients at least three days per week. Office-based teams will identify at least one “anchor day” per week on which their full team will be together in person.
