title: Head of Digital Advice & Discretionary Portfolio Management (DPM)
description:
*Nordnet is a leading pan-Nordic digital platform for savings and investments. Ever since our start in 1996, our purpose has been to democratize savings and investments. Through passion, simplicity, and transparency, we challenge traditional ways in the financial industry, and give private savers access to the same information, tools and services as professionals. Our ambition is to inspire, encourage and enable people to take their savings to the next level, no matter who they are.*
**In Brief**
 As Head of Digital Advice & DPM, you will take commercial and product ownership of Nordnet’s digital wealth management strategy. Working directly with the Chief Wealth Management Officer and the Area Product Owner, you will translate strategic ambitions into business results and high-impact digital products. In this role, you will collaborate closely with a dedicated tech team to bring our next-generation advisory and DPM capabilities to market across the Nordics.
   

  

 While initially driving strategic and cross-functional alignment across product, tech, and business units, this role is designed for long-term growth. As the Advice & DPM business expands, you will have the opportunity to take on formal managerial responsibility, shaping both the operational roadmap and the leadership structure of the department.
   

  

**This is Part of the Role**
* Drive Business Ownership: Take overall ownership of commercial strategy, positioning, product development, and P&L outcomes for Advice & DPM, and initiatives.
* Lead & Build the Department: Provide daily functional direction to cross-functional teams now, while preparing to recruit and managerially lead the Advice & DPM team in the next phase.
* Executive & Product Alignment: Partner closely with the Chief Wealth Management Officer on strategic direction while collaborating daily with the Area Product Owner to prioritize feature roadmaps.
* Partner with Tech Teams: Work seamlessly alongside a dedicated tech team to build and scale features linked to Guidance, Advice and DPM.
* Ensure Regulatory Compliance: Collaborate with Legal, Risk, and Compliance teams to maintain alignment with MiFID II advisory standards, suitability rules, and local Nordic frameworks.
* Deliver Growth & Impact: Deliver on customer performance by launching digital-first tools that increase net savings, capture external wallet share, and boost overall engagement.


**This is You**
* Solid experience as a Business Owner, Commercial Lead, or Senior Product Manager within wealth management, fintech, or digital banking.
* Proven ability to lead and align cross-functional teams in a matrix setup, with the readiness and drive to step into a formal line management role.
* Strong background working alongside cross-functional tech teams, product owners, and executive leadership.
* Deep understanding of MiFID II advisory regulations, DPM frameworks, and investment compliance.
* Commercial and analytical mindset with a strong focus on driving revenue, customer growth, and product adoption.
* Relevant degree in Engineering, Business Administration, or Finance.
* Swedsec license


**We offer**
 Nordnet started from a passionate belief that changing the hierarchical financial world was possible. We became part of redefining the industry when we gave the customers power over their savings. You will become part of a journey that has only yet started towards the vision of making our customers the best investors they can be. To be leading in IT is pivotal for that journey and you will work with colleagues who have a great passion for that goal.
   

  

 We are 1000 employees in Stockholm, Oslo, Helsinki, Copenhagen and Frankfurt. We cooperate, exchange ideas and use our core competencies to continuously improve the way we meet our customers. Open communication, creativity and engagement are important parts of our everyday life at the office.
   

  

**Visit us on:** 
 www.nordnetab.com, www.nordnet.se, www.nordnet.no , www.nordnet.dk, www.nordnet.fi and www.nordnet.de.
   

  

**Application**
 Please note that we do only accept applications through our recruitment system, hence no email applications will be considered.
   

  

 If you have questions, please contact the Chief Wealth Management Officer, Alexander Fick alexander.frick@nordnet.se
   

  

 We want to inform you that Nordnet conducts mandatory credit and background checks, as well as drug testing as part of our recruitment process.
   

  

 Please note that we will start reviewing applications after the summer holidays.
   

  

 We look forward to receiving your application!

title: Senior Enterprise Account Executive Legal & Compliance Swedish/English speaking
description:
**Job Description**
**Senior Enterprise Account Executive – Legal and Compliance**
**SWEDISH AND ENGLISH SPEAKING**
**Key Responsibilities**
 We are a leading provider of AI and software technology solutions, committed to delivering innovative products and services that drive business growth and customer success. We're seeking a dynamic and experienced Account Executive to join our team and help us expand our Enterprise customer market presence while nurturing strong customer relationships.
   

  

 As an Senior Enterprise Account Executive, you will be responsible for driving sales growth, managing customer relationships, and ensuring high levels of customer satisfaction and retention for our large enterprise corporate customers. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to develop and implement effective sales strategies, acquire new customers, and maximize revenue from existing accounts.
   

  

 The Senior Enterprise Account Executive is responsible for new business growth in existing accounts in his/her assigned account territory. It carries a monthly and annual sales quota based on new business sales through targeted upsell and cross sell campaigns of Thomson Reuters Legal and Compliance products which includes the market leading HighQ, Legal Tracker, Thought Trace, Practical Law, Westlaw, Regulatory Intelligence and Compliance Learning services. We are looking for an individual that can demonstrate self-sufficient success and the ability to find, manage and close high-value deals.
   

  

* Sales Strategy and Execution:
* Develop and execute strategic account plans to achieve sales targets and expand the enterprise customer base
* Collaborate with account specialists, solution consultants, product specialists, and marketing teams to create effective sales and renewal strategies
* Act as a customer advocate within the company
* Meet or exceed established goals, KPIs, and performance metrics
* Customer Acquisition and Growth:
* Drive new customer acquisition through strategic sales initiatives
* Identify, pursue, and close new sales opportunities within assigned territory or market segment
* Upsell and cross-sell to existing customers to maximize revenue
* Customer Relationship Management:
* Serve as the primary point of contact for customer inquiries and issues
* Foster strong, long-term relationships with key customers and stakeholders
* Ensure high levels of customer satisfaction and loyalty
* Collaborate with the customer success team for smooth onboarding and continued customer success
* Customer Engagement:
* Lead customer meetings and develop presentations for complex sales opportunities
* Understand customer business needs and challenges
* Present tailored solutions demonstrating how our products solve specific problems
* Conduct regular business reviews to ensure alignment with customer goals
* Collaboration with Internal Teams:
* Work closely with solution consultants to develop tailored solutions
* Coordinate with professional services for timely implementation
* Partner with Partnerships & Alliances team for growth and strategic account planning
* Provide customer feedback to inform product development and marketing strategies


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, or related field
* 5+ years of experience in account management or sales in the software/technology industry
* Proven track record of meeting or exceeding sales targets
* Strong understanding of AI and software technology products and services
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and presentation skills
* Demonstrated ability in solution selling and strategic account planning
* Experience with CRM systems and sales analytics tools


**Preferred Qualifications**
 MBA or relevant advanced degree
   

  

 Experience in AI or machine learning industry
   

  

 Proven success in managing enterprise-level accounts
   

  

 Track record of developing and nurturing partner relationships
   

  

**Key Success Measures**
 Sales performance (quota achievement, revenue growth, win rate)
   

  

 Customer relationship management (satisfaction scores, retention rates, NPS)
   

  

 Operational efficiency (productivity, forecast accuracy, pipeline coverage)
   

  

**What’s in it For You?**
* Hybrid Work Model: We’ve adopted a flexible hybrid working environment (2-3 days a week in the office depending on the role) for our office-based roles while delivering a seamless experience that is digitally and physically connected.
* Flexibility & Work-Life Balance: Flex My Way is a set of supportive workplace policies designed to help manage personal and professional responsibilities, whether caring for family, giving back to the community, or finding time to refresh and reset. This builds upon our flexible work arrangements, including work from anywhere for up to 8 weeks per year, empowering employees to achieve a better work-life balance.
* Career Development and Growth: By fostering a culture of continuous learning and skill development, we prepare our talent to tackle tomorrow’s challenges and deliver real-world solutions. Our Grow My Way programming and skills-first approach ensures you have the tools and knowledge to grow, lead, and thrive in an AI-enabled future.
* Industry Competitive Benefits: We offer comprehensive benefit plans to include flexible vacation, two company-wide Mental Health Days off, access to the Headspace app, retirement savings, tuition reimbursement, employee incentive programs, and resources for mental, physical, and financial wellbeing.
* Culture: Globally recognized, award-winning reputation for inclusion and belonging, flexibility, work-life balance, and more. We live by our values: Obsess over our Customers, Compete to Win, Challenge (Y)our Thinking, Act Fast / Learn Fast, and Stronger Together.
* Social Impact: Make an impact in your community with our Social Impact Institute. We offer employees two paid volunteer days off annually and opportunities to get involved with pro-bono consulting projects and Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) initiatives.
* Making a Real-World Impact: We are one of the few companies globally that helps its customers pursue justice, truth, and transparency. Together, with the professionals and institutions we serve, we help uphold the rule of law, turn the wheels of commerce, catch bad actors, report the facts, and provide trusted, unbiased information to people all over the world.


**About Us**
 Thomson Reuters informs the way forward by bringing together the trusted content and technology that people and organizations need to make the right decisions. We serve professionals across legal, tax, accounting, compliance, government, and media. Our products combine highly specialized software and insights to empower professionals with the data, intelligence, and solutions needed to make informed decisions, and to help institutions in their pursuit of justice, truth, and transparency. Reuters, part of Thomson Reuters, is a world leading provider of trusted journalism and news.
   

  

 We are powered by the talents of 26,000 employees across more than 70 countries, where everyone has a chance to contribute and grow professionally in flexible work environments. At a time when objectivity, accuracy, fairness, and transparency are under attack, we consider it our duty to pursue them. Sound exciting? Join us and help shape the industries that move society forward.
   

  

 As a global business, we rely on the unique backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences of all employees to deliver on our business goals. To ensure we can do that, we seek talented, qualified employees in all our operations around the world regardless of race, color, sex/gender, including pregnancy, gender identity and expression, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, disability, age, marital status, citizen status, veteran status, or any other protected classification under applicable law. Thomson Reuters is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer providing a drug-free workplace.
   

  

 We also make reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and for sincerely held religious beliefs in accordance with applicable law. More information on requesting an accommodation here.
   

  

 Learn more on how to protect yourself from fraudulent job postings here.
   

  

 More information about Thomson Reuters can be found on thomsonreuters.com.

**Om arbetsplatsen**
 Handlingskraftig och samhällsintresserad? Då tror vi att du kommer att trivas hos oss. Statistikmyndigheten SCB är landets största och främsta kunskapskälla inom statistik. Vår statistik används överallt, hemma vid köksbordet, i nyhetsrapporteringen och av beslutsfattare i riksdag och regering.
   

  

**Arbetsuppgifter**
 Vill du vara med och beräkna Sveriges inflationstakt? Är du statistiker med stort samhällsintresse? Den här tjänsten passar dig som är nyutexaminerad eller i början av karriären.
   

  

 På sektionen för konsumentpriser kommer du att arbeta tillsammans med engagerade kollegor i Solna med att beräkna och analysera prisutvecklingen i Sverige. Arbetsuppgifterna varierar i grad av komplexitet, från enklare till mycket komplexa.
   

  

 Sektionen ansvarar för att ta fram Konsumentprisindex (KPI) och KPI med fast ränta (KPIF) som utgör de officiella måtten för inflationstakten. Statistiken publiceras månadsvis och det ställs därför mycket höga krav på kvalitetssäkring av statistiken och att arbeta med korta deadlines. Statistiken har flera centrala användningsområden i samhället och rapporteras och till EU:s statistikmyndighet Eurostat.
   

  

 Sektionen för konsumentpriser med ca 20 medarbetare har sin verksamhet i Solna och ansvarar för statistik över prisutvecklingen i Sverige. Vår statistikproduktion utgörs till största delen av Konsumentprisindex (KPI) som mäter den genomsnittliga prisutvecklingen för hela den privata inhemska konsumtionen. Vi ansvarar även för det svenska deltagandet i Köpkraftsparitetsundersökningarna (PPP) där den relativa prisnivån i olika länder undersöks. Statistiken har flera centrala användningsområden i samhället. Statistiken utgör också ett viktigt underlag till Nationalräkenskaperna.
   

  

 Sektionen har också ett nära samarbete med sektionen för producentpriser och tjänsten kan också innebära arbete på sektionen för producentpriser.
   

  

 Vill du ...
   

  

* medverka i framställningen, presentationen och publiceringen av den månatliga statistiken och där arbeta mot skarpa deadlines,
* arbeta med kvalitetssäkring av statistiken i form av granskning, kontroller och dokumentation av arbetsprocesser
* medverka i ämnesnära utvecklingsarbete och samordning av statistikens kvalitet och innehåll, ha kontakter med såväl interna som externa statistikanvändare
* delta i analysarbete och omvärldsbevakning inom området
* medverka i utvecklingen av statistikens kvalitet och innehåll
* då tror vi att den här tjänsten kan vara riktigt intressant för dig!


**Kvalifikationer**
 Vi vill att du har:
   

  

* akademisk samhällsvetenskaplig examen i statistik
* har god förmåga att uttrycka dig i tal och skrift på svenska och engelska
* har relevant och aktuell kunskap eller erfarenhet inom programmeringsspråk för statistikändamål, dataanalys och databashantering, t ex R eller SAS.
* kunskaper i Excel och övriga delar av Officepaketet
* 30 hp i nationalekonomi


 Vi ser det som meriterande om du har:
   

  

* 60 hp i nationalekonomi
* aktuell arbetslivserfarenhet som SCB bedömer vara relevant för tjänsten
* mastersexamen i statistik eller nationalekonomi


 För att det här ska bli en bra matchning för både dig och oss är det viktigt att du har en god förmåga att samarbeta. Du arbetar bra med andra människor och du vill ingå i ett team där du bidrar till att dina kollegor trivs och lyckas med sitt arbete.
   

  

 Du gillar att ta initiativ, bidra med idéer och driver arbetet framåt. Hos oss trivs du om du är nyfiken och handlingskraftig.Du förväntas ta ansvar för ditt eget arbete på ett noggrant och kvalitetsmedvetet sätt.
   

  

 Samtidigt har du lätt för att anpassa dig till nya förutsättningar och har förmåga att omprioritera när behov och förutsättningar förändras. Du är flexibel och har förmåga att växla mellan arbetsuppgifter. Dessutom är du strukturerad och kan planera, organisera och prioritera ditt arbete på ett effektivt sätt.
   

  

**Övrigt**
 Den här tjänsten finns på sektionen för Konsumentpriser iSolna. Utifrån verksamhetens förutsättningar finns det möjlighet att även arbeta viss tid hemifrån.
   

  

 På SCB har vi valt att ta bort det personliga brevet i våra rekryteringar och du ska därför inte bifoga det i din ansökan. Svaren i urvalsfrågorna och CV ligger till grund för om du är kvalificerad att gå vidare i processen.
   

  

 Anställningen är tillsvidare och inleds vanligtvis med sex månaders provanställning. Tillträdesdatum kommer vi överens om.
   

  

 Vi erbjuder flextidsavtal, friskvårdstimme och friskvårdsbidrag. Som medarbetare vid en statlig myndighet har du upp till 35 semesterdagar per år, beroende på din ålder, redan från ditt första anställningsår. Du kan läsa mer om hur det är att jobba hos oss på vår hemsida: https://www.scb.se/om-scb/jobba-hos-oss/
   

  

 Hos oss är alla medarbetares kompetens och potential viktig. Vi tror på en inkluderande kultur där vi drar nytta av vår mångfald och våra olikheter. Du som söker delar våra förhållningssätt: mod att agera, tillit till varandras kompetens och goda vilja, handlingskraft att omsätta ord i arbete samt var och ens ansvar att bidra till helheten.
   

  

 Som medarbetare på SCB förväntas du bidra till att upprätthålla den statliga värdegrunden genom att arbeta sakligt, opartiskt och med respekt för alla människors lika värde. SCB:s verksamhet bygger på förtroende, vilket ställer höga krav på integritet, gott omdöme samt ett ansvarsfullt förhållningssätt till säkerhet och sekretess. Vi lägger stor vikt vid din personliga lämplighet.
   

  

 Du ansöker genom att registrera ditt CV på svenska. Bifoga ditt examensbevis med kursförteckning. Krav på akademiska poäng som inte ingår i en examen ska verifieras genom studieintyg eller registerutdrag. I din ansökan får du besvara ett antal urvalsfrågor i vårt rekryteringssystem som du kommer till när du klickar på Ansök nedan.
   

  

 Om du har skyddade personuppgifter, vänligen kontakta HR-partner via SCB:s växel.

title: Distribution Partner Account Manager – Nordics, Baltics & Eastern Europe
description:
Extreme Networks represents a tremendous career challenge and personal growth opportunity. We’re a company of strong market standing, with proven technological capability, differentiators and the growth mindset to overachieve goals.
   

  

 We also adamantly promote an internal culture that truly embraces diversity, inclusion and equality in the workplace. We’re proud to foster an environment where every Extreme employee can thrive because of their differences, not despite them.
   

  

 Extreme’s EMEA distribution team stands out as one that fosters success in all aspects, from over-achieving sales targets to providing a first-class team culture.
   

  

 We are recruiting for the role of Distribution Partner Account Manager (DPAM) responsible for our key Nordics, Baltics & Eastern Europe region. The DPAM is the ‘quarterback’ for the distributor (disti) relationship. Working closely with regional leaders plus other stakeholders, the DPAM ensures distributor activity aligns with the business priorities of the EMEA and global distribution team and to our Regional Directors’ (RD) objectives.
   

  

**The DPAM is fundamentally an experienced leader and influencer who…**
* Reports to the Senior Director, EMEA Distribution as part of a global distribution organization;
* Drives corporate sales revenue with deep focus on disti-led high potential resellers to ensure a pipeline of new and emerging VARs and MSPs;
* Maintains continuous sell-in focus to ensure disti inventory holding metrics are met;
* Aligns with stakeholders / business partners including iDPAM, regional RD, Channel Leaders, PAMs, Field Sales, Services/Support Team, SE teams, Disti Ops, Order Management Team, Finance, RevRec, Supply Chain and Legal team.


**The DPAM owns the C-Level relationship (and below) with all distributors in region and manages these core responsibilities:**
* Builds and executes a plan to maximize and measure disti performance, reflecting local plans where relevant
* Aligns to RD and Channel Leader to realize the reseller development potential of the region
* Manages a consistent set of KPIs
* Enables cloud capability into and through disti
* Leads contractual and other operational negotiations
* Leads inventory and stocking discussions to satisfy contractual / program minimums and other corporate objectives
* Manages the weekly bookings and POS forecast as well as stock rotation expectations
* Partners with distributor and Extreme channel marketing team to execute strategic marketing programs and activities
* Leads Quarterly Business Planning (QBP) with distributors and stakeholders
* Evaluates and enables disti partner program compliance, including competence
* Participates in setting quarterly Value Incentive Rebate (VIR) targets and attainment tracking
* Proactively manages MDF approvals and spend in alignment with the business and marketing plan
* Shares best practices and initiatives, covers colleague absences when appropriate and maintains continuity of business plan for own accounts with colleagues
* Leads a virtual team of iDPAM and other colleagues


**Necessary Skills Will Include**
* Degree level education and/or significant distribution management experience
* Relevant local language fluency as well as fluent English
* An optimistic, confident and enthusiastic attitude with a progressive and pragmatic approach to achieving goals
* Self-starter and team player
* An experienced background or strong solution selling skillset in transmitting advanced technology differentiators into the channel
* Able and willing to travel regularly across the region (some global travel) including some out-of-hours working
* Strong relationship-building, presentation, AI and problem-solving skills
* An influencer and leader


 OTE is on a 60/40 split and is based on qualifications and experience between 1.2 and 1.4 million SEK.
   

  

 Extreme Networks Benefits
   

  

 Fundamentally, the successful candidate will be someone who brings us something new, who embraces change, who is a great cultural fit, who leads virtual teams with passion and respect and who makes Extreme more relevant to our distributors whilst making our distributors more relevant to Extreme.
   

  

**Extreme Networks, Inc. (** 
**EXTR** 
**) creates effortless networking experiences that enable all of us to advance. We push the boundaries of technology leveraging the powers of machine learning, artificial intelligence, analytics, and automation. Over 50,000 customers globally trust our end-to-end, cloud-driven networking solutions and rely on our top-rated services and support to accelerate their digital transformation efforts and deliver progress like never before. For more information, visit Extreme's** 
**website** 
**or follow us on Twitter, LinkedIn, and Facebook.**
 We encourage people from underrepresented groups to apply. Come Advance with us! In keeping with our values, no employee or applicant will face discrimination/harassment based on: race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion, age, gender, marital domestic partner status, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability status, or veteran status. Above and beyond discrimination/harassment based on “protected categories,” Extreme Networks also strives to prevent other, subtler forms of inappropriate behavior (e.g., stereotyping) from ever gaining a foothold in our organization. Whether blatant or hidden, barriers to success have no place at Extreme Networks.
   

  

 We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: Enterprise Account Executive
description:
**About Proxify** 




  





 Proxify gives companies vetted senior developers within 48 hours, so they can ship without months of hiring. Since 2018 we've worked with 2,500+ companies. Enterprise customers include Securitas, Electrolux and Lufthansa. The Financial Times ranked us Sweden's 3rd fastest-growing company in 2025, and we were in Deloitte's Fast 50 Sweden in 2024.
 



  





**Why enterprise, and why now?** 
 AI is changing how software gets built, but it hasn't closed the talent gap. It has moved it. Large companies are rebuilding their engineering organisations around AI, cloud and data, and they need engineers who can build and run these systems now. Proxify helps place those engineers.
 



  





**The role** 




  





 As an Enterprise Account Executive, you'll win new enterprise logos and grow them across business units and subsidiaries. You own each deal from first outreach to signature: an outbound role.
 



  





 Enterprise buyers don't buy developer capacity the way startups do. A typical deal involves:
 



  




1. **Getting in** 
 : Reaching CTOs or VPs of Engineering through research-led outbound and warm paths into existing customer groups.
2. **Proving value** 
 : A pilot placement of 1–3 engineers, scoped with Client Engineering, that shows speed and quality.
3. **Getting through procurement** 
 : Vendor onboarding, security and legal review, and negotiating a place on a preferred-supplier list, often against large consultancies already in the account.
4. **Scaling** 
 : Turning the framework agreement into multi-team demand.



  





**What you'll do** 




  




* Build and work a named account,
 **generating your own pipeline** 
 through multi-channel outbound;
* **Run multi-threaded deals** 
 across engineering, business, procurement and legal stakeholders;
* Build
 **business cases** 
 leaders can take to their CFO: cost, time-to-hire and delivery risk;
* **Negotiate** 
 commercial terms, MSAs and supplier-framework entries;
* **Find expansion routes** 
 into subsidiaries and new business units of existing customer groups;
* **Hand won accounts** 
 to Account Management with a clear expansion plan;
* **Keep** 
 your pipeline, forecast and
 **CRM accurate** 
 , and help write the enterprise playbook as it grows.



  





**What we're looking for** 




  




* At least 4 years of new-business B2B sales in SaaS, tech services, IT consulting, staffing or outsourcing;
* Experience running the full cycle yourself, from cold outbound to signed contract, including procurement and legal;
* Confidence with C-level and technical buyers: you can talk about engineering teams, AI and cloud without a script;
* Comfort building structure where it doesn't exist yet;
* Fluent English



  





**Nice to have** 




  




* Experience selling developer staffing, IT consulting or engineering services to large enterprises;
* A network among enterprise engineering leaders;
* Swedish, German or another language;
* Experience with a structured method such as MEDDPICC or command of the message;
* Experience helping set up a new sales function.



  





**Why it may not be your match** 




  





 ❌ You prefer highly structured environments with established processes rather than helping build them.
 



 ❌ You enjoy account management more than hunting for and closing new business.
 



 ❌ You lack curiosity about technology or feel uncomfortable discussing technical challenges.
 



 ❌ You are not based in Stockholm for on-site collaboration.
 



 ❌ You solely worked as an Account Manager and don't have outbound experience.
 



  





**How to apply** 




  





 Send your CV in English, plus a short note (or three bullet points) answering:
 


1. Which enterprise logos have you won from scratch, and what were the deal sizes?
2. Walk us through one complex deal: who was involved, what nearly killed it, and how you closed it.
3. Why Proxify, and why now?

title: IT Operation Expert
description:
**Job ID: 5605**
 Would you like to work in an international team of IT professionals with a long experience in enterprise file transfer services and business processes? We are now looking for a IT Operations Expert to manage and develop our B2B integration platform, working closely with other IT teams and business stakeholders.
   

  

 At Nordea, we know our customers’ needs are changing – and we’re deeply committed to meeting them with the financial solutions of tomorrow. We’re creating an agile environment where we’re harnessing the power of technology – one where you can make an impact. So bring your skills, ideas and unique background. With us, you’ll find plenty of opportunities to grow and make your mark on something bigger.
   

  

 Nordea is a place where traditions meet tomorrow. We’re not just a bank; we’re a tech employer on a mission to evolve finance securely and responsibly. Together, we impact millions of people’s daily lives by ensuring they can access our solutions anytime, anywhere, while safeguarding their personal data and wealth. Join us in making an impact on the banking industry.
   

  

**About Our Team**
 Welcome to the E-Bridge team. We add value by providing file transfer services for our corporate customers and internal partners. As a Senior IT Analyst, you’ll play a valuable role in providing high quality, business critical and reliable service.
   

  

 This role is based in Stockholm, Sweden.
   

  

**What You’ll Be Doing**
* Operate, maintain and improve our primary B2B integration platform.
* Participate/lead major platform changes e.g. cloud migration.
* Continuously improve monitoring of the technical platform as well as data flows.
* Capacity and performance management.
* Automate manual operations.
* Handle incidents and participate in problem investigations.
* Act as the 3rd line support and the escalation point to the vendor.
* Work closely with our developers adopting DevOps practices.
* Onboarding of new B2B partners or internal systems, doing technical assessments and configuration changes.


**To succeed in this role, we believe that you:**
* are self-driven, communicative, team player with good understanding of critical enterprise environments and importance of operational stability
* are able to stay calm, focused and work rational under pressure


**Your experience and background:**
* Expert technical knowledge and experience of communication and file transfer protocols: SFTP, FTPS, HTTPS.
* Knowledge of digital certificates and file/message integrity.
* Experience with different hosting environments e.g. VMs with Linux, containers, cloud providers.
* Good understanding of networking concepts.
* Scripting and automation skills e.g. bash, Python, Ansible.
* Monitoring tools skills e.g. Splunk, Grafana.
* Understanding of databases and basic SQL skills.
* Good understanding of distributed systems.


**Additional skills that would be an advantage:**
* Experience of B2B integration tools e.g. experience with SEEBURGER Business Integration Suite.
* Experience with Jira, Confluence, Git/Bitbucket, Bamboo.
* Knowledge about file messages/filetypes used in banking sector.
* Knowledge about additional protocols:  SWIFT, MQ.
* Knowledge about Webservices.


**What We Offer**
 Collaboration. Ownership. Passion. Courage. These are the values that guide us in how we work and how we make decisions – and that we imagine you share with us.
   

  

 People are driven by many different factors. For some, it’s to take their career to the next level. For others, it’s to break new ground within their area of expertise – in other words, with us, you will always move forward.
   

  

 A culture that fosters performance and growth in one of the largest Nordic banks, offering various opportunities to evolve, develop and learn from brilliant colleagues with diverse backgrounds in a vibrant working environment.
   

  

 Hybrid working model – we believe in the value of bringing people together and at the same time we embrace the freedom of flexibility.
   

  

 Diversity and inclusion are a natural part of our daily work. We know that an inclusive workplace is a sustainable one. We genuinely believe that our diverse backgrounds, experiences, characteristics and traits make us stronger together. Every day we strive to find new ways to improve diversity and inclusion within our community e.g. we have signed the European Diversity Charters in the countries where we operate to show our commitment and engage with others to continue learning and improving.
   

  

 If this sounds like you, get in touch!
   

  

**Next Steps**
 Submit your application no later than 12/10/2026 For more information about the position, you are more than welcome to contact Darko Delinac, darko.delinac@nordea.com and Ritu Mittal ritu.mittal@consult.nordea.com for HR related matters.
   

  

**We enable dreams and aspirations for a greater good.**
**We build relationships.** 
 We add a personal touch to everything we do – when advising our customers, collaborating with colleagues, and meeting our potential candidates.
   

  

**We learn and develop.** 
 We take pride in being experts and thinking ahead. We use our expertise to meet our customers’ needs, from the simplest to the most complex. We bring a growth mindset to our work that enables us to focus on a broader perspective in our daily challenges.
   

  

**We lead change.** 
 We are responsible and aware of the impact of our decisions, both for our customers and for our local and global communities. Mindful of our responsibility towards current and future generations, we have made sustainability an integrated part of our business strategy.
   

  

**We are Nordea.** 
 We have a 200-year history of supporting and growing the Nordic economies and our values are deeply rooted in these open, progressive and collaborative societies. As one of the biggest employers in the Nordics, Poland and Estonia, you have excellent opportunities to evolve, develop and move forward with us.
   

  

 Studies show that members of underrepresented communities don’t apply for jobs unless they tick all the qualification boxes. If this is part of why you hesitate to apply, we would like you to reconsider and give it a chance. Maybe your profile fits our needs much better than you think."
   

  

 For union information, please contact Finansförbundet at finansforbundet@nordea.se or SACO at SacoNordea@nordea.com.

title: Supporttekniker säkra miljöer
description:
Vi söker en Supporttekniker säkra miljöer som vill vara med och bidra till en problemfri vardag för våra medarbetare. Hos oss får du möjlighet att verkligen göra skillnad i en verksamhet med ett viktigt samhällsuppdrag.
   

  

**Om tjänsten**
 I rollen som supporttekniker i säkra miljöer hos oss arbetar du med hantering av IT-relaterade ärenden på plats såsom support, felsökning, hårdvara. Du bidrar till att skapa en smidig och effektiv arbetsmiljö och hanterar både enklare och mer komplexa supportärenden.
   

  

 I denna roll arbetar du nära verksamheten och felsöker och åtgärdar klient-, applikations- och andra användarrelaterade ärenden i säkra miljöer. Därtill även installation och konfiguration av datorer och annan IT-utrustning samt mottagande och utlämnande av IT-utrustning. Rollen hanterar och arbetar i ärendehanteringssystem och samarbetar med IT-drift och andra tekniska team samt hanterar beställningar, incidenter, change och handledning.
   

  

 Tjänsten är placerad i Stockholm.
   

  

**Om dig**
 Vi söker dig som har minst gymnasiekompetens eller motsvarande utbildning/erfarenhet som bedöms som likvärdig. Du har några års erfarenhet av relevant supportarbete i 1:a och/eller 2:a linjen samt erfarenhet av ärendehantering och arbete med Windows. Därtill har du även kunskap om support av Windowsbaserade plattformar.
   

  

 Det ses som meriterande om du dessutom har utbildning inom tekniskt relevant område samt kunskap och erfarenhet av arbete med ServiceNow som ärendehanteringsverktyg samt arbete enligt ITIL.
   

  

 Även erfarenhet av felsökning i IT-miljöer, erfarenhet av Active Directory – kontohantering och grupphantering och kunskap och/eller erfarenhet av godkännanden ur säkerhetssynpunkt är meriterande.
   

  

 Så är även kunskap och/eller erfarenhet av totalförsvarsgemensamma säkerhetslösningar och signalskyddssystem med tillhörande signalskyddsutbildning samt kunskap och/eller erfarenhet av skydd mot röjande signaler meriterande. Till sist ses även informationssäkerhetsarbete som meriterande.
   

  

 Personliga egenskaper är av stor vikt för oss. Vi välkomnar sökanden med olika bakgrund och erfarenheter och söker dig som är är noggran och håller hög kvalitet i det arbete du gör. Dessutom har ett tillmötesgående sätt och en vilja och förmåga att hjälpa. Din kommunikativa och tydliga förmåga är till stor hjälp i ditt arbete då du samarbetar med många olika kollegor. Därtill kommer ditt strukturerade sätt och förmåga att planera och organisera till god användning.
   

  

**FMV – Försvarets materielverk**
 På FMV är du med och bidrar till att göra Sverige och världen säkrare. Vi har i uppdrag att förse det svenska försvaret med den senaste tekniken och kunskapen så att de kan försvara vårt land och våra allierade. Tillsammans med kompetenta och engagerade kollegor får du vara med och utveckla och upphandla det som ibland inte existerar än. Du driver utvecklingen, hela vägen från behov till leverans. Från idé till verklighet.
   

  

 Du kommer att arbeta på infrastrukturstaben som ansvarar för IT-verksamhet, informationsförvaltning och fastighetsförvaltning som möjliggör ett effektivt och säkert arbete.
   

  

 Hos FMV erbjuds du en trygg anställning med bra förmåner:
   

  

* Kompetensutveckling och karriärmöjligheter
* Flexibel arbetstid och möjlighet till distansarbete i den mån arbetet tillåter
* Tjänstepension och friskvårdsbidrag


 Läs mer om FMV som arbetsgivare och om de förmåner vi erbjuder på vår hemsida: Arbeta på FMV.
   

  

 Vill du vara med och utveckla framtidens försvar? Välkommen med din ansökan senast den 28 sept 2026
 *.*
**Bra att veta**
* Du ansöker genom att bifoga ditt CV, betyg och intyg på svenska.
* I ditt CV beskriver du tydligt på vilket sätt du uppfyller efterfrågade kvalifikationer och meriter. För att skapa en mer inkluderande rekryteringsprocess ber vi dig att inte skicka personligt brev eller inkludera bild i ditt CV.
* Vi rekryterar kompetensbaserat och bedömer kandidater utifrån rollens krav på erfarenhet, kunskap och personliga egenskaper.
* Våra fackliga företrädare är SACO Stefan Hållander, OFR/S Madeleine Lithander, OFR/O Lars Carlsson och SEKO Peter Andersson. Alla nås via FMV:s växel: 08-782 4000.
* Vid frågor om tjänsten kan du kontakta Peter Svahn via FMV:s växel: 08-782 4000. Kontakta Oscar Nordström, oscar.nordstrom@fmv.se vid frågor om rekryteringsprocessen.


 För att jobba hos oss behöver du vara svensk medborgare och genomgå en säkerhetsprövning i enlighet med säkerhetsskyddslagen. Vi tillämpar provanställning och som anställd kommer du att krigsplaceras utifrån totalförsvarets behov. Ansökningar till befattningen tas endast emot via FMV:s webbplats eller registratur. Vi har gjort vårt medieval och undanber oss därför försäljning av annons- och rekryteringstjänster.

title: Studentmedarbetare inom AML/Fraud sökes!
description:
*Studerar du och söker ett flexibelt extrajobb där du får värdefull erfarenhet inom bank och bedrägeribekämpning? I rollen får du arbeta med kundkontakt och administration, samtidigt som du får möjlighet att utvecklas inom fraud-monitorering och kombinera jobbet med dina studier.* 




  





**Om tjänsten** 




 Perido söker efter studentmedarbetare inom AML/Fraud till en av våra kunder, en bank med placering i Stockholm. Tjänstens omfattning är cirka 15–20 timmar per vecka, med en förväntan om i genomsnitt två arbetspass per vecka. Under sommaren behöver du även ha möjlighet att arbeta heltid under cirka 6–7 veckor, samt arbeta heltid i större omfattning under perioden kring jul och nyår. Arbetstiderna kan vara förlagda till både dagar, kvällar, helger och röda dagar.
 



  





**Dina arbetsuppgifter** 




 I rollen kommer du till en början kommer du att arbeta med telefon och back office, med möjlighet att på sikt utvecklas mot mer proaktiv fraud-monitorering.
 



  





**Telefon och Back Office** 



* Ta emot samtal från kunder som har drabbats av bedrägerier eller upptäckt misstänkta transaktioner. Du hjälper bland annat till med att spärra kort, ge kunderna stöd i en stressande situation och starta reklamationsärenden.
* Inom back office arbetar du med administrationen kring ärendena. Det innebär exempelvis att samla in och registrera underlag som polisanmälningar och kvitton, dokumentera information i bankens system samt förbereda material inför vidare utredning.



  





**Fraud-monitorering** 




 När du har blivit trygg i systemen och självständig i arbetet finns möjlighet att utvecklas mot fraud-monitorering. Då arbetar du mer proaktivt med att identifiera och hantera misstänkta transaktioner.
 


* Du övervakar transaktionsflöden i realtid via bankens säkerhetssystem, där automatiska larm signalerar avvikande beteenden. Det kan exempelvis handla om att ett kort plötsligt används i flera olika länder under samma dag.
* Du analyserar därefter larmen, bedömer om det kan röra sig om ett faktiskt bedrägeriförsök och vidtar lämplig åtgärd. Det kan innebära att godkänna en transaktion, frysa ett kort eller konto och vid behov kontakta kunden.



  





**Dina egenskaper** 




 Vi söker dig som är snabblärd och självgående och som trivs med att arbeta fokuserat och effektivt. Du är prestigelös, ansvarstagande och noggrann i ditt arbete, med ett analytiskt och proaktivt förhållningssätt. Samtidigt är du en lagspelare som gärna samarbetar med andra och bidrar till ett gott arbetsklimat.
 



 Låter detta som en spännande tjänst?
 



 Vi ser fram emot att läsa din ansökan, varmt välkommen med den redan idag!
 



  





**Kvalifikationer:** 



* Pågående studier vid universitet/högskola
* Erfarenhet av kundkontakt
* God systemvana
* Goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska både i tal och skrift



  





**Meriterande:** 



* Erfarenhet inom Fraud/AML



  





**Omfattning och tillträde** 




 Deltid 15-20h/v, konsultuppdrag tillsvidare samt heltid 6-7 veckor under sommaren samt under jul/nyår. Start omgående.
 



  





**Vi hjälper dig till nästa steg i yrkeslivet** 




 Vår vision är att alla ska trivas och vara engagerade på jobbet. Hos oss finns en stor variation av uppdrag, där du kan bli anställd direkt hos ett företag eller arbeta som konsult via Perido. Vi är ett av Sveriges största konsultföretag för tjänstemän, vilket ger dig många möjligheter. Som konsult blir du en viktig del av vår organisation och bidrar med din kompetens ute hos våra kunder. Läs mer om oss på Perido:
 
 https://perido.se/om-oss/
 




 De flesta frågor eller funderingar kan du hitta svar på under
 
 perido.se/vanliga-fragor/
 
 . Om du fortfarande inte hittat svaret du söker är du välkommen att kontakta oss på
 **fraga@perido.se**

title: Säkerhetsstrateg- och samordnare till Södermalms stadsdelsförvaltning
description:
Det här är rollen för dig som vill vara med och stärka Södermalms och Stockholms Stads säkerhetsarbete. Säkerhetsfrågorna är högt prioriterade och har ett starkt fokus hos oss. I denna tjänst får du stora möjligheter att bidra till utvecklingen av säkerhetsfrågorna inom vår stadsdelsförvaltning.
   

  

**Välkommen till oss**
 Som säkerhetsstrateg- och samordnare kommer du tillhöra enheten Trygghet och säkerhet, som är en del av den administrativa avdelningen. Enheten består av 9 medarbetare inklusive rekryterande chef. Tillsammans arbetar vi för att skapa ett tryggare och säkrare Södermalm.
   

  

 Hos oss får du en varierad roll där arbetsdagarna kan se väldigt olika ut. Du kommer att arbeta både långsiktigt och strategiskt med säkerhetsfrågor och samtidigt hantera aktuella frågor och utmaningar som uppstår i verksamheten. Det finns stort utrymme att påverka och utveckla arbetssätt, samtidigt som du arbetar nära engagerade kollegor med olika kompetenser.
   

  

**Vi erbjuder dig**
* goda möjligheter till kompetensutveckling
* flextid samt sommar- och vinterarbetstid
* friskvårdsbidrag och rabatt på stadens idrotts- och motionsanläggningar
* möjlighet att arbeta hemifrån upp till två dagar i veckan när verksamheten tillåter
* en utvecklingsorienterad enhet med kompetenta och generösa kollegor


 Läs mer om våra förmåner här.
   

  

**Din roll**
 Som säkerhetsstrateg- och samordnare har du en bred roll där du arbetar både strategiskt, samordnande och operativt. Du ansvarar för stadsdelsförvaltningens risk- och sårbarhetsanalys (RSA), arbete med kontinuitetsplanering samt deltar i utvecklingen av processer, planer och förvaltningsrutiner för ett systematiskt säkerhetsarbete.
   

  

 En viktig del av rollen är att vara ett stöd till verksamheten i säkerhets- och trygghetsfrågor. Du vägleder och stöttar chefer och medarbetare, genomför säkerhetsbedömningar samt håller utbildningar inom säkerhets- och beredskapsområdet. Vidare planerar och samordnar du förvaltningens krisledningsövningar och ansvarar för trygghetspunkternas upprustning samt omsättning av beredskapsmateriel.
   

  

 I rollen ingår även att representera stadsdelsförvaltningen i olika nätverk och samverkansforum. Du kommer bland annat att ingå i arbetsgruppen mot välfärdsbrottslighet, genomföra seriositetsprövningar samt svara på tjänsteutlåtanden.
   

  

 Tjänsten innebär arbete på kontoret minst tre dagar i veckan.
   

  

**Din kompetens och erfarenhet**
 Vi söker dig som har
   

  

* eftergymnasial utbildning inom säkerhet, krisberedskap eller annan utbildning som arbetsgivaren bedömer som relevant för tjänsten
* erfarenhet inom projektledning eller samordning, exempelvis inom området risk- och sårbarhetsanalys eller motsvarande
* god erfarenhet av att tala inför grupper samt hålla utbildningar och föreläsningar
* mycket goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift.


 Det är meriterande om du har
   

  

* erfarenhet av säkerhetsarbete inom offentlig sektor
* erfarenhet av samverkan med andra myndigheter
* erfarenhet av utredningsarbete.


 För att trivas och lyckas i rollen behöver du vara strukturerad och ha hög integritet. Du har god samarbetsförmåga och ett intresse för att hitta nya arbetssätt och lösningar inom säkerhets- och beredskapsområdet. Eftersom arbetsuppgifterna kan variera och situationer snabbt kan förändras behöver du också vara flexibel och kunna växla mellan olika uppgifter när verksamheten kräver det. Du är kreativ och kan tänka nytt när du ställs inför komplexa eller nya utmaningar, och har förmåga att växla mellan olika perspektiv.
   

  

 Vidare är du prestigelös inför variationen av arbetsuppgifter som rollen innebär och trivs med att vara ett bollplank för kollegor och verksamheten. Du är också van vid att driva längre processer från start till mål och har förmåga att behålla struktur och framdrift över tid.
   

  

**Övrigt**
 I denna rekryteringsprocess kommer arbetspsykologiska tester att genomföras på slutkandidat.
   

  

 Södermalms stadsdelsförvaltning arbetar för att vara en trygg, rättssäker och professionell verksamhet. Som en del av vår rekryteringsprocess kommer vi därför att genomföra bakgrundskontroll i slutskedet av denna rekrytering. Om du blir aktuell för detta får du tydlig information och möjlighet att lämna ditt samtycke innan kontrollen genomförs.

title: Wind Farm System Designer (Junior/Advanced Engineer)
description:
***Can you turn complex data into decisions that shape the future of offshore wind?***
 At Vattenfall, there is a way. A way to accelerate the energy transition through innovation, collaboration and smart decision-making. As a Wind Farm System Designer, you will help define the design and value of some of Europe's largest offshore wind projects, influencing investment decisions worth billions of euros and contributing directly to a more sustainable energy system.
   

  

**Business Area Wind**
 Within Business Area Wind, we develop, build and operate wind farms both onshore and offshore to accelerate the growth of renewable energy. We bring together international expertise, technological innovation and operational excellence to deliver world-class energy projects that support the transition to a more sustainable future.
   

  

 Our System Design team combines engineering, economics, costing, sustainability and data science competencies. Investigating innovative technologies, regulatory framework, cost and price projections, we identify opportunities across Vattenfall's offshore wind portfolio from early stage of wind farm development to repowering.
   

  

**Your role / what will you do?**
 As a Wind Farm System Designer (Junior/Advanced Engineer), you will transform complex technical and economic information into actionable insights that influence product, project and portfolio strategies. Working closely with experts within interdisciplinary teams, you will perform techno-economical assessments to create value while supporting the continued growth of renewable energy.
   

  

**Your Responsibilities Include:**
* Performing techno-economic assessments to evaluate offshore wind farm concepts, quantify key value drivers, and support strategic project and portfolio decisions.
* Developing offshore wind farm designs, balancing energy production, cost, technical feasibility, environmental constraints, and project requirements.
* Driving levelised energy cost and value improvement opportunities by challenging assumptions, exploring innovative concepts, and identifying optimisation potential across projects and products.
* Translating complex technical, economic and market information into clear recommendations through executive level reporting.
* Building data-driven analyses and automation solutions using Python, AI-enabled tools, and modern analytics platforms to improve decision quality and operational efficiency.
* Developing neutral reference cases to evaluate future technologies, enabling stakeholders to make informed decisions based on robust, transparent and unbiased analysis.


**Qualifications**
**Your profile / who are you?**
 You are someone who enjoys tackling complex challenges and finding practical solutions. You take ownership of your work, follow through on commitments, and are always looking for ways to improve how things are done.
   

  

 You thrive in a collaborative environment where different perspectives are valued and where open, honest communication helps build trust and strong relationships. Curious by nature, you are not afraid to challenge assumptions and explore new ideas.
   

  

 Above all, you want your work to have a real impact. You are motivated by contributing to a safe, inclusive workplace and by playing a meaningful role in the energy transition.
   

  

 We believe you'll be successful in this role if you have:
   

  

* A Master's degree in Engineering, Economics, Data Science, Mathematics, Physics or another relevant field. A PhD is considered an advantage.
* Experience within a technical, innovation-driven or cost-engineering environment.
* Strong problem-solving capabilities and the ability to convert complex information into business insights and recommendations.
* An interest in renewable energy and the energy transition. Experience in offshore wind or a related industry is beneficial.
* An interest in Python and applying AI-enabled tools to improve efficiency and support decision-making.
* Excellent communication skills and fluency in written and spoken English.


**It Is Considered An Advantage If You Also Have:**
* Experience from offshore wind, renewable energy, infrastructure, consulting or other capital-intensive industries.
* Knowledge of business cases, modelling, optimisation, portfolio analysis or techno-economic assessments.
* Experience working in project, programme or portfolio environments.
* Knowledge of tools such as Power BI, Excel, database or comparable data and analytics platforms.

 Good remuneration, a challenging and international work environment, and the possibility to work with some of the best in the field. We offer attractive employment conditions and opportunities for personal and professional development.

You apply quickly and easily by answering screening questions and attaching your CV.

 Vattenfall is a European energy company with approximately 21 000 employees. title: Loyalty Program Manager
description:
Are you genuinely passionate by loyalty programs, customer engagement, and the art of turning commercial strategies into real-world results? Join us on our mission to create raving fans by delivering the most rewarding, friction-free loyalty ecosystem in the Nordics - driving innovation both within Strawberry and across the expanding Spenn ecosystem.
   

  





 As our Loyalty Program Manager, you will serve as both architect and driver of our next-generation loyalty ecosystem - connecting strategic vision, behavioral psychology, tech logic, and hotel operations .If you are a strong project leader, a pragmatic doer, and someone who thrives when given full ownership to drive initiatives, take decisions, and make things happen - this is your stage! 
   

  





  




**What you will be doing:**

 In this role, you will lead complex, cross-functional loyalty initiatives from inception to launch, executing new program mechanisms, campaign logic, and member rules across all Nordic markets. You will co-design our long-term loyalty strategy - evaluating market positioning, tier mechanics, and innovative, margin-aware benefits designed to directly drive Member Revenue
 
 and lifetime value. 
   

  

 You will collaborate with our partnership team to design and deliver seamless benefits across the Spenn and Strawberry universe, maximizing value for our members. Serving as the vital bridge between commercial strategy, IT, and hotel operations, you align cross-functional teams to deliver pragmatic execution without over-engineering solutions. 
   




**Who we think you are:**
* You genuinely care about member journeys and reward mechanics, with 5+ years of experience in loyalty strategy or program management.
* Strong grasp of behavioral economics, habit loops, and predictive/AI-driven personalization logic (e.g., Next Best Action, retention nudges) that drive engagement beyond standard points-and-nights logic.
* Proven track record of translating customer behavior, financial metrics, and competitor movements into ROI-focused loyalty mechanics. You thrive when measured primarily on Member Revenue and bottom-line impact.
* You know how to simplify the complex, find smart shortcuts, and move projects from idea to reality quickly.
* You excel at bringing people with you. Whether translating business logic into functional requirements for IT or anchoring changes with hotel managers on-site, you build trust and alignment effortlessly.



**Qualifications:** 



* Background: Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Engineering/Systems, or a related commercial field.
* Professional fluency in English; proficiency in a Scandinavian language is an advantage given local hotel operations.



 Details: 
   

**Reports to:** 
 Therese Mattisson, Head of Loyalty Program & Operations 
   

**Location:** 
 Flexible hybrid workplace policy based in Stockholm/Solna or Oslo
   

**Scope:** 
 Nordic-wide 
   

  





  




**What we can offer you:**
* A flat organization with trust and autonomy in your work. We are rebels that support innovation without imposing strict corporate rules.
* The chance to be part of a passionate team with exceptional colleagues and an inclusive culture that believes every stay should be a story worth telling.
* Plenty of social events including smaller gatherings with your team and huge get-togethers with the whole Strawberry family!
* Great benefits! In addition to our collective agreement, we also offer staff discounts and friends & family rates at our 250+ hotels.



  




**Sounds interesting?**

 If you're ready to embark on this exciting journey with us and challenge the loyalty approach within the Nordics while making a significant impact on our loyalty program, we'd love to hear from you! Interviews will be held on a rolling basis, don’t wait to submit your application! 
   

  





*We are Strawberry. With over 245 hotels, 120 restaurants, 20 spas and more, we create thousands of experiences every day. With urban Comfort Hotel®, warm Quality Hotel™, stylish Clarion Hotel® and cosy Home Hotel and more than 40 unique independent hotels, our guests can pick and choose. Our team of 20,000 passionate individuals from more than 120 countries is what makes us grow! Strawberry is built on our core values: energy, courage and enthusiasm.*

title: Account Executive (Stockholm)
description:

 , an ambitious, international scale-up within FinTech. We help companies make their management reporting faster, better, and more visual. Our headquarters?  Join our team in Stockholm and you’ll have the opportunity to grow and shape the future of Bright Analytics

* With the team you expand the number of incoming leads by setting up targeted sales actions
* You take initiative to find new and creative ways of increasing our brand awareness in the Swedish market

 The benefits of joining this fintech scale-up
   

  

* We are a financially healthy and ISO-certified scale-up with strong international growth ambitions
* We have an open corporate culture with freedom to take initiative
* With internal trainings and on-the-job coaching, we teach you unique skills that you can use in your further career

* You will receive a competitive salary with bonuses
* Friskvårdsbidrag
* Pension Plan
* Insurance (sickness, pension, TGL, TFA)
* 27 vacation days
* Friday after-work drinks, legendary team-buildings, and an annual weekend with the entire BrightAnalytics team


**Join one of the fastest growing- and sustainable Belgian/European fintech companies today and launch your next career chapter!**

title: Partnerships Associate
description:
**About Us**
 Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar.
   

  

 Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes.
   

  

 1,000+ customers across 50+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White & Case, Dentons, and Barclays. We’ve scaled to
 **$100M+ in ARR** 
 , with teams across Europe, North America and APAC, and continue to expand through acquisitions including Qura, Walter AI and Graceview.
   

  

 We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law.
   

  

 Joining Legora means three things.
   

  

* We lean in: ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions.
* We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback.
* We grow together: as a team and with our customers.


 Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts.
   

  

 If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As a Partnerships Associate, you will help build and scale one of Legora’s most important growth channels: strategic partnerships. Your focus will be on developing and activating relationships with key ecosystem partners and industry stakeholders to drive distribution and revenue growth.
   

  

 This is a cross-functional role where you’ll work closely with GTM (sales), Marketing, and Legal Engineering to turn partnerships into tangible outcomes - from activation programs to closed deals.
   

  

 You’ll thrive in this role if you enjoy combining relationship-building with execution, are comfortable with ambiguity, and enjoy turning ideas into structured, repeatable initiatives. The role is well suited for someone who is proactive, commercially minded, and motivated by owning initiatives end-to-end in a fast-moving environment.
   

  

**What makes this role unique:** 
 you’ll work on an untapped growth channel with clear impact from day one, combining hands-on execution, cross-functional collaboration, and global relationship-building with real ownership of outcomes.
   

  

**What You Will Be Doing**
* Identify, evaluate, and secure partnerships across ecosystem partners
* Build and manage partner relationships, ensuring strong engagement and clear goals
* Plan and execute partner initiatives, including pilots, webinars, and joint efforts
* Work across teams to convert partnership opportunities into revenue
* Represent Legora in partner interactions, including events and conferences
* Contribute to improving how we build and scale partnerships


**What You Bring**
* 2+ years of experience in a faced paced and high-performance environment (e.g. scale-up, consulting, or similar)
* Strong execution skills and ability to drive projects with multiple stakeholders
* High ownership and a proactive, solution-oriented mindset
* Excellent communication skills in English (additional languages are a plus)
* Attention to detail with the ability to manage both strategic and operational work
* Curiosity and ability to quickly understand new industries, partners, and customer needs


**What We Offer**
 At Legora, you’ll have the opportunity to build strategic relationships with some of the world’s leading law firms, legal organizations, and technology partners — working on truly impactful problems at the forefront of AI and legal tech.
   

  

 You’ll be part of a fast-scaling, entrepreneurial environment where your ideas matter and your growth is a priority.
   

  

 As an early member of the Partnerships team, your work will be visible, meaningful, and closely connected to both our clients and our product evolution.
   

  

 You’ll collaborate with senior leadership and cross-functional teams, helping shape not just customer outcomes but how we engage and support legal professionals across the globe.
   

  

 We offer a competitive salary, a high-upside equity program, and full support for relocation to our centrally located Stockholm office — designed for focus, energy, and great collaboration.
   

  

**Legora is an Equal Opportunity Employer**
 At Legora, we believe great teams are built on diversity of thought and experience. We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer and committed to creating an inclusive, high-performance culture where everyone can do their best work. We welcome people of all backgrounds and don’t discriminate based on race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

title: Senior projektledare - Infrateknik och tekniska anläggningar
description:
Hem Lediga jobb Senior projektledare - Infrateknik och tekniska anläggningar
   

  

 Projektledare
   

  

 Senior projektledare - Infrateknik och tekniska anläggningar
   

  

 Stockholms kommun
   

  

 Ansök hos arbetsgivaren
   

  

 Arbetsgivare Stockholms kommun
   

  

 Ort Stockholm
   

  

 Omfattning Tillsvidare
   

  

 Erfarenhet 5+ år
   

  

 Lön —
   

  

 Publicerad 2026-09-24
   

  

 Om tjänsten
   

  

 Välkommen till infrateknikenheten
   

  

 Vill du leda tekniska projekt som får Stockholm att fungera – dygnet runt, året om?
   

  

 Infrateknikenheten består av cirka 18 medarbetare som ansvarar för drift, underhåll och utveckling av tekniska anläggningar i stadens trafik- och ledningstunnlar, öppningsbara broar, rulltrappor, hissar, markvärme, fontäner med mera.
   

  

 En stor del av arbetet handlar om reinvesteringar och modernisering av anläggningarnas tekniska system. Det kan exempelvis vara utbyte av brandlarm, elinstallationer, kamerasystem, belysning och ventilation samt ombyggnad av fontäner och utbyte av hissar och rulltrappor.
   

  

 Vi deltar också i större samverkans- och utvecklingsprojekt, exempelvis ombyggnaden av Liljeholmsbron, förlängningen av Blekholmstunneln och införande av fjärrstyrning i dammanläggningar.
   

  

 Som projektledare får du arbeta med tekniska system där hög tillgänglighet, säkerhet och driftsäkerhet är avgörande för att Stockholm ska fungera. Det är ett uppdrag med tydlig samhällsnytta och stor teknisk variation.
   

  

 Vi erbjuder
   

  

 Spännande och samhällsviktiga tekniska projekt i en av Sveriges mest komplexa stadsmiljöer. Du får möjlighet att följa projekt från tidiga utredningar och förstudier till projektering, upphandling, genomförande och överlämning. Som senior projektledare har du möjlighet att utvecklas genom delaktighet i stora projekt som exempelvis Hagastaden och Slussen.
   

  

 Trafikkontoret är en trygg arbetsplats där vi hjälper och stöttar varandra i det vardagliga arbetet och värnar om den goda arbetsmiljön. Vi har flexibla arbetstider samt möjlighet till växling av semesterdagsstillägg mot extra ledighet. Beroende på arbetsuppgifter och verksamhetsbehovet finns möjlighet att varva kontorsarbete med att arbeta hemifrån ett par dagar i veckan.
   

  

 Arbetsmiljö och hälsa är viktigt för oss. Vi erbjuder friskvårdsersättning, friskvårdstimme och möjlighet att delta i friskvårdsaktiviteter.
   

  

 Arbetsplatsen är centralt belägen i Teknisk nämndhuset på Fleminggatan 4 eller ute på det projekt du arbetar med. Stockholms stad som arbetsgivare: Stockholms stad: Stadsutveckling. Att jobba i Stockholms stad och se gärna den här kortfilmen om vår verksamhet - Trafikkontoret film och läs mer om Trafikkontoret.Stadens förmåner.
   

  

 Din roll
   

  

 Som senior projektledare driver du tekniska projekt inom infrateknikens område och ansvarar för att projekten genomförs inom beslutade ramar och i linje med stadens mål. Du arbetar genom projektens planerings-, projekterings- och genomförandefaser och behöver kunna växla mellan tekniska detaljer, ekonomi och ett strategiskt helhetsperspektiv.
   

  

 Du ansvarar för att skapa framdrift i komplexa projekt där många interna och externa aktörer behöver samverka. I rollen ingår ansvar för projektets tid, ekonomi, kvalitet, riskhantering och uppföljning samt för att rätt kompetens och resurser finns på plats.
   

  

 Projektportfölj och samordning

Du samordnar projekt internt och externt, identifierar beroenden och resursbehov och bidrar till att rätt kompetenser och resurser tillsätts i rätt skede. Du får därmed både ett operativt ansvar för egna projekt och ett helhetsperspektiv på enhetens samlade projektverksamhet.
   

  

 Exempel på arbetsuppgifter
   

  

 Genomföra utredningar och förstudier i tidiga skeden.
   

  

 Ta fram projektplaner, tidplaner, budgetunderlag och förslag till resurs- och kompetenssättning.
   

  

 Leda projektering och genomförande av tekniska investerings- och reinvesteringsprojekt.
   

  

 Avropa tjänster via ramavtal och medverka i upphandling av projektörer, projektledare och entreprenader enligt LOU.
   

  

 Följa upp tid, ekonomi, kvalitet, risker och leveranser samt hantera avvikelser och ändringar.
   

  

 Förhandla, upprätta och följa upp konsult- och entreprenadavtal.
   

  

 Samordna interna och externa aktörer och säkerställa framdrift i komplexa projekt.
   

  

 Vara Trafikkontorets representant i samverkansprojekt med exempelvis exploateringskontoret och andra interna eller externa aktörer.
   

  

 Din kompetens och erfarenhet
   

  

 För att lyckas i rollen som Senior projektledare krävs det att du har:
   

  

 Civilingenjör/högskoleingenjör inom exempelvis el, automation eller industriteknik, alternativt motsvarande erfarenhet som vi bedömer likvärdig.
   

  

 Flerårig och aktuell erfarenhet av att självständigt driva komplexa tekniska projekt som senior projektledare, projektansvarig eller motsvarande roll inom infrastruktur, anläggning, industri eller annan komplex teknisk verksamhet.
   

  

 Erfarenhet av resultat-, budget- och uppföljningsansvar i projekt.
   

  

 God kunskap om entreprenadjuridik och branschens regelverk, exempelvis AMA, MER, AB/ABT och ABK, samt erfarenhet av att tillämpa regelverket i praktiken.
   

  

 God förmåga att uttrycka dig på svenska i tal och skrift.
   

  

 B-körkort.
   

  

 Det är meriterande om även du har
   

  

 Erfarenhet av tekniska system inom tunnlar, broar, trafikmiljöer eller annan samhällskritisk infrastruktur.
   

  

 Erfarenhet inom el, automation, styr- och övervakningssystem, brand- och säkerhetssystem, ventilation eller andra tekniska installationer.

 Som person är du trygg i att fatta beslut och driva frågor framåt även när förutsättningarna förändras. Du skapar struktur i komplexa projekt, är tydlig i din kommunikation och har lätt för att bygga och bibehålla goda relationer.
   

  

 Du kan växla mellan tekniska detaljer och ett övergripande perspektiv och ser samband mellan teknik, ekonomi, tid, risk och verksamhetsnytta. Du är lösningsorienterad och får framdrift genom samverkan, samtidigt som du kan ställa krav när situationen kräver det.

title: VP, Portfolio Strategy
description:
Sinch’s vision is to connect every business with every customer, everywhere in the world. More than 200,000 businesses — including Google, Uber, Paypal, Visa, Tinder, and many others — rely on Sinch’s Customer Communications Cloud to power engaging customer experiences through mobile messaging, voice, and email.
 



  





 Whether you need to verify users or craft omnichannel campaigns, Sinch makes it easy. Our AI-infused Super Network, APIs, and applications ensure you can connect with your customers reliably and securely, at every step of their journey.
 



  





 At Sinch we “Dream Big”, “Win Together”, “Keep it simple”, and “Make it Happen”. These values are our foundation!
 



  





**Description** 




 The VP, Portfolio Strategy shapes the strategy and future direction for a focused set of cross-product themes within Sinch’s Product organization. These are the highest-leverage opportunities that span Messaging, Voice, Email, and Applications, and that shape how customers experience Sinch as a single platform.
 



  





 This is a senior product leadership role focused on portfolio direction, cross-product alignment, and clear ownership of a small number of strategic themes. You will help define and advance priorities such as end-to-end customer journeys, developer and agent experiences, Product-led Growth, ecosystems, integrations, partnerships, AI-native and agentic adoption, and selective channel evolution opportunities such as conversational messaging. Your work will translate ambiguous portfolio themes into clear decisions, success measures, ownership models, and measurable outcomes across products, regions, and functions.
 



  





 You will sit alongside our product area leaders, partner closely with regional and GTM leadership, and act as a senior product partner to the Chief Product Officer. The role is built for a leader who is strongest at setting direction, aligning senior stakeholders, clarifying ownership, and making cross-product outcomes legible and measurable.
 



  





**Key responsibilities** 



* Shape and rank the product strategy and future direction for a focused set of portfolio-level, cross-product themes that disproportionately matter to Sinch’s growth, working with the Chief Product Officer to translate them into clear priorities, sequencing, ownership, and success outcomes.
* Balance investment across the product portfolio, including when and how we allocate resources to big bets, and make the trade-offs and sequencing explicit to product-line and GTM leadership.
* Define and evolve the mission, scope boundaries, and interfaces of Product Areas, so teams can move faster with clear ownership, fewer overlaps, and stronger cross-area collaboration.
* Translate strategy into concrete, decision-ready proposals on end-to-end customer journeys and the developer and agent surfaces that present Sinch as a single portfolio.
* Ensure strategic portfolio priorities translate into measurable business outcomes by defining success measures, decision points, and ownership models, in partnership with Product Operations and Business Operations on sequencing, dependency clarity, adoption tracking, and disciplined follow-through.
* Partner with regional leadership in AMER, EMEA, and APAC to ensure cross-product priorities are understood, sequenced, and adopted in market, with plans tailored to buyer needs, regulatory realities, and regional growth opportunities.
* Act as a senior product partner to the Chief Product Officer on portfolio-level strategy, partnerships, and M&A pattern recognition.
* Shape how cross-product strategy gets translated into action at scale by clarifying decision rights, escalation paths, accountability, and the minimum operating rhythm required to keep strategic priorities moving.



  





 The role is ideally based at SINCH HQ in Stockholm, Sweden.
 



  





**Requirements** 



* 15+ years in product leadership in CPaaS, communications software or enterprise SaaS with experience operating in growth environments, not only operating in established businesses.
* Strong experience with multi-product platforms, ecosystems, integrations, partnerships, developer experiences, or cross-channel customer journeys.
* A track record of landing cross-functional, cross-product outcomes inside a multi-product portfolio.
* Strong product judgment and commercial fluency: you move comfortably between portfolio strategy and GTM motion design, and you understand unit economics and gross profit mechanics, not just revenue.
* Demonstrable stakeholder management and collaboration skills: you build trust with product-line leaders, GTM, regional teams, and partners, and you can implement hard choices once decisions are made.
* A humble, collaborative leadership style: you build trust through inclusion, engagement, and transparency, and you have the courage to challenge assumptions while listening and learning from others.
* A strong outcomes orientation. You are credible because you make the hardest cross-product choices clear, align leaders behind them, and ensure results are measurable and owned.
* Senior executive presence, with the ability to operate credibly at C-suite, board, customer, and partner executive level.
* Comfort operating with ambiguity, delegated authority, and an explicit obligation to make a small number of cross-product outcomes legible, measurable, and accountable inside a product-line-led organization.



  





**Our hiring process** 




 We are committed to ensuring a recruitment process that is fair, objective, consistent, and inclusive. Our approach includes structured, competency-based interviews designed to evaluate your skills, experience, and qualifications relevant to the role. At times, we may include a data-driven assessment to enhance our hiring success and identify candidates likely to excel.
 



  





 We believe in a two-way process and encourage you to ask questions throughout the journey. If this role isn't what you're looking for, please explore the other opportunities listed on our career page: https://www.sinch.com/careers/. No matter who you are, we hope you find an exciting path forward - hopefully with us!
 



  





**Salary:** 




 The annual salary for this position is between SEK 1.300.000 – 1.600.000. This role is eligible for bonus. Factors which may affect pay within this range may include skills, education, experience, and other qualifications.
