title: Account Director – Nordics
description:
**Job title: Account Director – Nordics**

**Location: Stockholm, SWE (hybrid, 3 days in office)**

 **Who We Are**


At Tricentis, we’re redefining what’s possible in software testing and quality engineering. Our AI-driven, codeless, and continuous testing platform empowers enterprises to accelerate innovation, deliver higher-quality releases, and transform digital velocity at scale.

  

Recognized as a global leader by Gartner, Forrester, and IDC, Tricentis partners with the world’s largest and most innovative companies. We’re a team of curious learners, ambitious achievers, and collaborative competitors who believe in constant growth—both for our customers and ourselves.


If you’re motivated by challenge, feedback, and the pursuit of excellence, you’ll thrive here.

 **About the Role**


We’re looking for an accomplished and strategic Account Director to join the Tricentis Enterprise Sales team in Stockholm supporting the Nordic region. This role owns the growth and expansion of strategic enterprise accounts, leading complex sales cycles and building trusted relationships with senior executives to connect Tricentis’ testing and automation solutions to meaningful business outcomes.

  

Success requires enterprise SaaS sales expertise, rigorous forecasting and pipeline management, and the ability to influence C-suite and senior IT stakeholders. This is an opportunity to shape account strategy, create long-term customer value, and deliver measurable revenue impact in a complex enterprise environment.

 **What You’ll Do**

* Own and expand strategic enterprise accounts by identifying new opportunities, shaping account strategy, building executive relationships, and closing complex, multi-stakeholder deals.
* Develop a deep understanding of the Tricentis platform and translate technical capabilities into clear business value for enterprise customers.
* Engage C-level and senior IT decision-makers to understand strategic priorities, quantify business challenges, and align solutions to transformation goals.
* Drive disciplined pipeline management and accurate forecasting, creating visibility into deal progress, risks, and the actions required to achieve revenue goals.
* Partner with Pre-Sales, Customer Growth, Marketing, and other stakeholders to deliver coordinated account plans, increase customer value, and support long-term success.

 **Qualifications**

 **Must Have:**

A consistent record of achieving or exceeding revenue goals and closing six-figure transactions, including deals above $500K ACV.  
* 

  

**Nice to Have:**

* Knowledge of and/or experience with Tricentis products
Knowledge of Tricentis products or comparable enterprise software platforms.  
* 

  

Experience in software quality, testing, automation, DevOps, or another relevant technical domain.  



  

**Skills You Bring**

* Executive influence and value selling: Ability to engage senior IT leaders, uncover business drivers, and connect technical solutions to strategic and financial outcomes.
* Business and technical translation: Ability to turn complex customer challenges into quantified business impact and position Tricentis solutions against measurable outcomes.
* Complex deal execution: Demonstrated use of structured sales methodologies such as MEDDPICC and value-based selling to navigate multi-stakeholder decisions.
* Cross-functional execution: Experience working with Pre-Sales, Customer Growth, Marketing, and peers to strengthen account strategy and customer outcomes.
* Sales technology fluency: Practical experience with CRM, forecasting, sales enablement, and AI tools, such as Salesforce, Clari, Outreach, or comparable platforms.

  



**Who You Are**

* Coachable: You actively seek feedback, apply new learning, and refine your approach based on evidence and customer insight.
* Resilient: You maintain focus through long, complex sales cycles, adapt when conditions change, and turn setbacks into informed next steps.
* Driven for Results: You set ambitious goals, take ownership of outcomes, and combine strategic thinking with disciplined execution.
* Resourceful: You find practical ways through ambiguity and constraints while keeping account strategy, customer value, and scale in view.

**Tricentis Core Values:**


At Tricentis, we strive for success while inspiring those around us by knowing what we need to achieve and how we’ll achieve it. Our core values serve as our guiding light to drive our every action and define our ways of working so that we can create and enjoy a successful journey and reach higher heights together.

* Serve Our Customers & Communities: Create a positive experience with each interaction.

Tricentis is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, ethnicity, gender, religious affiliation, age, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or physical and mental disability and other statuses protected by law.  

  

**Global Sanctions Compliance**

title: Localization Program Manager
description:
**Position Overview**


We are seeking an experienced and technically minded **Localization Program Manager (LPM)** to design, establish, and scale an end-to-end global localization operation.


In this role, you will own the operational framework, TMS architecture, vendor execution, and cross-functional alignment necessary to launch new international markets seamlessly. You will serve as the primary bridge between Product, Engineering, Design, Legal/Compliance, and external linguistic partners, ensuring the product and content scale globally without increasing operational drag or costs.

  

The ideal candidate possesses deep hands-on expertise with **CrowdIn Enterprise**, direct experience configuring continuous localization (CI/CD) pipelines, and a strong background in defining governance models, SLAs, and terminology strategies in fast-moving product environments.

 **Key Responsibilities**

* **Program Strategy & Governance**
* Establish the overarching localization operating model, including program intake, prioritization frameworks, RACI matrices, SLAs, and escalation pathways.
* Define and track key program performance indicators (KPIs) covering turnaround times, quality scores, cost efficiency, and release gate readiness.
* Author and maintain reusable market-launch playbooks to streamline entry into subsequent target regions post-launch.

**2. Technical Infrastructure & CrowdIn Operations**

* Own the setup, project architecture, permission levels, and configuration of **CrowdIn** / **CrowdIn Enterprise**.
* Partner with Solutions Architects, Localization Engineers, and DevOps to configure file parsers, API endpoints, webhooks, and direct repository/CI-CD integrations (e.g., GitHub, GitLab, Figma).
* Set up automated QA rules, pre-translation workflows, pseudo-localization testing, and machine translation (MT) engine integrations within CrowdIn.

**3. Linguistic & Asset Management**

* Oversee the lifecycle of core linguistic assets, including translation memories (TM), glossaries, style guides, and terminology databases.
* Partner with Linguistic Leads and product teams to enforce internationalization (i18n) standards and string-externalization best practices.
* Coordinate in-context reviews (LQA), functional testing, and sign-offs for regulated or domain-specific content (e.g., fintech, legal, compliance).

**4. Cross-Functional Alignment & Vendor Management**

* Collaborate with Product Managers, Content Strategists, Design Leads, and Engineering to build localization into the core software delivery lifecycle.
* Build, negotiate, and manage direct external vendor models, agency partnerships, and direct freelance linguist networks.
* Drive hypercare support during new market launches, monitoring release readiness and resolving technical or linguistic bottlenecks in real time.

 **Required Qualifications**

* **Experience:** 6+ years of dedicated experience in Localization Program Management, Internationalization (i18n), or Localization Operations within a technology or fintech environment.
* **CrowdIn Mastery:** Proven, hands-on experience setting up, maintaining, and optimizing project structures, workflows, and integrations in **CrowdIn** or **CrowdIn Enterprise**.
* Experience working within **Fintech**, **Regulated Industries**, or complex compliance environments.
* **Technical Aptitude:** Strong understanding of software development lifecycles (Agile/Scrum), string-based workflows, CI/CD continuous delivery models, and common file formats (JSON, YAML, XLIFF, Android XML, PO).
* **Vendor & Budget Oversight:** Demonstrated track record of establishing vendor SLAs, negotiating direct contractor or agency rates, and managing localization budgets.
* **Cross-Functional Leadership:** Ability to drive alignment across cross-functional partners (Product, Engineering, Design, Legal) without direct authority.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Proficiency with design-to-localization workflows (e.g., CrowdIn plugin for Figma).
* Familiarity with scripting/automation concepts (REST APIs, Python, JavaScript, Bash) or working directly with Localization Engineers.
* Working proficiency or fluency in French or other key target languages is a plus.

title: Security Engineer
description:
Sinch is pioneering the way the world communicates. More than 200,000 businesses — including Google, Uber, Paypal, Visa, Tinder, and many others — rely on Sinch’s Customer Communications Cloud to power engaging customer experiences through mobile messaging, voice, and email.


Whether you need to verify users or craft omnichannel campaigns, Sinch makes it easy. Our AI-infused Super Network, APIs, and applications ensure you can connect with your customers reliably and securely, at every step of their journey.


At Sinch we “Dream Big”, “Win Together”, “Keep it simple”, and “Make it Happen”. These values are our foundation!


**DESCRIPTION**

As a Security Engineer at Sinch, you will help safeguard our cloud and on-premise environments as an integral member of our global security team. Your focus will be on identifying potential risks, conducting vulnerability assessments, and supporting the security of our infrastructure. You will handle routine security evaluations independently while collaborating with and learning from senior engineers on more complex projects.


* Conduct vulnerability assessments and security testing across our products and systems.
* Proactively monitor and manage the attack surface across assigned environments, recommending and implementing mitigation strategies.
* Contribute to the implementation and maintenance of robust cloud hardening standards to continuously improve our security posture.
* Evaluate, deploy, and manage security tools, providing recommendations for improvements.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate security measures into DevOps processes and contribute to secure design best practices.
* Design and implement automation for security processes to improve efficiency and reduce manual intervention.
* Participate in architectural reviews to ensure security is deeply embedded in all new infrastructure initiatives.
* Analyze emerging security threats and sharing insights and mitigation proposals with senior engineers.

This is a hybrid role based in Sweden, with Kalmar as the preferred location and Stockholm being an option.


**REQUIREMENTS**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
* Hands-on industry experience in security engineering or a similar role.
* Proficiency in security tools and technologies.
* Pragmatic and analytical to problem-solving, clear communication, and good organizational skills.
* Preferred Certifications: CISSP, CCSP, AWS Certified Security - Specialty.

Our corporate language is English, please submit your application in **English** .


Must currently reside in and be eligible for employment in Sweden. Relocation and visa sponsorship are not available for this role.


**OUR HIRING PROCESS**

We are committed to ensuring a recruitment process that is fair, objective, consistent, and inclusive. Our approach includes structured, competency-based interviews designed to evaluate your skills, experience, and qualifications relevant to the role. At times, we may include a data-driven assessment to enhance our hiring success and identify candidates likely to excel.


We believe in a two-way process and encourage you to ask questions throughout the journey. If this role isn't what you're looking for, please explore the other opportunities listed on our career page: https://www.sinch.com/careers/. No matter who you are, we hope you find an exciting path forward - hopefully with us!


**Salary** :


The monthly salary for this position is between 35 000 to 50 000 SEK. Factors which may affect pay within this range may include skills, education, experience, and other qualifications.

title: Kravanalytiker
description:
Vi söker en erfaren kravanalytiker som vill vara med och utveckla digitala lösningar i en agil miljö. Du får en central roll i att omvandla verksamhetens behov, regelverk och tekniska förutsättningar till tydliga, prioriterade och testbara krav.
  
Du kommer att arbeta nära produktägare, utvecklare, arkitekter, verksamhet, juridik och informationssäkerhet. Rollen kombinerar kravanalys med test och innebär bland annat att arbeta med epics, features, user stories och acceptanskriterier samt att bidra till testfall och testgenomförande.
  
  

**Vi söker dig som har:**  

Minst 5 års erfarenhet av kravanalys, Business Analysis eller motsvarande.
  
Minst 3 års erfarenhet av kravarbete i agila utvecklingsteam.
  
Erfarenhet av att formulera user stories, funktionella och icke-funktionella krav samt testbara acceptanskriterier.
  
Praktisk erfarenhet av testarbete och exempelbaserad kravställning/BDD.
  
Erfarenhet av krav kopplade till exempelvis informationssäkerhet, behörighet, loggning, integrationer, prestanda och dataskydd.
  
Erfarenhet från komplexa IT-miljöer med flera system och integrationer.
  
Vana av verktyg som Jira, Confluence, Azure DevOps eller motsvarande.
  
Mycket god svenska i tal och skrift.
  
  

Som person är du strukturerad, analytisk och kommunikativ. Du trivs med att driva ditt arbete självständigt och har lätt för att skapa samsyn mellan verksamhet och tekniska team.

description:

Vill du utveckla dataprodukter som gör fordonsdata tillgänglig, tillförlitlig och användbar? I den här rollen arbetar du i en internationell fordonsnära teknikmiljö med data för analys, rapportering och ML/AI.
  
Du blir en viktig del av ett team som bygger och förvaltar molnbaserade datatjänster för interna användare och externa affärstillämpningar.

Utveckla och förvalta dataprodukter för fordonsdata.

Designa, utveckla och underhålla batch- och streamingpipelines.
  
Bygga arbetsflöden för datarensning, transformation och modellering.
  
Övervaka prestanda, datakvalitet och systemhälsa samt felsöka incidenter.

Goda kunskaper i SQL och praktisk erfarenhet av Python eller annat programmeringsspråk.
  
Erfarenhet av produktionsnära drift, testning, övervakning och felsökning.
  
Förståelse för dataåtkomst, säkerhet, integritet och regelefterlevnad.

title: Project Manager Internal & External Logistics
description:
Join us in shaping the future of logistics at Nobia Park!
  
At Nobia Park, we're building one of Europe's most modern manufacturing environments. Our new factory combines advanced automation, digitalization, and lean operations to create a highly efficient and future-focused production setup.
  
We are now looking for a Project Manager Internal & External Logistics to play a key role in developing and optimizing logistics processes across our manufacturing and supply chain operations. This is a unique opportunity to join a large-scale transformation journey where technology, processes, and people come together to create the factory of the future.
  
Where we are right now
  
Nobia Park is continuing its journey toward becoming a highly integrated and digitally enabled manufacturing environment. As operations evolve and new capabilities are introduced, logistics plays a critical role in ensuring efficient material flow from inbound deliveries through production to outbound distribution.
  
In this role, you will help develop and optimize internal logistics operations, including warehousing and picking, as well as external logistics processes such as consolidation and distribution. Working closely with operations, supply chain, and IT, you will contribute to both continuous improvements and long-term development initiatives.
  
About the role
  
As Project Manager Internal & External Logistics, you will drive logistics-related projects and process development within our MES (2020 insight) and on occasions SAP/4HANA. Acting as the link between business operations and system development, you will ensure that business needs are translated into efficient and scalable logistics solutions.
  
The role combines project management, process development, stakeholder collaboration, and continuous improvement in a dynamic manufacturing environment.
  
Your responsibilities
  
  

Translate business needs into effective solutions within MES and SAP systems.
  
  

Work closely with production teams to develop and implement efficient logistics flows.
  
  

Lead and participate in cross-functional workshops to improve processes and ways of working.
  
  

Provide second- and third-line support, working closely with support teams to troubleshoot issues and drive resolution.
  
  

Drive change initiatives and help ensure new processes are successfully adopted across the organization.
  
  

Contribute to the development of future system and process landscapes within logistics and supply chain
  
  

Manage, coach, and support one direct report, ensuring clear priorities, development, and engagement.
  
  

**Location:** Nobia Park, Jönköping, this is an onsite position
  
Who you are
  
To succeed in this role, you are a structured and collaborative professional who enjoys working at the intersection of business processes, technology, and operations. You are comfortable navigating complex stakeholder environments and can balance strategic thinking, project delivery, and day-to-day operational support.
  
You enjoy solving problems, making improvements, and creating solutions that have a real impact on business performance. You build strong relationships and communicate effectively with stakeholders across different functions and levels of the organization. Most importantly, you are motivated by being part of a transformation journey where you can influence the future design and development of logistics processes.
  
We believe you bring
  
  

At least two years' experience within Logistics, Supply Chain, or Manufacturing environments.
  
  

Understanding of logistics processes such as warehousing, material flow, picking, transportation, and distribution
  
  

Experience with process design, system configuration, or solution development within manufacturing or supply chain environments.
  
  

Experience working with SAP S/4HANA, preferably within Transport Management (TM), Warehouse Logistics, or related manufacturing systems.
  
  

Experience leading projects, process improvements, or business development initiatives
  
  

The ability to bridge business requirements and technical solutions
  
  

Experience leading teams or coordinating cross-functional initiatives.
  
  

Fluent in both Swedish and English.
  
  

It is highly desirable if you have experience with Azure DevOps
  
About Nobia
  
Nobia is Europe’s leading kitchen specialist, with strong brands such as Marbodal, HTH, Sigdal, and uno form. With us, you will become part of a modern organization where quality, safety, and continuous improvement are at the core of everything we do. We offer excellent opportunities for both professional and personal development. Curious to learn more? Visit Nobia Park – Jönköping. 
  
Want to be a part of our journey?
  
Then we would like to receive your application in English no later than October 18, 2026. We review applications on an ongoing basis, and the position may be filled before the application deadline. Our recruitment process is competency-based and includes assessments to provide both you and us with the best possible conditions for a successful match. As part of the employment process, you will need to demonstrate your right to work within the EU, for example through a passport or a valid work permit. Background checks and drug screening will be conducted as part of the recruitment process.
  
If you have any questions, please contact Talent Acquisition Specialist Josephine Tjernlund (josephine.tjernlund@nobia.com). We look forward to receiving your application!

title: Product Owner IAM
description:
Be part of Clavister's journey to secure the digital world. We are looking for a Product Owner with the leadership, product thinking and technical judgement to lead a cross-functional Java team responsible for authentication, identity management and digital signing products.
  
Working closely with the Product Manager, you will contribute to the vision and roadmap for our IAM portfolio, own the backlog and guide delivery across Product, Engineering, Architecture and Security.
  
  

About Clavister Clavister is a European cybersecurity company founded in 1997 and headquartered in Örnsköldsvik. We develop solutions across network security, identity and access management, cloud security, machine learning and AI for customers in the public sector, critical infrastructure, defence and telecommunications. With our partners and distributors, our hardware and software are deployed in more than 100 countries.
  
  

The role This role combines product ownership, people leadership and engineering delivery. Creating focus, developing people and building an effective team are more important than being an IAM specialist.
  
You should be comfortable in the IAM domain and able to discuss Java or a comparable enterprise backend ecosystem, architecture, integrations, quality and engineering trade-offs. The portfolio includes established on-premises products with multiple supported versions and SaaS offerings, requiring sound judgement when balancing development and technical debt.
  
  

Key responsibilities
  
  

Lead and develop a cross-functional Java team, with responsibility for people leadership, competence development, team effectiveness and delivery practices, including feedback and professional development.
  
  

Contribute customer, delivery and team perspectives to the Product Manager's vision and roadmap.
  
  

Own and prioritise the backlog based on product direction, customer needs, security requirements and capacity.
  
  

Translate roadmap objectives into clear outcomes, requirements and acceptance criteria.
  
  

Collaborate with engineers, architects and IAM specialists on system design, APIs, integrations and architecture.
  
  

Balance new capabilities and technical debt with cybersecurity, privacy, quality, usability, scalability and maintainability.
  
  

Drive delivery from refinement and planning through development, automated testing and operational follow-up.
  
  

Promote modern engineering practices, including CI/CD, DevOps, observability, code review and test automation.
  
  

Recruit, coach and mentor team members and foster trust, learning and knowledge sharing.
  
  

Coordinate dependencies, risks and expectations across Product, Technology, Architecture, Security and other stakeholders.
  
  

What success looks like in this role
  
The team has clear priorities and ownership, delivers secure and maintainable products with predictable quality and flow, and grows through collaborative decision-making and a healthy engineering culture.
  
  

To thrive in this role we believe you have
  
  

Experience leading and developing commercial software product teams, with focus on people, performance, collaboration and delivery.
  
  

Experience with product ownership, backlog management and agile software delivery.
  
  

A hands-on background in software engineering or architecture and enough technical understanding to engage confidently with Java developers and architects.
  
  

Experience with Java or a comparable enterprise backend ecosystem.
  
  

Experience collaborating with Product Managers and stakeholders on product discovery, priorities, vision and roadmap.
  
  

Comfort working in IAM and curiosity to learn authentication, identity and signing concepts.
  
  

Knowledge of secure software development, privacy and vulnerability management.
  
  

Strong communication, coaching, stakeholder management, problem-solving and change leadership skills.
  
  

Fluent English, both written and spoken.
  
  

Extra points for
  
  

Experience in IAM, authentication, digital identity or electronic signing.
  
  

Familiarity with IAM integrations, APIs, federation, identity lifecycle processes or trust services.
  
  

Experience as a Scrum Master or in a similar agile facilitation role.
  
  

What we offer
  
  

Meaningful work in a European cybersecurity company where IAM is a key part of zero-trust security.
  
  

The opportunity to lead a skilled Java team delivering authentication, identity and signing products.
  
  

A collaborative and inclusive environment across Product, Technology and Security.
  
  

Professional development, training and leadership growth opportunities.
  
  

Flexible working arrangements, a supportive team culture, competitive salary and benefits.
  
  

Join us If you enjoy leading people, creating product clarity and bringing stakeholders together around effective delivery, we would like to hear from you.
  
We review applications and interview qualified candidates continuously.

title: Group Chief Accountant
description:
**Welcome to Eficode!**
  

We’re building the future of software development - driving innovation across Cloud, DevOps, Agile, Service Management, and AI-powered transformation. Our mission is to help organizations evolve into truly software-driven enterprises, empowering them to deliver faster, smarter, and more sustainably. We believe in changing the world by sharing our expertise and enabling teams to work better through modern technology and intelligent automation.


As an Atlassian Platinum Partner, we have been recognized multiple times as Atlassian Partner of the Year, most recently for 2024–25. We are also proud to be a two-time GitHub Partner of the Year in EMEA and an Azure Managed Service Provider. With over 600 experts across 10 countries, we bring together leading talent from the Nordics, continental Europe, the UK, and the Americas.
  

  

**About the Role**
  

We’re looking for an experienced Group Chief Accountant to play a key role in the next stage of our Finance journey.


You’ll take ownership of accounting integrity, financial control and compliance across our international Group, while helping us build a more consistent, scalable and group-led Finance function.


Combining strong technical accounting expertise with people leadership, you’ll have the opportunity to develop our Finance team, improve how we work and help shape the future of Finance at Eficode.
  

  

**Your Key Responsibilities:**


* Own the Group balance sheet and cash flow, ensuring accuracy and strong financial control.
* Lead, coach and develop members of our Finance team.
* Drive consistency and standardisation across Group accounting processes, controls and ways of working.
* Lead key areas of tax, treasury, banking, liquidity, transfer pricing and financial compliance.
* Coordinate external audits and strengthen our internal control environment.
* Support the management of foreign exchange exposure and wider financial risks.
* Play a key role in Finance transformation as we move towards a more scalable, group-led operating model.
* Partner with Finance leadership and stakeholders across our international organisation.

**Success Factors:**


* 10+ years’ experience in accounting, financial control or a similar senior Finance role.
* A professional accounting qualification or equivalent relevant experience.
* Strong technical accounting expertise across balance sheet management, cash flow, tax, audit and internal controls.
* Proven experience leading and developing Finance professionals.
* Experience working in a complex, multi-entity and/or international organisation.
* Experience supporting Finance transformation, process improvement or operating model change.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Fluent English language skills, both written and spoken.

  

**Desired skills and qualifications**
  

It would be an added bonus if you have:


* Experience within a group-led or centralised Finance function.
* Experience supporting post-acquisition integration.
* Knowledge of treasury, banking, liquidity, debt, foreign exchange and transfer pricing.
* Finnish or Swedish language skills would be beneficial.

  

**About you**
  

The type of person we’re looking for is:


* A confident Finance leader who can balance technical detail with the bigger picture.
* A supportive people manager who enjoys developing others and building effective teams.
* Proactive and improvement-focused, with the confidence to challenge existing ways of working.
* Collaborative and pragmatic, with the ability to build relationships across teams and countries.
* Comfortable working in an evolving environment and bringing greater structure, consistency and clarity.

  

**What’s in it for you?**


* Play a key role in our Finance transformation and help shape how we work as we continue to scale.
* Help shape our Finance team culture, develop the team and support the move towards a more consistent, group-led approach.
* Generous paid holiday
* Health insurance & pension scheme
* Learning & development - We have knowledge sharing sessions, team activities, technical and soft skills trainings to all Eficodeans
* Regular social events, lunches and code camps
* A work laptop, phone and necessary work equipment

To find out more about life at Eficode, and hear what our people think about us, click here.

  

  

**Ready to build with us?** Submit your CV to apply! Selected candidates will be invited to an initial screening call with our Talent Acquisition team. We're looking forward to reading from you!

title: Senior Data Platform Engineer
description:
About Us
Creditstar Group is an international fintech company headquartered in Tallinn, Estonia, operating across multiple European markets. We build data-driven financial products and are looking for engineers who want to have a real impact in a fast-moving environment.


Your Role
As a Senior Data Platform Engineer at Creditstar, you will take ownership of the data platform behind our analytics, reporting, and data science across our European markets. Your focus will be to raise it to the next level through solid engineering, clear governance, and standards that scale as the company grows.


Rather than working on isolated deliverables, you will shape the platform, tooling, and practices that let our BI, Analytics, and Data Science teams build on data they can trust. You will work closely with data scientists, analysts, risk, and product teams, and partner with DevOps on the underlying infrastructure. You will have a high degree of autonomy, a wide range of technical problems to solve, and the freedom to make decisions in an environment that expects engineers to lead.

 **What You Will Own**

* + Own and continuously improve Creditstar's data platform on AWS and Snowflake, keeping it reliable, performant, and scalable.
	+ Strengthen platform performance, security, secrets management, and observability across the data stack.
	+ Own platform cost efficiency: track and optimize Snowflake and AWS spend, and lead FinOps practices within the data team.
	+ Advance data governance through clear data ownership, access and PII controls, data lineage, and audit readiness, in line with GDPR and internal policies.
	+ Define and uphold engineering standards for testing, versioning, code reviews, CI/CD, and Git-based workflows across the data team.
	+ Own the integration layer connecting internal and third-party data sources.
	+ Lead the response to data platform incidents, seeing issues through to a durable fix.
	+ Work with the DevOps team on the underlying infrastructure: setting requirements, reviewing their solutions, and making sure platform needs are met.
	+ Support BI Engineers, Analysts, and Data Scientists with a well-governed, well-documented, self-serve platform.

  

**Requirements** **Experience & Expertise**

* + Strong hands-on experience running and improving a cloud data platform on AWS and Snowflake.
	+ A solid grasp of cloud infrastructure, security, and cost management, enough to set requirements and assess solutions alongside DevOps.
	+ Practical experience with data governance, access control, and PII management.
	+ Experience in a regulated setting such as finance, banking, or AML/KYC.

 **Collaboration & Mindset**

* + Strong communication skills and ability to work effectively with technical and business stakeholders.
	+ A dependable, ownership-driven approach: you stay with a problem until it is resolved and does not come back.
	+ Structured working style with the confidence to set standards where none exist yet.
	+ Entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to thrive in a fast-scaling environment.
	+ Fluent in spoken and written English.


Nice to have:* A track record with cloud cost optimization and FinOps practices.
* Familiarity with modern table formats (Apache Iceberg, Delta Lake).
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.

**Our Tech Stack:**

* Cloud: AWS (EC2, EMR, MWAA, RDS, etc.)
* Data Warehouse: Snowflake
* Workflow & Orchestration: Airflow, DBT
* Big Data & Processing: Spark, Docker
* Streaming: Kafka

  

**Benefits**  

* Ownership of a data platform serving millions of customers across Europe.
* Direct influence on data-driven products that reach millions of people.
* Flexible working arrangements and modern office facilities.

title: Project Manager Internal & External Logistics
description:
***Join us in shaping the future of logistics at Nobia Park!***

**At Nobia Park**, we're building one of Europe's most modern manufacturing environments. Our new factory combines advanced automation, digitalization, and lean operations to create a highly efficient and future-focused production setup.


We are now looking for a *Project Manager Internal & External Logistics* to play a key role in developing and optimizing logistics processes across our manufacturing and supply chain operations. This is a unique opportunity to join a large-scale transformation journey where technology, processes, and people come together to create the factory of the future.

**Where we are right now**


Nobia Park is continuing its journey toward becoming a highly integrated and digitally enabled manufacturing environment. As operations evolve and new capabilities are introduced, *logistics plays a critical role* in ensuring efficient material flow from inbound deliveries through production to outbound distribution.

**In this role**, you will help develop and optimize internal logistics operations, including warehousing and picking, as well as external logistics processes such as consolidation and distribution. Working closely with operations, supply chain, and IT, you will contribute to both continuous improvements and long-term development initiatives.

**About the role**


As *Project Manager Internal & External Logistics*, you will drive logistics-related projects and process development within our MES (2020 insight) and on occasions SAP/4HANA. *Acting as the link between business operations and system development,* you will ensure that business needs are translated into efficient and scalable logistics solutions.

*The role combines project management, process development, stakeholder collaboration, and continuous improvement in a dynamic manufacturing environment.*

**Your responsibilities**

* Translate business needs into effective solutions within MES and SAP systems.
* Work closely with production teams to develop and implement efficient logistics flows.
* Lead and participate in cross-functional workshops to improve processes and ways of working.
* Provide second- and third-line support, working closely with support teams to troubleshoot issues and drive resolution.
* Drive change initiatives and help ensure new processes are successfully adopted across the organization.
* Contribute to the development of future system and process landscapes within logistics and supply chain
* Manage, coach, and support one direct report, ensuring clear priorities, development, and engagement.

**Location:** Nobia Park, Jönköping, this is an *onsite* position

**Who you are**


To succeed in this role, you are a structured and collaborative professional who enjoys working at the intersection of business processes, technology, and operations. You are comfortable navigating complex stakeholder environments and can balance strategic thinking, project delivery, and day-to-day operational support.


You enjoy **solving problems**, **making improvements**, and **creating solutions** that have a real impact on business performance. You build strong relationships and communicate effectively with stakeholders across different functions and levels of the organization. Most importantly, you are motivated by being part of a transformation journey where you can influence the future design and development of logistics processes.

**We believe you bring**

* At least two years' experience within Logistics, Supply Chain, or Manufacturing environments.
* Understanding of logistics processes such as warehousing, material flow, picking, transportation, and distribution
* Experience with process design, system configuration, or solution development within manufacturing or supply chain environments.
* Experience working with SAP S/4HANA, preferably within Transport Management (TM), Warehouse Logistics, or related manufacturing systems.
* Experience leading projects, process improvements, or business development initiatives
* The ability to bridge business requirements and technical solutions
* Experience leading teams or coordinating cross-functional initiatives.
* Fluent in both Swedish and English.

**It is highly desirable** if you have experience with Azure DevOps

**About Nobia**


Nobia is Europe’s leading kitchen specialist, with strong brands such as Marbodal, HTH, Sigdal, and uno form. With us, you will become part of a modern organization where quality, safety, and continuous improvement are at the core of everything we do. We offer excellent opportunities for both professional and personal development. Curious to learn more? Visit Nobia Park – Jönköping.

**Want to be a part of our journey?**


Then we would like to receive **your application in English** no later than October 18, 2026. We review applications on an ongoing basis, and the position may be filled before the application deadline. Our recruitment process is competency-based and includes assessments to provide both you and us with the best possible conditions for a successful match. As part of the employment process, you will need to ***demonstrate your right to work within the EU***, for example through a passport or a valid work permit. ***Background checks and drug screening will be conducted*** as part of the recruitment process.


If you have any questions, please contact Talent Acquisition Specialist Josephine Tjernlund (josephine.tjernlund@nobia.com). We look forward to receiving your application!

title: Backend & DevOps-konsult (direktuppdrag) - Kollarna.se
description:
På Doktor.se definierar vi om det svenska sjukvårdssystemet genom att göra det mer tillgängligt, smidigt och effektivt, utan att kompromissa med kvalitet eller säkerhet. Vår hybridmodell, som kombinerar fysiska vårdcentraler med moderna digitala lösningar, har gjort oss till den största digitala vårdgivaren i Sverige, med miljontals konsultationer varje år.

### **Om uppdraget**


Vi söker en erfaren Backend- och DevOps-konsult för ett uppdrag hos Kollarna.se, en tjänst som erbjuds av Doktor.se:s dotterbolag Doktor24.se. Vi vill arbeta direkt med dig som konsult, utan mellanhänder.


Uppdraget syftar till att stärka och modernisera Kollarnas infrastruktur i Azure, med fokus på säkerhet, skalbarhet och automatisering. Du arbetar i nära samarbete med Kollarnas utvecklingsteam och driver dina leveranser självständigt mot överenskomna mål.

### **Vad uppdraget innebär**


Uppdraget omfattar följande leveranser:

* Genomlysning av nuvarande Azure-miljö och säkerhetsläge, med prioriterade åtgärdsförslag.
* Införande av infrastructure as code för befintliga tjänster.
* Översyn och förenkling av CI/CD-pipelines i GitHub Actions.
* Uppsättning av monitorering och larm, samt översyn av skalbarhet, t.ex. databaser och cachning (Redis).
* Rådgivning i design- och arkitekturfrågor som rör leveranserna ovan.
* Dokumentation och överlämning till teamet vid uppdragets slut.

### **Vem vi söker**


Du har gärna 5 år eller mer som backendutvecklare med erfarenhet av DevOps, som infrastrukturingenjör eller i liknande roll, framför allt i Azure-miljöer (erfarenhet av AWS är meriterande). Kollarnas backend är skriven i C# .NET och frontend i TypeScript/React. Erfarenhet av TypeScript och/eller Python är meriterande.


Du kan drifta Azure-tjänster med hjälp av exempelvis GitHub Actions, har god erfarenhet av databaser och SQL, framför allt MS SQL, och vet hur man bäst utnyttjar Azure-tjänster och sätter upp exempelvis Redis. Du har erfarenhet av att sätta upp och underhålla monitorering, tänker säkerhet först och har gedigen kunskap om hur man skyddar infrastruktur mot intrång.


Du är van att driva uppdrag självständigt och leverera mot överenskomna mål, samarbetar gärna och har erfarenhet av agila arbetssätt. Du talar och skriver flytande svenska och engelska.

### **Varför uppdraget är intressant**


Kollarna är en tjänst som hjälper människor varje dag, och infrastrukturen bakom den behöver vara säker, stabil och skalbar. Här får du ett tydligt avgränsat uppdrag med verklig effekt, stort mandat inom ditt område och ett engagerat team att samarbeta med.

### **Uppdragsvillkor**

**Uppdragsform:** Direktuppdrag. Du fakturerar via eget bolag med F-skatt, helst aktiebolag.

**Uppdragslängd:** Enligt överenskommelse.

**Omfattning:** 40 timmar per vecka.

**Start:** Så snart som möjligt. Vi tar hänsyn till eventuella pågående uppdrag.

**Arbetsplats:** Uppdraget utförs delvis på plats i Göteborg (Första Långgatan 18) för samarbete och avstämningar, enligt överenskommelse.

**Ersättning:** Enligt överenskommelse. Ange gärna ditt timpris i ansökan.

**Övrigt:** Uppdraget kan kombineras med andra uppdrag, så länge det inte innebär en intressekonflikt.

### **Var med och gör skillnad i vården!**


Som en del av vår urvalsprocess genomför vi ID-kontroll och begär utdrag ur belastningsregistret. Vi söker konsulter som vill arbeta direkt med oss och ber därför vänligt men bestämt att konsultmäklare, konsultbolag och rekryteringsföretag avstår från att kontakta oss.

title: Azure Cloud Engineer
description:
Vill du ta din expertis inom Azure till nästa nivå? Vi söker en person med erfarenhet inom Microsoft Cloud som vill vara med och designa, bygga och optimera framtidens molnlösningar tillsammans med oss på Accelerate. Hos oss får du inte bara arbeta med moderna tekniker och spännande uppdrag, du blir en del av ett värderingsdrivet och passionerat team där du får goda möjligheter till personlig utveckling.
 



  





**Om rollen** 




 Som Azure Cloud Engineer hos oss är du en nyckelspelare i att skapa stabila, säkra och moderna molnplattformar åt våra kunder. Du blir motorn bakom en friktionsfri resa från kod till produktion genom att automatisera, effektivisera och optimera kundernas Azure-miljöer. Vi ser dig som den som frigör kraften i molnet, så att utvecklingsteamen kan fokusera på innovation.
 



  





**Exempel på vad du kommer att göra:** 



* Bygga och underhålla en modern, säker och skalbar infrastruktur i Azure med Infrastructure as Code.
* Hantera lösningar inom PaaS (Platform as a Service) och IaaS (Infrastructure as a Service), inklusive Azure VM, Azure Virtual Desktop, Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), Azure Container Apps m.m.
* Säkerställa governance och compliance genom att implementera och hantera Azure Policy, RBAC och Workload Identity Federation.
* Optimera och implementera effektiva lösningar för monitorering och loggning med hjälp av Azure Monitor, Log Analytics och Application Insights.
* Säkerställa hög tillgänglighet och lösa komplexa utmaningar inom nätverk och säkerhet i Azure.



  





**Vem är du?** 




 Vi söker dig som är har gedigen erfarenhet som Cloud Engineer och som brinner för Cloud lösningar såsom Azure, automation och säkerhet. Du har ett lösningsfokuserat mindset och vill hjälpa våra kunder att bygga hållbara och effektiva molnlösningar.
 



  





 Du uttrycker dig obehindrat på svenska och engelska i både tal och skrift. För denna position krävs svenskt medborgarskap, vi utför även bakgrundskontroll av slutkandidat.
 



  





**Vi tror att du gillar att jobba med** 



* Cloud Infrastruktur: Azure VM, Azure Network, Azure Virtual Desktop, Azure Kubernetes Services
* Azure-tjänster som Function Apps, App Services, Key Vault och Storage Accounts
* Säkerhet och compliance: Entra ID, Managed Identities, RBAC, Azure Policy, Microsoft Security
* Monitorering och loggning: Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Application Insights
* Infrastructure as Code: som t ex Bicep
* Erfarenhet av att bygga cloudmiljöer enligt CAF (Cloud Adotions Framework) eller liknande.



  





**Plus Om Du Har** 



* Certifieringar som AZ-104 och/eller AZ-204
* Erfarenhet av: Azure Landing Zones
* AZ-400, AZ-305 eller motsvarande



  





**Varför Accelerate?** 




 Vi erbjuder dig mer än ett uppdrag – vi erbjuder en plattform för att växa som expert inom Microsoft Cloud så som Azure Infrastruktur, Azure DevOps och andra Microsoft Cloud lösningar! Hos oss får du chansen att arbeta i en modern och framtidsinriktad molnmiljö tillsammans med erfarna kollegor som är Microsoft MVP och Microsoft Certified Trainer inom Azure. Här blir du en del av en kultur där vi lär av varandra och bygger lösningar som verkligen gör skillnad hos våra kunder.
 



  





**Som konsult hos oss får du** 



* En skräddarsydd utvecklings- och certifieringsplan
* Utmanande och varierande uppdrag med de senaste teknikerna
* Flexibilitet, frihet och balans mellan jobb och fritid
* Kollektivavtal, friskvårdsbidrag och sjuk- och hälsoförsäkring
* Ett sammansvetsat team av vassa specialister som lyfter varandra
* En trygg och säker anställning med bra förmåner



  





 Vi tror på gemenskap och kompetensutbyte – här utvecklas vi tillsammans och stöttar varandra för att alltid ligga i framkant.
 



  





**Placeringsort** 




 Accelerate finns på flertal orter i Sverige och Norge. För denna tjänst utgår du från vårt kontor i Stockholm, med möjlighet till hybridarbete.
 



  





 Önskad start är snarast eller enligt överenskommelse. Har du frågor? Kontakta Jesper Carlsson på jesper.carlsson@iver.se
 



**Vi ser fram emot att träffa dig! Välkommen till Accelerate**
