title: Postdoc Researcher in Resilient Edge Computing for Critical Infrastructure
description:
*Are you passionate about building distributed systems that keep running under attack, failure, and disruption? Do you want to work on research that directly strengthens the resilience of Europe's critical digital infrastructure? If so, we invite you to apply for this postdoctoral position at RISE Research Institutes of Sweden.*

**The Project**


This position is part of CIRES (Critical Infrastructure Resilience through Edge Computing Systems), a European research project funded under the Chips Joint Undertaking. CIRES addresses a fundamental and urgent challenge: how to design distributed digital infrastructures that remain operational, secure, and trustworthy under failures, cyber attacks, degraded connectivity, and large-scale disruptions.


Modern critical infrastructure increasingly relies on tightly coupled edge computing, distributed communication networks, and cloud coordination. While these architectures offer autonomy and scalability, they also introduce complex failure modes and new attack surfaces. CIRES develops next-generation resilient edge-cloud architectures with a focus on secure communication, distributed coordination, adaptive service continuity, and rapid recovery under adverse conditions.


The project brings together leading European research institutes, universities, and industrial partners, offering an opportunity to address scientifically challenging distributed systems problems while contributing to technologies that safeguard essential societal infrastructure.

**About the Role**


As a postdoctoral researcher in CIRES, you will develop network and system mechanisms that keep critical infrastructure services running when connectivity and power are degraded or disrupted. The work combines protocol and architecture design with implementation and experimental validation in real environments, together with the project's application partners.


Key responsibilities include:

* Designing resilient network protocols and architectures that work across connectivity conditions, from well-connected, high-capacity networks to intermittently connected, delay- and disruption-tolerant networks (DTN), and adapt to the conditions at hand
* Applying these mechanisms so that sensors, IoT and other low-power devices, user devices, and edge systems keep sufficient communication services during disruptions to communication and power infrastructure
* Developing methods for offloading computation between end devices, edge, and cloud based on available resources and current and predicted service needs, together with efficient data collection and caching
* Contributing to robust AI/ML and data analysis methods that support resilient decision making when only partial data is available
* Integrating solutions with partners' software and platforms and evaluating them in large-scale tests in real environments
* Publishing results in leading international conferences and journals
* Contributing to EU project deliverables and technical reporting
* Collaborating with industrial and academic partners across Europe


You will collaborate with a multidisciplinary team and engage with industrial partners to validate solutions in relevant environments.

**What We Offer**


This position provides a strong platform for building an internationally visible research career. Specifically, you will benefit from:

* The opportunity to publish in leading international venues in distributed systems and networking
* Influence over technical direction within your research area
* Access to realistic deployment environments and industrial validation scenarios
* Participation in large-scale European research collaboration across industry and academia
* Exposure to the full research-to-deployment pipeline within critical infrastructure contexts
* Career development support toward senior roles in academia, research institutes, or industrial R&D


The position is a full-time, fixed-term appointment for two years, starting as soon as possible, designed to support your career development. You will gain experience in large-scale European collaboration, applied research in critical infrastructure, and direct interaction with industrial stakeholders. Travel is included in the role, primarily within Europe, with an estimated 3-4 international trips per year for consortium meetings, workshops, and conferences.

**Who Are You?**


Requirements:

* PhD in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a closely related field
* Strong background in networked and distributed systems, for example network protocols, wireless or IoT networking, or edge computing
* Experience in system design and experimental evaluation
* Demonstrated ability to publish scientific research
* Strong programming skills (e.g., Python, C/C++, or equivalent)
* Excellent written and spoken English


Meriting:

* Experience with EU-funded research projects
* Experience with robust or distributed AI/ML, for example federated learning
* Experience with delay- and disruption-tolerant, opportunistic, or mesh networking
* Familiarity with containerization, virtualization, or distributed deployment environments
* Experience with computation offloading, caching, or edge resource management
* Experience with testbeds or real-world deployments, including low-power IoT devices
* Familiarity with semiconductor or embedded hardware platforms
* Experience collaborating with industrial partners


Personal qualities:


We are looking for a researcher who combines intellectual rigour with practical systems thinking. We value:

* Strong analytical capability and independent problem-solving
* Ability to drive research forward with initiative and self-leadership
* Collaborative mindset in multidisciplinary, international environments
* Clear and structured communication with both technical and non-technical stakeholders
* Curiosity, technical depth, and motivation to work on challenging problems with real-world relevance

**Are we right for each other?**


At RISE, we like different and we are convinced that diversity contributes to an innovative environment where we together challenge boundaries and develop new knowledge for the future. With us, passionate problem solvers meet to solve some of the world's most important, and perhaps fun, problems. We cannot promise you an easy job, but what we can promise you is a bunch of committed colleagues and some really exciting societal and industrial challenges to tackle. You will work in a dynamic environment that gives you development opportunities both professionally and personally. With us, you get the opportunity to make a real difference. Welcome to Sweden's research institute and innovation partner!

**Welcome with Your Application!**


For more information, please contact Anders Lindgren, supervisor, at anders.lindgren@ri.se. The last application date is October 16th. Selection and interviews will be conducted continuously during and after the application period. Apply without cover letter.


Our union representatives are Ingemar Petermann, SACO, +46 10 228 41 22 and Linda Ikatti, Unionen, +46 10 516 51 61.

title: Principal Architect, E-Invoicing Solutions
description:
**Job Description**

  

We are seeking a high-impact **Principal Architect** to serve as our central subject matter expert in global e-invoicing, regulatory compliance, and platform architecture. This is a senior individual contributor role with organization-wide reach, operating beyond traditional single-project allocation to influence delivery, pre-sales, and customer strategy. In this role, you will be the definitive go-to authority across all delivery projects, pre-sales engagements, and customer-facing interactions. You will leverage your deep mastery of the Pagero platform, hands-on integration expertise, and understanding of national e-invoicing authorities to solve complex technical challenges, shape strategic solutions, and translate intricate regulatory frameworks into clear, actionable guidance for our teams and clients.  



  

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Cross-Project Advisory & Escalation**

* Serve as the senior technical and functional escalation authority across all active delivery projects, resolving complex platform, integration, and compliance roadblocks.
* Diagnose and solve the most challenging edge cases across the delivery portfolio, including non-standard ERP configurations, complex data transformation requirements, and multi-country mandate flows.
* Design and establish reusable reference architectures, standard configuration templates, playbooks, and best-practice frameworks to scale delivery quality and consistency across the organization.

**Pre-Sales & Commercial Enablement**

* Act as the dedicated Pagero platform and compliance expert for sales and pre-sales teams, providing deep functional and technical insight without holding direct ownership of SOW creation or pricing.
* Advise solution architects and pre-sales consultants on platform capabilities, limitations, architectural fit, and feasibility.
* Participate in high-stakes, customer-facing technical discussions for strategic enterprise opportunities.
* Review proposed solution designs from pre-sales and delivery teams to ensure technical accuracy, platform feasibility, and regulatory alignment.

**Customer Mandate & Regulatory Guidance**

* Act as the trusted advisor for enterprise clients navigating complex global e-invoicing mandates, clearance flows, format specifications (e.g., Peppol, UBL, XML), and government platform integrations.
* Engage directly with customer stakeholders and liaise with national e-invoicing and tax authorities when necessary to secure formal regulatory clarifications.
* Author and review customer-facing compliance roadmaps, mandate checklists, and country-specific onboarding documentation.

**Team Onboarding, Training & Knowledge Management**

* Own the technical onboarding journey for new team members, developing and executing structured onboarding programs that build Pagero platform and compliance proficiency from day one.
* Foster continuous skill development across delivery teams through tailored training sessions, hands-on coaching, certification guidance, and internal knowledge-sharing forums.
* Build, maintain, and expand an internal Pagero Knowledge Base and learning curriculum covering country-specific mandates, integration patterns, and platform updates.
Partner with delivery leadership to identify capability gaps across teams and deploy targeted technical enablement initiatives.  
* 

**Required Qualifications**

* Deep Pagero Expertise: Proven, hands-on experience and expert-level functional and technical mastery of the Pagero platform ecosystem.
* Domain Knowledge: Extensive knowledge of global e-invoicing regulations, continuous transaction controls (CTC), clearance models, Peppol networks, and digital tax reporting requirements across multiple jurisdictions.
* Integration & ERP Proficiency: Strong technical background in enterprise application integration (EAI), API frameworks, and ERP systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle, NetSuite, Microsoft Dynamics), alongside deep familiarity with standard data formats (XML, JSON, EDI, UBL, CSV).
* Architecture & Advisory Experience: Substantial experience operating in a Lead Architect, Principal Consultant, or Senior Subject Matter Expert capacity across complex enterprise deployments.
* Pre-Sales Acumen: Demonstrated track record supporting pre-sales teams with technical solution reviews, discovery calls, and RFP responses.
Communication & Stakeholder Management: Exceptional communication skills with the ability to articulate complex technical and regulatory nuances to both executive business leaders and technical engineering teams.  
* 

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Prior experience directly interfacing or collaborating with national tax authorities, e-invoicing standard bodies, or working groups.
* Demonstrated experience establishing a Center of Excellence (CoE) or structured technical training and onboarding curriculum within an enterprise technology or consulting environment.
* Relevant industry or architecture certifications (e.g., TOGAF, Cloud Certifications, or ERP-specific accreditations).
Multilingual proficiency, particularly in languages relevant to major emerging e-invoicing mandate regions (e.g., Spanish, French, German, Arabic).  
* 

  

#LI-KK1


**What’s in it For You?**

* **Hybrid Work Model:** We’ve adopted a flexible hybrid working environment (2-3 days a week in the office depending on the role) for our office-based roles while delivering a seamless experience that is digitally and physically connected.
* **Flexibility & Work-Life Balance:** Flex My Way is a set of supportive workplace policies designed to help manage personal and professional responsibilities, whether caring for family, giving back to the community, or finding time to refresh and reset. This builds upon our flexible work arrangements, including work from anywhere for up to 8 weeks per year, empowering employees to achieve a better work-life balance.
* **Career Development and Growth:** By fostering a culture of continuous learning and skill development, we prepare our talent to tackle tomorrow’s challenges and deliver real-world solutions. Our Grow My Way programming and skills-first approach ensures you have the tools and knowledge to grow, lead, and thrive in an AI-enabled future.
* **Industry Competitive Benefits:** We offer comprehensive benefit plans to include flexible vacation, two company-wide Mental Health Days off, access to the Headspace app, retirement savings, tuition reimbursement, employee incentive programs, and resources for mental, physical, and financial wellbeing.
* **Culture:** Globally recognized, award-winning reputation for inclusion and belonging, flexibility, work-life balance, and more. We live by our values: Obsess over our Customers, Compete to Win, Challenge (Y)our Thinking, Act Fast / Learn Fast, and Stronger Together.
* **Social Impact:** Make an impact in your community with our Social Impact Institute. We offer employees two paid volunteer days off annually and opportunities to get involved with pro-bono consulting projects and Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) initiatives.
* **Making a Real-World Impact:** We are one of the few companies globally that helps its customers pursue justice, truth, and transparency. Together, with the professionals and institutions we serve, we help uphold the rule of law, turn the wheels of commerce, catch bad actors, report the facts, and provide trusted, unbiased information to people all over the world.
**About Us**

Thomson Reuters informs the way forward by bringing together the trusted content and technology that people and organizations need to make the right decisions. We serve professionals across legal, tax, accounting, compliance, government, and media. Our products combine highly specialized software and insights to empower professionals with the data, intelligence, and solutions needed to make informed decisions, and to help institutions in their pursuit of justice, truth, and transparency. Reuters, part of Thomson Reuters, is a world leading provider of trusted journalism and news.


We are powered by the talents of 26,000 employees across more than 70 countries, where everyone has a chance to contribute and grow professionally in flexible work environments. At a time when objectivity, accuracy, fairness, and transparency are under attack, we consider it our duty to pursue them. Sound exciting? Join us and help shape the industries that move society forward.


As a global business, we rely on the unique backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences of all employees to deliver on our business goals. To ensure we can do that, we seek talented, qualified employees in all our operations around the world regardless of race, color, sex/gender, including pregnancy, gender identity and expression, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, disability, age, marital status, citizen status, veteran status, or any other protected classification under applicable law. Thomson Reuters is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer providing a drug-free workplace.


We also make reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and for sincerely held religious beliefs in accordance with applicable law. More information on requesting an accommodation here .

title: VP, Portfolio Strategy
description:
Sinch’s vision is to connect every business with every customer, everywhere in the world. More than 200,000 businesses — including Google, Uber, Paypal, Visa, Tinder, and many others — rely on Sinch’s Customer Communications Cloud to power engaging customer experiences through mobile messaging, voice, and email.  



Whether you need to verify users or craft omnichannel campaigns, Sinch makes it easy. Our AI-infused Super Network, APIs, and applications ensure you can connect with your customers reliably and securely, at every step of their journey.  



At Sinch we “Dream Big”, “Win Together”, “Keep it simple”, and “Make it Happen”. These values are our foundation!  



**Description**

The VP, Portfolio Strategy shapes the strategy and future direction for a focused set of cross-product themes within Sinch’s Product organization. These are the highest-leverage opportunities that span Messaging, Voice, Email, and Applications, and that shape how customers experience Sinch as a single platform.  



This is a senior product leadership role focused on portfolio direction, cross-product alignment, and clear ownership of a small number of strategic themes. You will help define and advance priorities such as end-to-end customer journeys, developer and agent experiences, Product-led Growth, ecosystems, integrations, partnerships, AI-native and agentic adoption, and selective channel evolution opportunities such as conversational messaging. Your work will translate ambiguous portfolio themes into clear decisions, success measures, ownership models, and measurable outcomes across products, regions, and functions.  



You will sit alongside our product area leaders, partner closely with regional and GTM leadership, and act as a senior product partner to the Chief Product Officer. The role is built for a leader who is strongest at setting direction, aligning senior stakeholders, clarifying ownership, and making cross-product outcomes legible and measurable.  



**Key responsibilities**

* Shape and rank the product strategy and future direction for a focused set of portfolio-level, cross-product themes that disproportionately matter to Sinch’s growth, working with the Chief Product Officer to translate them into clear priorities, sequencing, ownership, and success outcomes.
* Balance investment across the product portfolio, including when and how we allocate resources to big bets, and make the trade-offs and sequencing explicit to product-line and GTM leadership.
* Define and evolve the mission, scope boundaries, and interfaces of Product Areas, so teams can move faster with clear ownership, fewer overlaps, and stronger cross-area collaboration.
* Translate strategy into concrete, decision-ready proposals on end-to-end customer journeys and the developer and agent surfaces that present Sinch as a single portfolio.
* Ensure strategic portfolio priorities translate into measurable business outcomes by defining success measures, decision points, and ownership models, in partnership with Product Operations and Business Operations on sequencing, dependency clarity, adoption tracking, and disciplined follow-through.
* Partner with regional leadership in AMER, EMEA, and APAC to ensure cross-product priorities are understood, sequenced, and adopted in market, with plans tailored to buyer needs, regulatory realities, and regional growth opportunities.
* Act as a senior product partner to the Chief Product Officer on portfolio-level strategy, partnerships, and M&A pattern recognition.
Shape how cross-product strategy gets translated into action at scale by clarifying decision rights, escalation paths, accountability, and the minimum operating rhythm required to keep strategic priorities moving.  
* 

The role is ideally based at SINCH HQ in Stockholm, Sweden.  



**Requirements**

* 15+ years in product leadership in CPaaS, communications software or enterprise SaaS with experience operating in growth environments, not only operating in established businesses.
* Strong experience with multi-product platforms, ecosystems, integrations, partnerships, developer experiences, or cross-channel customer journeys.
* A track record of landing cross-functional, cross-product outcomes inside a multi-product portfolio.
* Strong product judgment and commercial fluency: you move comfortably between portfolio strategy and GTM motion design, and you understand unit economics and gross profit mechanics, not just revenue.
* Demonstrable stakeholder management and collaboration skills: you build trust with product-line leaders, GTM, regional teams, and partners, and you can implement hard choices once decisions are made.
* A humble, collaborative leadership style: you build trust through inclusion, engagement, and transparency, and you have the courage to challenge assumptions while listening and learning from others.
* A strong outcomes orientation. You are credible because you make the hardest cross-product choices clear, align leaders behind them, and ensure results are measurable and owned.
* Senior executive presence, with the ability to operate credibly at C-suite, board, customer, and partner executive level.
Comfort operating with ambiguity, delegated authority, and an explicit obligation to make a small number of cross-product outcomes legible, measurable, and accountable inside a product-line-led organization.  
* 

**Our hiring process**

We are committed to ensuring a recruitment process that is fair, objective, consistent, and inclusive. Our approach includes structured, competency-based interviews designed to evaluate your skills, experience, and qualifications relevant to the role. At times, we may include a data-driven assessment to enhance our hiring success and identify candidates likely to excel.  



We believe in a two-way process and encourage you to ask questions throughout the journey. If this role isn't what you're looking for, please explore the other opportunities listed on our career page: https://www.sinch.com/careers/ . No matter who you are, we hope you find an exciting path forward - hopefully with us!  



**Salary:**

The annual salary for this position is between SEK 1.300.000 – 1.600.000. This role is eligible for bonus. Factors which may affect pay within this range may include skills, education, experience, and other qualifications.

title: ML/AI Engineer
description:
Shape the future with AI at CGI. We are looking for an ML/AI Engineer who wants to turn the possibilities of artificial intelligence and machine learning into solutions that create real value.  

  

In this role, you will work at the intersection of software engineering, machine learning, data, and generative AI. You will collaborate with colleagues and clients to design, build, deploy, and improve AI powered solutions, from early prototypes and proofs of concept to robust production systems.  

  

The role is intentionally broad. Depending on your experience and interests, you may work with traditional machine learning, generative AI and large language models (LLMs), intelligent applications, MLOps, or a combination of these areas.

**Dina framtida arbetsuppgifter**


As an ML/AI Engineer, you will:  

  

. Design and develop machine learning and AI solutions for real world business challenges  

. Build applications and services using generative AI, LLMs, and modern AI frameworks  

. Develop and evaluate solutions such as RAG, AI agents, search, recommendation, prediction, and automation  

. Build reliable data and ML pipelines and integrate models into applications and business systems  

. Deploy, monitor, evaluate, and continuously improve AI/ML solutions in production  

. Experiment with new models, tools, frameworks, and approaches  

. Apply good software engineering, MLOps, security, and responsible AI practices  

. Work closely with software engineers, data specialists, architects, domain experts, and client teams  

. Translate business needs into practical technical solutions and communicate technical concepts to different audiences.

**Kvalifikationer för att bli framgångsrik denna roll**


What we're looking for:  

  

We believe you could come from several different backgrounds. You might already be an ML/AI Engineer, or you may have developed strong AI/ML capabilities through software engineering, data science, or data engineering.  

  

We are particularly interested in experience with some of the following:  

  

. Python and modern software development practices  

. Machine learning frameworks and libraries such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, or scikit learn  

. Generative AI and LLMs, including prompt engineering, embeddings, RAG, evaluation, and/or agentic applications  

. Cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud  

. APIs, microservices, containers, and technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes  

. Data processing, databases, vector databases, and data pipelines  

. MLOps / LLMOps, CI/CD, model deployment, monitoring, and lifecycle management  

  

You don't need to be an expert in everything above. We value strong engineering fundamentals, curiosity, and the ability to learn and apply new technologies.  

  

We believe that:
  

  

You enjoy solving complex problems and turning ideas into working solutions. You are comfortable experimenting but you also understand what it takes to move from an experiment to something reliable and maintainable.  

  

You collaborate well with others and can connect technology with business needs. You are curious about the rapidly evolving AI landscape while maintaining a thoughtful approach to areas such as security, privacy, explainability, quality, and responsible AI.  

  

At CGI, you will have the opportunity to work with AI and machine learning across different industries, technologies, and business challenges. You'll be part of a collaborative environment where you can learn from experienced colleagues, contribute your own ideas, and continue developing your expertise.  

  

We combine the reach and opportunities of a global organization with strong local teams and close collaboration with our clients. If you're excited about building useful AI solutions, and want to help organizations move from AI possibilities to practical outcomes, we'd like to hear from you.  

  

#LI-CGISWEDEN5

Livet på CGI bygger på ägande, lagarbete, respekt och tillhörighet. Tillsammans med oss kommer du att kunna nå din fulla potential.

title: Project assistant in reseach at the Department of Earth and Environmental Sciences
description:
Lund University was founded in 1666 and is repeatedly ranked among the world’s top universities. The University has around 46 000 students and 8 500 staff based in Lund, Helsingborg and Malmö. We are united in our efforts to understand, explain and improve our world and the human condition. Lund University welcomes applicants with diverse backgrounds and experiences. We regard equality, equal opportunities and diversity as a strength and an asset.


Research and education at the Department of Earth and Environmental Sciences (MGeo) addresses fundamental and applied questions on the Earth’s past, present and future climate and environment, including people’s interactions with the natural world and consequences for human wellbeing. MGeo advances and deploys cutting-edge methods, models and technologies in environmental science, quaternary sciences, bedrock geology, paleontology, physical geography, biodiversity and ecosystem science, remote sensing, Geographic Information Science (GIS), and computational science for health and environment, to study processes spanning from the microscopic to the planetary, across all time scales.


**Work duties**


Forests differ substantially in their species composition, structure and ecological function, with tree-species diversity influencing biodiversity, ecosystem services, resilience to environmental disturbance, and contributing to nature-based solutions. The project assistant will primarily involve preparing and integrating large geospatial datasets, adapting and applying machine-learning models across different forest and environmental conditions, and evaluating model performance using forest inventory and other reference data. The position will also involve producing national-scale tree-species and species-composition maps, assessing spatial patterns of prediction uncertainty, and carrying out quality control of the resulting map products. Additional tasks may include processing satellite and ancillary environmental data, preparing training and validation datasets, manual interpretation and digitization of reference information.

**Qualifications**

* Master’s degree in environmental science, GIS, remote sensing, or equivalent competence.
* Experience analyzing large volumes of medium-resolution satellite remote sensing data such as Landsat and Sentinel-2.
* Very good programming skills (e.g. Python, JavaScript).
* Very good oral and written proficiency in English.

**Other merits**

* Experience with time series satellite image analysis in cloud computing platforms (e.g. GEE Python API).
* Experience developing machine learning models (e.g. CNN, XGBoost, etc).


We will place great emphasis on personal suitability. In the assessment, consideration will also be given to factors such as attention to detail, the ability to plan and organize work effectively, good collaboration skills, initiative, and independence. Consideration will also be given to how the applicant’s experience and competencies complement and strengthen the research activities within the project.

**Terms of employment**

* Fixed-term employment, 8 months.
* The scope of the employment, full time (100%).

**Instructions on how to apply**


Applications should be in English and include a cover letter stating the reasons why you are interested in the position and in what way the employment corresponds to your qualifications. The application should also contain a CV, degree certificate or equivalent, and other documents you wish to be considered (grade transcripts, contact information for your references, letters of recommendation, etc.).


Welcome to apply!

  

Within the Faculty of Science research and education is conducted within Astronomy, Biology, Physics, Geosciences, Chemistry, Mathematics, medical radiation physics, physical geography and Environmental Sciences. The Faculty of Science is organized into eight departments, gathered in the northern campus area in Lund. The Faculty of Science has approximately 1900 students, 330 PhD students and 730 employees.


We kindly decline all sales and marketing contacts.

title: AI Engineer
description:
**About Us**
------------


Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar.  

  

Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes.  

  

1,000+ customers across 50+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White & Case, Dentons, and Barclays. We’ve scaled to **$100M+ in ARR**, with teams across Europe, North America and APAC, and continue to expand through acquisitions including Qura, Walter AI and Graceview.  

  

We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law.  

  

Joining Legora means three things.

* We **lean in:** ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions.
* We **fight for excellence:** high standards, direct, ego-free feedback.
* We **grow together:** as a team and with our customers.


Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts.


If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place.

  

**The team**
------------


AI Enablement makes Legora AI-native by default. We work across three streams in parallel: building internal agents and tools, equipping teams to build their own, and owning the standards, access and guardrails that let everyone move fast safely.


We own the AI platforms and the internal products built on them. So far that includes Leya, an internal knowledge agent live in Slack that answers questions about Legora with cited sources and automates parts of our RFP and security questionnaire work. A structured, agent-readable knowledge base assembled from knowledge each domain continues to own, where agents propose changes and humans approve them. Leyf, a platform for internally built apps that lands anyone's app on shared infrastructure with guardrails scaled to how much damage it could do. And a Skills Hub, so that something one person works out becomes something the whole company can use rather than staying on their laptop.


The team is small and the mandate is large. That is the job.

**What makes this hard**
------------------------


Legora is an AI company of around a thousand people, most already fluent and on current tools. Internal AI here is not an adoption problem. Nobody needs convincing, which means there is nowhere to hide behind change management or training. If something we build is not used, it is because it was not good enough.


Our colleagues know what good looks like and will not use something worse than what they think they could build themselves in an afternoon. So we ship things people genuinely want, and the foundations arrive with them. That constraint does not go away.


The mandate is also larger than the team. The part no individual can do for themselves is the infrastructure, the access model and the architecture underneath, and getting that right across a company this size is the actual work. It does not come with a specification.

**What you will do**
--------------------


You will take broad ownership of how AI works inside Legora and of the platforms we build to make it work.

* Build internal agents, tools and platforms, and treat them as products rather than projects. Quality, reliability and whether they actually serve the business are yours, not someone else's
* Take a broad goal, work out what is actually required, and break it into the work yourself
* Own what you build end to end, from the architecture through to whether people use it and it holds up in production
* Shape what we should build and in what order, and argue for it
* Design the foundations: knowledge architecture, access and permissions, evaluation and monitoring, the guardrails that scale with risk
* Work directly with the people who will use what you build, across the whole company, including the parts furthest from engineering

**Who we are looking for**
--------------------------

* **Strong engineering fundamentals.** You build production systems, not prototypes that need someone else to finish them
* **Real depth with LLM-based systems.** Agents, retrieval, evaluation, tool use. You know where these systems break and you design for it
* **Ownership by instinct.** You do not wait for a specification. When the requirement is unclear or wrong, you say so and propose something better
* **Three kinds of understanding at once.** Technical, domain and business. You can hold a conversation about architecture and a conversation about what the business actually needs, and connect them
* **Openness.** You take feedback, build on other people's ideas, change your mind when the evidence moves, and push for the strongest outcome rather than the one you proposed first
* **Comfort with ambiguity.** New team, fast growth, decisions that get revisited as we learn. That should sound appealing rather than annoying
* **TypeScript.** It's what we work in, and where our shared patterns live
* **No aversion to infrastructure.** We own ours, so Terraform and cloud providers are part of the work rather than someone else's problem
* **You work with code agents daily.** Not as an experiment, as how you build

 **Legora is an Equal Opportunity Employer**


At Legora, we believe great teams are built on diversity of thought and experience. We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer and committed to creating an inclusive, high-performance culture where everyone can do their best work. We welcome people of all backgrounds and don’t discriminate based on race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

title: Enterprise Architect - Technology
description:
Are you driven by transforming complex technology landscapes and shaping the architecture of tomorrow? At Sandvik Coromant, this is a key role in shaping the digital backbone of a global industry leader and making a visible impact on how we innovate, grow, and operate.  



**About the job**

You’re part of the EA team that leads the modernization of our technology landscape to support evolving business needs. You define and guide target architectures, principles, and guardrails that enable modular, cloud-native, API- and event-driven ways of working. You also evaluate emerging technologies and assess their fit, opportunities, and risks for enterprise-wide adoption.  



Working closely with senior leaders, architects, and product teams, you shape technology roadmaps and ensure initiatives align with business needs and target architecture from idea to implementation. By evaluating tools, platforms, and frameworks, setting standards, and providing architectural guidance, you enable consistent architectural practices and informed technology decisions across the organization.  



**Job responsibilities**

* Define target architectures and architectural patterns that drive adaptability, speed and cost efficiency, and ensure that solution designs align with business needs and enterprise direction.
* Define and enforcing technology standards and architectural direction.
* Lead the development of technology roadmaps and guide pilot evaluations to validate architectural concepts and future capabilities.

Track and communicating measurable business and technical impact.  

* 

**Location and flexibility**

The position is based in Stockholm or Sandviken and offers a hybrid way of working.  



**Your profile**

We’re looking for someone who combines leadership experience with hands‑on expertise in modern enterprise architecture. You’ve successfully driven large‑scale modernization programs and worked with distributed systems, microservices, and containerized applications. You’re confident in setting standards, making architectural decisions, and mentoring teams.  



Your background includes:


* Experience from Enterprise Architecture application in agile product lead IT organization.
* Experience leading technology roadmaps, piloting new tools and bringing innovations into production.
* Experience developing enterprise architectures, roadmaps, and transformation initiatives.
* Knowledge of modern technology platforms, cloud-based architectures, integrations, and distributed systems.
* Ability to connect technology investments to business value and long-term goals.
* Experience evaluating technologies, platforms, and architectural frameworks.

Strong communication skills in English. Swedish is considered an advantage.  

* 

Success in this position comes from balancing strategic thinking with a pragmatic, results-oriented approach. Strong stakeholder management skills, clear communication, and the ability to influence across organizational boundaries help you build trust and create momentum.

Innovation is in our DNA and we’re proud to shape the future of manufacturing in close collaboration with our customers and partners. We believe in an inclusive, equal and open-minded culture, and we nurture our diversities to form a solid foundation for achieving great results. description:

If you seek to make a difference on a global scale, working with next-gen technologies and the sharpest collaborative teams, then we could be a perfect match.

 **Role Overview:**  

We are seeking a Principal Cyber Security Analyst to provide technical leadership within our Security Operations Center (SOC). In this role, you will serve as a hands-on expert in detecting, analyzing, and responding to cybersecurity threats. You will lead and coordinate major incident response efforts, set best practices for threat detection and investigation, and mentor senior and junior analysts across the SOC.  

As a trusted security leader, you will collaborate closely with engineering, IT, risk, and business stakeholders to drive continuous improvements to the organization’s security posture, influence security strategy, and enhance detection and response capabilities

 **Key Responsibilities:**

* Provide technical leadership for advanced threat detection, investigation and response within the SOC.
* Lead high-severity security incidents investigations, including malware analysis and enterprise-wide investigations.
* Drive real-time incident response, coordinating containment, remediation, and post-incident reviews.
* Design, optimize, and maintain detection use cases, monitoring rules, and alert tuning to improve SOC effectiveness.
* Perform deep analysis across networks, endpoints, and cloud environments to identify and mitigate security risks.
* Lead and support proactive threat-hunting initiatives and vulnerability mitigation efforts.
* Collaborate with IT, engineering, digital forensics, and external partners during incident response activities.
* Develop, standardize, and continuously improve SOC playbooks, procedures, and automation workflows.
* Mentor analysts, conduct training and incident response exercises, and perform quality reviews of investigations.
* Act as a subject matter expert, contributing to broader cybersecurity initiatives and continuous improvement programs.
**Qualifications:**

* 10+ years of progressive, hands-on experience in Security Operations, with deep expertise in SIEM and SOAR platforms within enterprise or large-scale SOC environments.
* Proven technical leadership in incident response, advanced threat detection, and security operations, including ownership of complex and high-impact security incidents.
* Expert-level experience with SIEM and SOAR technologies (e.g., Splunk, XSOAR), including detection engineering, use case development, and response automation.
* Strong scripting and automation capabilities using languages such as Python and PowerShell to enhance SOC efficiency and response maturity.
* In-depth knowledge of network and security protocols, firewalls, server and cloud environments, identity platforms (Active Directory, LDAP, Microsoft Entra ID), and modern attack techniques.
* Demonstrated experience in continuous security monitoring, vulnerability management, threat hunting, and adversary-based testing activities.
* Experience with Purple Team operations, detection validation, and/or OT security environments is highly desirable.

 **Certifications (Preferred):**  

CISSP, OffSec Defense Analyst (OSDA) GIAC Certified Incident Handler (GCIH), Certified SOC Analyst (CSA) or equivalent certifications.

**Soft Skills:**

* Strong communication, presentation, and collaboration skills.
* Analytical and critical thinking abilities.
* Sense of urgency and effective prioritization in high-pressure situations.
* Positive mindset and conflict resolution expertise.

 **ITIL Skills (Preferred):**  

Incident Management, Problem Management, and Audit/Assessment Experience.

 **Why Join Us?**

* Opportunity to work on cutting-edge cybersecurity initiatives.
* Be part of a collaborative and forward-thinking team.
* Continuous learning and career development opportunities in the cybersecurity domain.
* Incident Management, Problem Management, and Audit/Assessment Experience.

title: Partner Solution Architect
description:
**Own Every Moment at NetApp**
 At NetApp, your ideas power innovation. We lead in intelligent data infrastructure—delivering unified storage, integrated data services, and solutions that help organizations unlock the full potential of their data, from AI to multicloud.
   

  

 Ready to innovate and contribute to our path to $10B? Here, you'll collaborate with passionate teams, tackle real-world challenges, and see your impact in how customers transform and grow. If you're ready to bring curiosity, creativity, and drive to every moment, NetApp is where your journey begins. Join teams that innovate to elevate, drive results, and excel together across every function.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 You'll help partners become self-sufficient technical engines of growth.
   

  

 As a Partner Solutions Architect (PSA), you will be a technical leader responsible for scaling NetApp's technical reach through the partner ecosystem. Acting as a trusted advisor to strategic reseller, distributor, and alliance partners, you will build partner capability, shape technical strategy, and enable partners to independently position, architect, sell, and deliver NetApp solutions
   

  

 Working closely with partners, field sales, systems engineers, alliance teams, and product organisations, you will bridge technical enablement and business execution. Through coaching, solution leadership, community development, and thought leadership, you will accelerate partner maturity, expand portfolio adoption, and drive measurable partner-led growth. Success in this role comes from influence, enablement, and scale rather than direct ownership of customer opportunities.
   

  

 The PSA operates through coaching, mentoring, and capability development rather than direct execution. The goal is to help partners become increasing self-sufficent, reducing dependency on NetApp whilst increasing their ability to independently create customer and business growth.
   

  

 What You'll Do
   

  

**Build Partner Capability**
 Own the technical enablement strategy for assigned partners, aligned to business priorities and growth objectives. Develop partner technical maturity across NetApp's strategic solution portfolios through scalable workshops, bootcamps, hands-on labs, technical onboarding programmes, and coaching initiatives. Mentor partner Solution Architects, Systems Engineers, and technical leaders to build long-term capability and independence. Enable distributor technical teams to autonomously qualify, design, and support opportunities within their market segments.
   

  

**Provide Technical Solution Leadership**
 Provide architecture guidance on complex partner-led opportunities and act as a technical escalation point when additional expertise is required. Help partners develop differentiated, domain-led offerings that integrate NetApp technologies into broader customer solutions and alliance ecosystems. Support solution validation, design reviews, and the development of repeatable solution patterns that partners can independently replicate and scale. Guide and coach partners through technical decision-making, helping them to build confidence and capability to lead future engagements independently.
   

  

**Evangelise and Lead Thought Leadership**
 Present at bootcamps, partner conferences, technical communities, distributor events, and industry forums. Build credibility and influence through technical leadership and community engagement. Contribute to technical content, reference architectures, best-practice guidance, and reusable enablement materials that strengthen the broader partner ecosystem.
   

  

**Grow the Partner Community**
 Build and nurture strong relationships within partner and distributor organisations. Develop thriving technical communities, advisory groups, and peer networks that encourage knowledge sharing and collaboration. Connect partner practice leaders with NetApp experts and foster collaboration across partners, distributors, alliance teams, and field organisations.
   

  

**Accelerate Partner-Led Growth**
 Collaborate with sales, channel, marketing, and alliance teams to drive partner-led pipeline creation and portfolio expansion. Support partner-led campaigns, workshops, technical events, and solution development initiatives that help partners identify, qualify, and progress opportunities independently. Increase adoption across NetApp's strategic portfolio areas and help partners expand beyond traditional storage opportunities.
   

  

**Connect Ecosystem Insights to Strategy**
 Act as a voice of the partner ecosystem within NetApp by capturing partner and customer feedback and helping influence technical strategy and future solutions. Share market insights, partner challenges, and emerging opportunities with internal stakeholders to improve partner success and solution relevance.
   

  

 What You'll Bring
   

  

* Significant experience in technical presales, solution architecture, consulting, partner enablement, or related technical leadership roles.
* Experience working with channel partners, distributors, system integrators, or alliance partners.
* Strong knowledge of enterprise IT, cloud, data infrastructure, and solution architecture practices.
* Experience aligning technical strategy and enablement programmes to commercial and business priorities.
* Experience developing technical capability through coaching, enablement programmes, mentoring, or community leadership.
* Familiarity with hyperscaler cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud) and alliance technologies such as Cisco, NVIDIA, and Commvault.
* Ability to translate technical differentiation into repeatable partner-led solutions and business outcomes.
* Strong stakeholder management, communication, facilitation, and influencing skills.
* Ability to drive outcomes through expertise and collaboration rather than direct authority.
* A coaching mindset and a passion for helping others succeed.
* Ability to thrive in a matrix organisation and balance strategic thinking with practical execution.


 Nice to Have
   

  

* Experience in a technical role within a sales, channel, or alliance organisation.
* Experience building and scaling technical communities and enablement programmes.
* Experience creating technical content, such as blogs, whitepapers, workshops, or conference sessions.
* Familiarity with AI infrastructure, cyber resilience, hybrid cloud, or other modern data infrastructure architectures.
* Experience working across multiple countries, partner ecosystems, or alliances.


 At NetApp, we embrace a hybrid working environment designed to strengthen connection, collaboration, and culture for all employees. This means that most roles will have some level of in-office and/or in-person expectations, which will be shared during the recruitment process.
   

  

**Equal Opportunity Employer:**
 NetApp is firmly committed to Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) and to compliance with all federal, state and local laws that prohibit employment discrimination based on age, race, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, religion, disability or genetic information, pregnancy, protected veteran status, and any other protected classification.
   

  

**Why You'll Thrive at NetApp**
 At NetApp, you won't wait for the perfect moment—you'll make it. The early planning, the extra thought, the bold idea that turns good into great: That's how our people operate and how we continue to push the boundaries of data infrastructure.
   

  

 NetApp is the trusted partner for organizations transforming data into opportunity. As the only enterprise-grade storage service natively embedded in Google Cloud, AWS, and Microsoft Azure, we empower customers to run everything from traditional workloads to enterprise AI with unmatched performance, resilience, and security.
   

  

**Our culture**
 We celebrate mold breakers, bold thinkers, and problem solvers. We reward initiative, impact, and ownership. We provide flexibility so you can balance professional ambition with your personal life. Here, differences are not just welcomed—they drive everything we do.
   

  

 If you're ready to innovate, rise to the challenge, and own every moment - make your next move your best one. Apply now.
   

  

**Submitting an Application**
 To ensure a streamlined and fair hiring process for all candidates, our team only reviews applications submitted through our company website. This practice allows us to track, assess, and respond to applicants efficiently. Emailing our employees, recruiters, or Human Resources personnel directly will not influence your application.
   

  

**AI Disclosure**
 For select roles, some stages of our hiring process may use artificial intelligence tools to help evaluate applications and candidate selection. These tools support—rather than replace—human decision-making.

 Databricks is seeking a

 , our

 offering for

* Drive new Lakebase revenue by identifying, qualifying, and driving Lakebase activations and consumption within a defined territory, in partnership with regional Account Executives and the broader account team

* Executive presence with the ability to whiteboard architectures, lead C-level conversations, and build trust with senior decision makers
* Strong value selling skills: adept at discovering pain, building a business case, and tying technical capabilities to clear, quantified outcomes

description:
På Capgemini får du chansen att göra verklig skillnad – för människor, företag och samhället. Hos oss får du #MakeItReal på riktigt, med stöd av kollegor som inspirerar, stöttar och utmanar dig att växa varje dag. Vi brinner för digital innovation och söker dig som vill skapa nästa generations smarta lösningar tillsammans med oss. Inom vårt område Digital Customer Experience (DCX) utvecklar vi lösningar som förbättrar hur människor interagerar med digitala tjänster, med hjälp av smart design, data och teknik. Tillsammans med världsledande plattformar bygger vi innovationer som gör skillnad för människor, företag och en mer hållbar framtid. Hos oss får du möjlighet att arbeta med det senaste inom Microsofts ekosystem – inklusive AI-drivna lösningar som Copilot i Dynamics 365 och Power Platform.
   

  

**Om rollen**
 Hos Capgemini DCX blir du senior arkitekt inom Power Platform och Dynamics 365 CRM. Du ansvarar för helheten från målbild och arkitektur till roadmap, governance och kvalite i uppdrag för några av Sveriges mest välkända företag. Tillsammans med erfarna kollegor skapar du lösningar som gör skillnad och blir en del av vårt globala Microsoft-nätverk.
   

  

 Som senior Power Platform/Dynamics 365 CRM-arkitekt är du teknisk och funktionell ledare i våra kundåtaganden.
   

  

*I den här rollen kommer du att ha en nyckelroll i:*
* Sätter målbild och arkitektur för Dynamics 365 CRM och Power Platform – inklusive Dataverse, integrationer, säkerhet, miljöstrategi och ALM.
* Designar end-to-end-lösningar där Dynamics 365 CRM, Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI, Copilot/AI och Azure-tjänster samverkar på ett robust och skalbart sätt.
* Leder workshops på C-nivå och med verksamheten kring processer, informationsmodell, kundresor och plattformsstrategi.
* Coachar teamet (konsulter, utvecklare, testare) i bästa praxis kring Power Platform, arkitektur, DevOps och kvalitet – och säkerställer att lösningen följer satta riktlinjer.
* Driver governance och standardisering: Referensarkitekturer, återanvändbara komponenter, solution templates och riktlinjer för hur plattformen ska användas.
* Är delaktig i presales och erbjudandeutveckling: Du stöttar i kunddialoger, RFP/RFI-svar, estimat och visar värdet av Microsoft-ekosystemet i praktiken.


**Din profil**
 Du är en erfaren konsult eller arkitekt som trivs lika bra i strategiska samtal med verksamhetschefer som i diskussioner om integration, Dataverse-modellering eller ALM-upplägg.
   

  

* Erfaren konsult eller arkitekt som trivs både i strategiska samtal med verksamhetschefer och i tekniska diskussioner om integration, Dataverse-modellering eller ALM-upplägg.
* Minst 5 års erfarenhet av Dynamics 365 CRM och/eller Power Platform i roller som lösningsarkitekt, lead consultant eller senior utvecklare, samt erfarenhet av större implementations- eller transformationsprojekt.
* God förståelse för affärsprocesser inom sälj, kundservice, fältservice eller kundupplevelse och hur dessa mappar mot Dynamics 365 CRM och Power Platform.
* Goda tekniska kunskaper inom Dataverse, lösningsstruktur och miljöstrategi, säkerhet och behörighetsmodeller, integrationer och API:er (t.ex. Azure Integration Services/Logic Apps), samt ALM och DevOps-flöden för Power Platform/Dynamics 365 CRM.
* God kommunikationsförmåga för att visualisera och förklara arkitektur för både tekniska och icke-tekniska intressenter, samt goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska.


*Det är meriterande om du:*
* Har avancerade Microsoft-certifieringar (t.ex. Power Platform Solution Architect eller Dynamics 365 CRM) samt erfarenhet av globala utrullningar, komplexa organisationer eller reglerade branscher.
* Aktivt arbete med Copilot/genAI-scenarier, presales (demo, PoC, offertunderlag) och bidrag till community eller thought leadership (t.ex. blogg, konferenser, meetup-talks).


*Obs: Har du inte titeln “arkitekt” idag men redan agerar som lead i komplexa Power Platform/D365-lösningar? Sök ändå.*
**Vad vi tror kommer få dig att trivas**
* Trygga villkor & förmåner: Vi erbjuder konkurrenskraftig lön och kollektivavtal, generösa pensioner och försäkringar. Din hälsa är viktig för oss, därför erbjuder vi friskvårdsbidrag och värnar om balansen mellan arbete och privatliv, med flexibla arbetstider och möjlighet till hybridarbete mm.
* Utveckling i fokus: Hos Capgemini satsar vi stort på din kompetens. Du får tillgång till en omfattande utbildningskatalog och plattformar för lärande. Vill du fördjupa dig inom Power Platform/Dynamics, bredda dig mot molnet eller bli expert på AI-drivna lösningar? Hos oss finns utrymme att forma din egen utvecklingsresa. Vi har karriärspår för både specialister och ledare – med erfarna mentorer vid din sida som stöd.
* Innovationskultur & gemenskap: Vår kultur är öppen och inkluderande – hos oss är olika bakgrunder en styrka. Vi jobbar mycket i team och delar kunskap (t.ex. genom interna tech-forum och innovationstävlingar). Du blir del av ett hjälpsamt konsultgäng där man lyfter varandra. Våra chefer månar om att du trivs och utvecklas, och vi gillar att ha kul på jobbet – allt från kunskapsdelning över en fika till gemensamma teamaktiviteter.


**Ansökan**
 Redo att ta nästa steg i karriären? Vi ser fram emot att höra från dig! Under processen får du besöka vårt kontor, träffa rekryterande chef och ställa dina frågor. Vi gör din resa mot jobbet så smidig och givande som möjligt!
   

  

 Varmt välkommen med din ansökan – vi ser fram emot att träffa vår nästa seniora Power Platform/Dynamics 365 CRM-arkitekt!
   

  

*Som en del av vår rekryteringsprocess kommer identitetskontroll att genomföras genom granskning av ditt ID-kort, och bakgrundskontroller kan utföras vid behov.*
**Om Capgemini**
 Capgemini är en AI-driven global partner för affärs- och tekniktransformation som levererar konkret verksamhetsnytta. Vi formar framtiden för organisationer och förverkligar den med hjälp av AI, teknik och människor. Med vår starka historia på nästan 60 år är vi en ansvarsfull och mångsidig koncern med 420 000 medarbetare i över 50 länder. Genom vår expertis inom strategi, teknik, design, ingenjörstjänster och affärsverksamhet levererar vi heltäckande tjänster och lösningar, baserade på vår djupa branschkunskap och vårt omfattande partnernätverk. Koncernen rapporterade globala intäkter på 22,1 miljarder euro för 2024.

title: Head of Core Enterprise Platforms & Applications
description:
Step into a key leadership role at the heart of Saab’s digital transformation. As Head of Core Enterprise Platforms & Applications within Group IT, you will lead group-wide enterprise platforms, business applications, data, and AI capabilities, ensuring that Saab’s technology landscape is being transformed while enabling efficient, secure, and scalable business processes across the organisation. You will play a key role in enabling Saab's digital transformation by supporting the adoption of AI, cloud-based technologies, automation, and modern digital platforms.
   

  

 Your role
   

  

 As Head of Core Enterprise Platforms & Applications within Saab Group IT, you will be responsible for the delivery and development of key capabilities, including data and AI strategy, data and AI governance, data management, data insights and analytics, digital platforms, and core business applications.
   

  

 You will drive Saab’s IT transformation agenda forward by ensuring adoption of AI, cloud-native technologies, automation, and modern digital platforms. This requires close alignment between business needs, technology enablement, and operational delivery across Business Areas and Group Functions.
   

  

 The role includes line management of senior leaders and close collaboration across the organisation to ensure cohesion between strategic direction and operational execution.
   

  

**In this role, you will:**
* Lead and transform Saab’s Core Enterprise Platform & Application capabilities, with focus on cloud, AI and modernisation
* Enable efficient, secure, and scalable business processes through modern digital platforms and core business applications
* Drive the modernisation of core enterprise platforms while ensuring stable and reliable service delivery
* Define and drive the roadmap for Core Enterprise Platforms & Applications, including data and AI governance, platform modernisation, and data-driven operations
* Enable secure, accessible, and trusted data through strong governance and data security by design
* Drive standardisation, interoperability, and integration across enterprise platforms, applications and data domains
* Support the decentralisation of business-specific solutions while ensuring common platforms and capabilities are leveraged effectively across the enterprise
* Represent Group IT in cross-functional forums and engage with senior business and technology stakeholders


 This is a highly visible position that involves frequent interaction with executive stakeholders, and you will report directly to the Saab Group CIO. You will play a central role in modernising Saab’s enterprise platforms, enabling data-driven decision-making, and establishing the foundations for future AI-enabled capabilities across the enterprise.
   

  

 Your profile
   

  

 We are looking for a senior leader with extensive experience managing complex IT organisations in a global context, combined with deep expertise in enterprise platforms, business applications, data, and AI.
   

  

 You have a strong track record of driving transformation and operational improvements, with focus on cloud, AI and modern IT infrastructure. Combined with a deep understanding of enterprise applications, data management, analytics, governance, and modern technology landscapes including cloud and AI.
   

  

 You are a relationship-oriented leader who is comfortable representing IT at senior management level, lead through others and drive change in large organisations.
   

  

**Key qualifications and experience:**
* Academic degree in a relevant field, or equivalent experience
* Minimum 10 years of IT management experience, including several years of leadership of leaders
* Extensive experience in enterprise applications, digital platforms, data management, analytics, governance, and AI-related capabilities
* Proven experience driving transformation with focus on cloud, AI and modern IT infrastructure and large-scale technology initiatives
* Experience modernising enterprise platforms and enabling data-driven operating models
* Strong understanding of data governance, data security, interoperability, and enterprise architecture principles
* Experience from large global organisations; ideally including defence
* Excellent communication skills and ability to manage complex stakeholder landscapes
* Fluency in both Swedish and English, both written and spoken


*This position requires that you pass a security vetting based on the current regulations around security protection. For positions requiring security clearance, additional obligations regarding citizenship may apply.*
 What you will be part of
   

  

 Explore a wealth of possibilities. Take on challenges, create smart inventions, and grow beyond. This is a place for curious minds, brave pioneers, and everyone in between. Together, we achieve the extraordinary, each bringing our unique perspectives. Your part matters.
   

  

 Saab is a leading defence and security company with an enduring mission: to help nations keep their people and society safe. Empowered by its talented employees, Saab constantly pushes the boundaries of technology to create a safer and more sustainable world.
   

  

 Saab designs, manufactures, and maintains advanced systems in aeronautics, weapons, command and control, sensors, and underwater systems. Saab is headquartered in Sweden, with major operations around the world, and is part of the domestic defence capability of several nations.

title: Technical Account Manager - Stockholm
description:
**About Us**
 Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar.
   

  

 Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes.
   

  

 1,000+ customers across 50+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White & Case, Dentons, and Barclays. We’ve scaled to
 **$100M+ in ARR** 
 , with teams across Europe, North America and APAC, and continue to expand through acquisitions including Qura, Walter AI and Graceview.
   

  

 We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law.
   

  

 Joining Legora means three things.
   

  

* We lean in: ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions.
* We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback.
* We grow together: as a team and with our customers.


 Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts.
   

  

 If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place.
   

  

 This is the most senior seat on the advisory ladder and the person our largest clients trust when it matters most. In legal AI, that trust is hard-won: matters run to fixed dates, data is privileged, and clients hold Legora to the same standard of care they apply to their own work. Part technical advisor, part incident lead, part operating model owner, you hold the technical health of Legora's most complex client relationships and define the playbook the whole function runs on.
   

  

 What you’ll do
   

  

* Own the relationship: Hold the technical health and escalation outcomes for our Strategic Accounts, serving as their primary point of escalation and continuity, and read usage and adoption signals to get ahead of risk.
* Lead in a crisis: Act as incident lead on Sev1 and Sev2 events, owning coordination, customer communication, and the path to resolution. Drive post-incident reviews as trust-building artifacts and product feedback loops, not just process checkboxes.
* Set the standard: Define and own the escalation criteria, account-health model, and cross-team interfaces the function runs on. Build mechanisms that make the team consistent and not dependent on individual heroics.
* Own the Technical Blueprint: Maintain the single source of truth for each account, including data setup, integrations, security and legal considerations, and workflow context. Carry technical context from implementation into the live relationship so nothing is lost in the handoff and the whole account team can rely on it.
* Drive adoption and enablement: Run technical reviews and enablement sessions that deepen product usage, unlock new value, and keep customers current on the platform.
* Partner proactively: Work with Engagement Managers (CSM function) on Quarterly Business Reviews that tie technical health to business outcomes.
* Coordinate escalations: Align the Platform Consultants and the Technical Platform Expert around a single resolution path, holding customer-facing ownership while technical root cause is driven in parallel.
* Stay close to the signal: Own the highest-stakes cases in the L2 queue for your assigned Strategic Accounts, and serve as the escalation point for Platform Consultants before an issue reaches the Technical Platform Expert, so you stay close to the ground truth of each account's technical health.


 What you bring
   

  

* You have owned strategic, high-value B2B accounts and kept clients confident when things went wrong.
* You have led incident response or major escalations under pressure, start to finish.
* You communicate with executives as clearly as with engineers: confirmed facts, explicit trade-offs, named owners, and no speculation presented as certainty.
* You build frameworks, not workarounds, and you raise the bar for everyone around you.
* A background in legal AI, legal tech, or a regulated professional-services domain is a strong plus.


 What’s in it for you
   

  

* Global collaboration: Partner with teams and clients across regions, on work that crosses every major legal market.
* Meaningful work: Your work shapes how the world’s leading legal teams adopt AI day to day.
* Competitive package: Comprehensive salary, benefits, and the tools to do your best work.
* In-person environment: A workspace built for ambitious builders.


**Legora is an Equal Opportunity Employer**
 At Legora, we believe great teams are built on diversity of thought and experience. We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer and committed to creating an inclusive, high-performance culture where everyone can do their best work. We welcome people of all backgrounds and don’t discriminate based on race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

title: Management Consultant, Data & AI (Manager/Senior Manager) - Stockholm or Gothenburg
description:
Vi på Capgemini Invent tror på att olikheter driver förändring. Som transformationskonsulter förenar vi strategiska, kreativa och vetenskapliga kompetenser och samarbetar nära våra kunder för att leverera lösningar i framkant. Bli en del av oss och driv transformation anpassad efter våra kunders utmaningar. Med vetenskap och data som grund, kreativitet och design som drivkraft – och teknik skapad med syfte som möjliggörare.
 



  





**Om rollen** 




  





 Som en del av vårt Data & AI-team hjälper du våra kunder att bli mer datadrivna och att skapa affärsvärde genom data, analys och AI. Du stöttar organisationer i att utveckla de strategier, styrningsmodeller, arbetssätt och tekniska förmågor som krävs för att lyckas med sin data- och AI-transformation – från strategi och utforskande till implementering och skalning. Vi söker flera senioritetsnivåer, från
 **Manager** 
 till
 **Senior Manager** 
 . Vilken nivå som erbjuds kommer att baseras på kandidatens erfarenhet, kompetens och tidigare meriter.
 



  





 Hos oss kommer du att spela en nyckelroll i att:
 



  




* Hjälpa våra kunder att förstå vilken påverkan data och AI har på strategisk, taktisk och operativ nivå samt omsätta insikter till konkreta affärsresultat.
* Utforma och utveckla data- och AI-strategier, styrningsmodeller (Governance) och initiativ för att stärka datadriven kultur och beslutsfattande.
* Stödja kunder i att använda och styra sina datatillgångar för att uppnå strategiska mål och skapa ökat affärsvärde.
* Leda eller bidra till utvecklingen av moderna dataplattformar och analysförmågor som möjliggör tillgång till tillförlitlig data av hög kvalitet.
* Rådgiva kunder kring AI-adoption, AI-drivna innovationer och utveckling av användningsfall som skapar mätbara effekter.
* Arbeta med innovativa frågeställningar i gränslandet mellan verksamhet, strategi, data och AI.
* Leda eller bidra till transformationsprogram inom data, analys, AI, process mining och intelligent automation.
* Bygga starka relationer med kunder och intressenter samt, beroende på senioritetsnivå, bidra till affärsutveckling, försäljningsinitiativ och anbudsarbete.
* Coacha och utveckla teammedlemmar samt säkerställa hög kvalitet i leveranser och projekt.



  





**Din profil** 




  





 Vi tror att du har erfarenhet av, eller ett starkt intresse för, ett eller flera områden inom data och AI, kombinerat med erfarenhet av data- och analysdriven transformation. Du har exempelvis arbetat med data- och AI-strategi, governance eller moderna dataplattformar och dataarkitekturer, såsom Snowflake eller Databricks. Du är van att omsätta data till verksamhetsnytta genom analytics, datavisualisering och beslutsstöd, och har gärna erfarenhet av process mining eller intelligent automation.
 



  





 Vi ser också gärna att du har kunskap inom AI-adoption, utveckling och skalning av AI-use cases samt AI-arkitektur och större AI-transformationer på företagsnivå. Erfarenhet av data- och AI-regelefterlevnad är meriterande, liksom ett intresse för nya teknologier och arbetssätt inom området, exempelvis agentbaserad AI (Agentic AI). Som person drivs du av att skapa värde genom data och AI och trivs i en miljö där innovation kombineras med affärsfokus.
 



  





**Vi ser även att du har:** 




  




* Erfarenhet från management consulting eller liknande rådgivande roller.
* Stark kommunikativ förmåga och erfarenhet av att samarbeta med och hantera intressenter på olika nivåer i en organisation.
* Förmåga att omsätta affärsbehov till konkreta data- och analyslösningar och fungera som bryggan mellan verksamhet och teknik.
* Erfarenhet av att leda initiativ, projekt eller team.
* Erfarenhet av affärsutveckling, kundbearbetning och anbudsarbete.
* Masterexamen med inriktning mot ekonomi, teknik, IT eller Data & Analytics.
* Mycket goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska samt giltigt arbetstillstånd i Sverige.



  





**Det här får du hos oss** 




  




* **Meningsfull påverkan** 
 Hjälp organisationer att frigöra värdet i sina data och AI-satsningar för att stärka konkurrenskraft, effektivitet och långsiktigt affärsvärde.
* **Innovation i framkant**

* **Karriärutveckling** 
 Utveckla din kompetens genom utbildningar, certifieringar, mentorskap och spännande uppdrag hos ledande organisationer.
* **Samarbete och kunskapsdelning** 
 Bli en del av ett inkluderande team där nyfikenhet, samarbete och entreprenörsanda står i fokus.



  





**Bra att veta**
