title: Thesis Work – Investigating the environmental impact of AI & Future Technologies at ABB Robotics
description:
At ABB, we help industries outrun - leaner and cleaner. Here, progress is an expectation - for you, your team, and the world. As a global market leader, we’ll give you what you need to make it happen. It won’t always be easy, growing takes grit. But at ABB, you’ll never run alone. Run what runs the world.


This role sits within ABB's Robotics business, a leading global robotics company. We're entering an exciting new chapter as we’ve announced the plan for SoftBank Group to acquire ABB Robotics. SoftBank is a globally recognized technology group and investor/operator focused on AI, robotics, and next-generation computing. By joining us now, you’ll be part of a pioneering team shaping the future of robotics—working alongside world-class experts in a fast-moving, innovation-driven environment.


This Position reports to:


R&D Global Unit Lead  

Are you interested in sustainability? Are you interested in analyzing the environmental impact of AI and software? Then come do a thesis with us at ABB Robotics!


ABB Robotics is a leading supplier of industrial robots and robot software, in addition to its equipment, and complete application solutions. We are found in 53 countries and have installed more than 500,000 robots, supported by the broadest service network, and offering in the industry.


Analyzing the environmental impact of a physical product is not new to ABB Robotics - we have Life Cycle Assessments for many of our physical robots for over 5 years. But as we peer into the future, it’s important to investigate how the environmental impact of ABB Robotics will evolve under the future technology of large, general-purpose AI models. Foundation models could improve the sustainability of robotics by allowing knowledge learned from large and diverse datasets to be reused across many robots and applications, reducing the need to develop and train separate models for every task. However, training and deploying these models can require substantial computational resources and energy.

**Your Role and Responsibilities**
----------------------------------


The candidate will develop a methodology to quantify the environmental impact (energy, water, etc) of the future technologies throughout the whole life cycle (training, architecture hardware, data cost, inference/sensing) and identify hotspots, potential rebound effects, and evaluate different future scenarios. For example, when does AI and future technologies become a more sustainable? And which types of deployment architectures are better? We are offering this exciting master thesis opportunity within R&D sustainability team.


We are a company with many future technology experts, and are looking for a curious sustainability specialist interested in assessing and discussing with us!

***Details:***

* *January-June 2027*
* *30 ECTS/högskolepoäng(hp)*
* *One student*
* *Distance/On site in Västerås*

**Your responsibilites**
------------------------

* Literature study on the environmental impacts of AI and future technologies
* Deep dive into ABB Robotics' current set up
* Quantify the influence of AI and future technologies with a Life Cycle Assessment (LCA) using SimaPro Software
* Identifying the environmental hotspots
* Depending on interest and initial results, evaluate the different technical scenarios (deployment architecture, infrastructure, materials, inferences) and environmental scenarios (renewable energy, etc.)
* Document and provide recommendations for implementation
* Live ABB’s core values of safety and integrity, which means taking responsibility for your own actions while caring for your colleagues and the business.

**Your background**
-------------------

* Engineering student in sustainability, environmental, or energy
* Knowledgeable about carbon footprints/LCAs and SimaPro
* Experience with Excel (PowerBi and VBA interesting, but not necessary)
* Curious, self-driven, structured and analytical mindset.
* Fluent English in speaking and writing, English is the corporate language and used for all documentation
* Ability to work independently while collaborating with the team

**More about us**

Bring your very own sense of pride and purpose as you help us drive forward the Fourth Industrial Revolution – creating a sustainable future for our planet, and your career. Join ABB and harness the power of our diverse global network, as you collaborate with and learn from our world-class teams. Above all, challenge yourself every day. Let’s write the future, together.

At ABB, you can be sure you are helping to create a better world. Why not take the chance to do this while working in one of the most fascinating technology areas in modern industry – Robotics!

  

ABB Robotics is a leading supplier of industrial robots and robot software, in addition to its equipment, and complete application solutions. We are found in 53 countries and have installed more than 500,000 robots, supported by the broadest service network, and offering in the industry.

  

Now we are offering an exciting master thesis within Mechanical Analysis R&D. You can be a part of our team responsible for simulation, optimization and calculations on the robots.

  

The loads used for dimensioning of the robots are retrieved with simulations where not just a certain load level, but also the probability for that load is retrieved. At the same time the criteria for the material limits are based on statistical evaluation of material tests. However, these are often evaluated conservatively in isolation, resulting in over-dimensioned designs that add unnecessary weight, cost, and environmental impact.

  

We need a fresh perspective on how to integrate probability and statistics into our dimensioning process – decreasing conservatism while maintaining safety and quantifying failure probability for informed engineering decisions.

* Deep dive into ABB Robotics' current in-house dimensioning criteria and load calculation methods
* Development and testing of improved methodologies to predict failure probability
* Documentation and recommendations for implementation

title: AI Engineer
description:
**About Us**
 Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar.
   

  

 Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes.
   

  

 1,000+ customers across 50+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White & Case, Dentons, and Barclays. We’ve scaled to
 **$100M+ in ARR** 
 , with teams across Europe, North America and APAC, and continue to expand through acquisitions including Qura, Walter AI and Graceview.
   

  

 We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law.
   

  

 Joining Legora means three things.
   

  

* We lean in: ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions.
* We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback.
* We grow together: as a team and with our customers.


 Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts.
   

  

 If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place.
   

  

 The team
   

  

 AI Enablement makes Legora AI-native by default. We work across three streams in parallel: building internal agents and tools, equipping teams to build their own, and owning the standards, access and guardrails that let everyone move fast safely.
   

  

 We own the AI platforms and the internal products built on them. So far that includes Leya, an internal knowledge agent live in Slack that answers questions about Legora with cited sources and automates parts of our RFP and security questionnaire work. A structured, agent-readable knowledge base assembled from knowledge each domain continues to own, where agents propose changes and humans approve them. Leyf, a platform for internally built apps that lands anyone's app on shared infrastructure with guardrails scaled to how much damage it could do. And a Skills Hub, so that something one person works out becomes something the whole company can use rather than staying on their laptop.
   

  

 The team is small and the mandate is large. That is the job.
   

  

 What makes this hard
   

  

 Legora is an AI company of around a thousand people, most already fluent and on current tools. Internal AI here is not an adoption problem. Nobody needs convincing, which means there is nowhere to hide behind change management or training. If something we build is not used, it is because it was not good enough.
   

  

 Our colleagues know what good looks like and will not use something worse than what they think they could build themselves in an afternoon. So we ship things people genuinely want, and the foundations arrive with them. That constraint does not go away.
   

  

 The mandate is also larger than the team. The part no individual can do for themselves is the infrastructure, the access model and the architecture underneath, and getting that right across a company this size is the actual work. It does not come with a specification.
   

  

 What you will do
   

  

 You will take broad ownership of how AI works inside Legora and of the platforms we build to make it work.
   

  

* Build internal agents, tools and platforms, and treat them as products rather than projects. Quality, reliability and whether they actually serve the business are yours, not someone else's
* Take a broad goal, work out what is actually required, and break it into the work yourself
* Own what you build end to end, from the architecture through to whether people use it and it holds up in production
* Shape what we should build and in what order, and argue for it
* Design the foundations: knowledge architecture, access and permissions, evaluation and monitoring, the guardrails that scale with risk
* Work directly with the people who will use what you build, across the whole company, including the parts furthest from engineering


 Who we are looking for
   

  

* Strong engineering fundamentals. You build production systems, not prototypes that need someone else to finish them
* Real depth with LLM-based systems. Agents, retrieval, evaluation, tool use. You know where these systems break and you design for it
* Ownership by instinct. You do not wait for a specification. When the requirement is unclear or wrong, you say so and propose something better
* Three kinds of understanding at once. Technical, domain and business. You can hold a conversation about architecture and a conversation about what the business actually needs, and connect them
* Openness. You take feedback, build on other people's ideas, change your mind when the evidence moves, and push for the strongest outcome rather than the one you proposed first
* Comfort with ambiguity. New team, fast growth, decisions that get revisited as we learn. That should sound appealing rather than annoying
* TypeScript. It's what we work in, and where our shared patterns live
* No aversion to infrastructure. We own ours, so Terraform and cloud providers are part of the work rather than someone else's problem
* You work with code agents daily. Not as an experiment, as how you build


**Legora is an Equal Opportunity Employer**
 At Legora, we believe great teams are built on diversity of thought and experience. We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer and committed to creating an inclusive, high-performance culture where everyone can do their best work. We welcome people of all backgrounds and don’t discriminate based on race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

title: Programador de PLC
description:
For the current job opening, we are looking for a PLC Programming Engineer for the SICE Nordics division. You will be based in the headquarters in Stockholm.
 



  





 You will be working on a telecommunication project involving the installation of control, safety, and information technological systems in a tunnel environment. We are searching for dynamic people, ready to learn and contribute as part of an international and multidisciplinary team.
 



  





 If you have at least 2 years of experience in the programming of PLCs (Programmable Logical Controller) and HMIs (Human-Machine Interface) in real environments, including the design and development of programming structures and integration of I/O signals within the overall PLC’s logic, you are our candidate.
 



  





 You will participate in an ongoing, quick-development infrastructure project of relevance to the general public, having direct contact with real systems that shall be put into real operation at the project’s end. You will have the chance to contribute through the life cycle of the control system's deployment, from the preliminary conception of the PLC's programming structure, HMI graphical design, and logic development up to and including the final testing and commissioning.
 



 You will become part of the programming team, working under the supervision of the programming leader and having close coordination with the client’s technical department as part of a collaborative approach for a coordinated deployment.
 



  





 We offer growth and learning opportunities, including official internationally recognized training certifications.
 



  





  





**Job Description** 




**The essential duties and responsibilities for this job:** 




 1. Assistance to the programming leader, under the overall coordination of the Control department leader.
 



 2. Create, read, understand, and review project documents ranging from top-level design documents to detailed system design.
 



 3. Daily work on both Swedish and English and translation from/to both languages.
 



 4. Development of PLC programming structures, based on I/O lists and project templates through the Siemens TIA portal.
 



 5. Development of PLC logic.
 



 6. Design and configuration of HMI for PLC operation and maintenance.
 



 7. Routine coordination with the client's technical team, either remotely or at the client’s premises and laboratory.
 



 8. Assistance to weekly coordination meetings.
 



 9. Administration and daily work on client’s platforms for documentation, notifications, etc.
 



 10. Represent the company, project, and/or department during project management meetings.
 



 11. Interfacing with the project team at headquarters (Madrid).
 



 12. This position requires occasional jobsite visits to active construction zones in order to troubleshoot and test PLCs and HMI systems.
 



  





**The requirements for this job position are** 




 1.
 
 Swedish native and proficient in English with excellent verbal & written communication skills
 
 .
 



 2. Engineering university degree (or students at their 3rd year of bachelor).
 



 3. Proactivity and willingness to take further responsibilities.
 



 4. Willingness to take occasional technical training.
 



 5.
 
 Practical knowledge of TIA Portal.
 





 6. Knowledge of PLC programming languages, including “Ladder Logic / KOP” and “SCL (Structured Control Language) ”
 
 .
 



 7. Team player: open-minded, collaborative, and ready to help/support when needed.
 



 8. Extensive use of the MS Office package.
 



 9. Good time management.
 



 10.
 
 Must demonstrate eligibility to work in Sweden
 
 .
 



 11. Ability to write routine reports and correspondence.
 



 12. Capacity to read variable and I/O signal lists (Drifkort), translating them from diagrammatic and tabulated format to actual programming structures.
 



 13. Hands-on experience in the programming of PLCs and control-related systems.
 



  





**Additional valuable skills:** 




 1. Previous experience with Siemens’ PLC programming environment and TIA portal.
 



 2. Experience in electrical cabinets and electrical installations in general (especially related to low voltage and electrical signaling).
 



 3. Knowledge in traffic systems such as tolling systems, intelligent transport systems, tunnels, etc.
 



 4. Previous working experience in Sweden’s national authorities, such as Trafikverket.
 



  





**Job Type: Full-time** 




**Work Location: In person**

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
**Techster Solutions** 
 befinner i dagsläget sig i en spännande tillväxtfas och söker nu fler kollegor, inledningsvis dig med minst
 **3+** 
 års erfarenhet och som kan stärka teamet.
   

  

 Du kan förvänta dig en omväxlande miljö, dagarna kan se väldigt olika ut - men en sak är säkert, här får du använda dina kompetenser och sätter själv gränsen för hur mycket du vill utvecklas. Som ett kunskapsbolag är det viktigt för oss att våra specialister delar med sig av sin kompetens och får kollegorna att växa.
   

  

**Rollbeskrivning** 
 :
   

  

 Vi söker nu en senior Data Engineer.
   

  

 Uppdragsbeskrivning:
   

  

 Kund söker en driven och framåtsträvande senior data engineer till Digitaliseringsenheten. Enheten ingår i avdelningen för verksamhetsstöd och ansvarar för verksamhetsnära digitala lösningar som stöder myndighetens kärnverksamhet.
   

  

 Digitaliseringsenheten arbetar agilt i fyra utvecklingsteam och präglas av innovation, nytänkande och höga ambitioner.
   

  

 Som senior data engineer blir du en nyckelperson i utvecklingen och förvaltningen av vårt datalager och våra BI-lösningar. Du kommer att driva tekniska beslut, optimera dataprocesser och säkerställa robusta, långsiktiga lösningar som skapar värde för verksamheten samt analysera och lösa komplexa problem på djupet.
   

  

 Placering: kunds kontor i Stockholm men med möjlighet till visst distansarbete.
   

  

**Arbetsuppgifter**
* Designa, utveckla och underhålla datalager, ETL-flöden och SSAS-kuber för rapportering och analys.
* Bygga datamodeller i SSAS som möjliggör effektiva och användarvänliga Power BI-lösningar.
* Felsöka, analysera och lösa komplexa problem i datalager och dataprocesser, från rotorsak till färdig lösning.
* Driva tekniska beslut kring arkitektur, datamodellering, datakvalitet och optimering av kuber.
* Samarbeta nära verksamheten för att förstå behov och omvandla dem till datadrivna beslutsstöd.
* Coachning och mentorskap av kollegor i teamet, inklusive standardisering av kod och processer.
* Bidra till en insiktsdriven myndighet genom att identifiera förbättringsmöjligheter och föreslå nya lösningar.


 Krav
   

  

 Skallkrav:
   

  

* Relevant högskoleutbildning inom systemvetenskap, datavetenskap eller annan teknisk utbildning som bedöms relevant.
* Minst 3–5 års erfarenhet som data engineer med fokus på datalager, ETL, BI-lösningar eller motsvarande.
* Mycket goda kunskaper i SSAS (SQL Server Analysis Services) och erfarenhet av att bygga kuber, datamodeller och measures för analys och rapportering.
* Mycket goda kunskaper i SQL och erfarenhet av att skriva och optimera komplexa queries.
* Erfarenhet av Microsoft SQL Server on-prem, inklusive Management Studio och databasadministration på utvecklingsnivå.
* God förståelse för datamodellering och databasdesign (t.ex. 3NF och Kimball).
* Vana vid Git och versionshantering, samt dokumentation av kod och dataprocesser.
* Mycket god förmåga att uttrycka dig i tal och skrift på svenska.
* Utvärdering av de personliga egenskaperna kommer att ske vid en eventuell intervju


 Börkrav:
   

  

* Erfarenhet av att arbeta i agila team och nära kärnverksamheten.
* Erfarenhet av att driva förbättringar inom datakvalitet, datastyrning och best practices.


**Ansökan**
 Tror du att du är
 **Techster Solutions** 
 nästa stjärna? Tveka då inte att skicka in din ansökan redan nu. Urval sker löpande och tillträde sker enligt överenskommelse.
   

  

 Arbetsplats och kultur
   

  

 Vi är ett entreprenördrivet IT företag, med både produktkunskap och försäljning (Techster AB) och konsultativa tjänster (Techster Solutions AB). Det innebär att vi är mycket öppna för nya tekniska lösningar, kunskapsutbyte och ständigt lärande. Att ha roligt och samtidigt behålla den familjära andan utan hierarkier är lika viktigt.
   

  

 Vi vill skapa det konsultbolag som du alltid velat jobba för, men kanske inte hittat ännu. Redan idag har vi en blandning av seniora och yngre medarbetare, såväl som män och kvinnor. Det vill vi fortsätta att bygga på. Så välkommen med din ansökan!

title: SAP Technical Architect
description:
**Job Description**
**Be part of something bigger. Decode the future.**
 At Electrolux Group, as a leading global appliance company, we strive every day to shape living for the better for our consumers, our people and our planet. We share ideas and collaborate so that together, we can develop solutions that deliver enjoyable and sustainable living.
   

  

 Come join us as you are. We believe diverse perspectives make us stronger and more innovative. In our global community of people from 100+ countries, we listen to each other, actively contribute, and grow together.
   

  

 Join us in our exciting quest to build the future home.
   

  

**All about the role:**
 The SAP Technical Architect is a strategic role that will enable business capabilities with SAP technology. The role includes creation of technology roadmaps as well as governance and support of existing deliveries and will be instrumental in modernising Electrolux technical landscape.
   

  

 Working with the landscape in Electrolux means working with a wide range of applications in a global environment. Electrolux landscape includes applications from on premise ERP, SCM, EWM, etc to public cloud solutions like IBP, CCv2, C4C, etc. There is currently a big modernisation of the landscape moving into private cloud/RISE, Integration Suite, BW/4HANA, BTP and eventually S/4HANA.
   

  

 The successful candidate is passionate about driving business value from technical solutions, analysing and designing solutions and collaborating with different level of stakeholders in a global setting. You will be part of a team of global architects with expertise in different business processes and technologies.
   

  

**What you'll do:**
* Create and own the SAP landscape strategy and design technical landscapes, both on premise and cloud.
* Establish and maintain SAP technical architecture principles, standards and guardrails to ensure scalable, secure and supportable solutions across the SAP landscape, for example considering data volume and performance.
* Define and govern non-functional requirements including security, availability, performance, resilience, recoverability and operational supportability.
* Own architecture decisions and review proposed solutions from functional and technical teams to ensure alignment with architecture standards.
* Collaborate with SAP, implementation partners and internal teams to jointly resolve complex issues or design solutions.
* Provide architecture leadership and guidance in high-priority support issues.
* Create and own the roadmap for Application Lifecycle Management to ensure the applications used are efficiently supporting the IT processes.
* Participate in ERP modernisation program, including move to private cloud, conversion to S/4HANA and implementation of Business Data Cloud (BDC).
* Proactively monitor innovation and emerging technologies, including AI-driven capabilities, to identify business value opportunities.
* Mentor and provide guidance to technical and functional teams and promote architecture best practices across the organization.


**Who you are:**
* You possess excellent written and oral communication skills and ability to communicate complex concepts to senior IT management, technical, functional and business teams in English.
* Demonstrate strong business acumen, with a solid understanding of SAP business processes and the ability to influence stakeholders through effective relationship management and communication.
* Able to work independently and as part of distributed, multi-disciplinary, multi-national teams with good collaboration skills
* Able to deal with ambiguity and manage multiple priorities
* A proactive learner with a strong passion for continuously expanding your knowledge and skills across SAP technologies and the broader digital ecosystem.
* Hold a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
* Fluent in English.


**Required qualifications** 
**:**
* 8+ years of SAP technical platform and architecture experience, including significant experience designing and governing enterprise-scale hybrid SAP landscapes.
* Proven experience acting as SAP Technical Architect, Lead SAP Basis Architect, SAP Platform Architect or equivalent architecture leadership role.
* Application Lifecycle Management, including e.g. transports, monitoring, testing and documentation using Solution Manager, CloudALM and/or third party tools.
* S/4HANA conversion, preferably with experience in optimizing downtime.
* Experience with SAP BTP platform architecture, account models, service enablement, for example linked to AI.


**Nice to have** 
 :
   

  

 The following experience is a plus, but not mandatory:
   

  

* SAP Security, including roles and authorisation design.
* Integration technology (PI/PO, CPI, Integration Suite).
* Custom development on stack and side-by-side in BTP or non-SAP platforms.
* SAP licensing and commercial models (on-premise, RISE, BTP and cloud subscriptions).
* FinOps, linking cloud consumption with financial processes, both for public cloud and credit-based solutions such as BTP, BDC, AI and PCE/RISE.
* Experience working with Enterprise Architecture frameworks.


**Where you will be:**
 This is a full-time position based in Electrolux Group's headquarters in Stockholm in the Stadshagen district of Kungsholmen.
   

  

 We offer 20% workplace flexibility, while maintaining the collaboration, connectivity, and team spirit that come from working together at our Global Headquarters.
   

  

 With more than 60 nationalities under one roof, you will be part of a dynamic international environment where English is the common language and diversity is part of everyday life.
   

  

**Benefits highlights:**
* Generous vacation allowance and a range of family-friendly benefits, including extended paternity leave.
* Comprehensive insurance coverage.
* Discounts on our award-winning Electrolux products and services.
* Extensive learning and development opportunities, with flexible career paths.
* Access to in-house sports facilities.


 We look forward to receiving your application!
   

  

 As part of Electrolux, we will continuously invest in you and your development. There are no barriers to where your career could take you.

title: Danish Speech & Audio AI Specialist
description:
**Job Description** 




  





**About the Role** 




  





 As a Danish Speech & Audio AI Specialist in our Global AI Community, you evaluate and validate speech AI systems—ensuring machine-generated voices sound natural, speech recognition captures intent accurately, and voice AI models learn from high-quality datasets. Your work directly impacts millions of users' voice-based AI experiences.
 



 What You'll Do
 



  





**Audio Evaluation & Quality Assessment** 



* Evaluate AI-generated speech (TTS) for naturalness, pronunciation, rhythm, tone, and emotion
* Identify transcription errors, pronunciation issues, and linguistic nuances in speech recognition (ASR) outputs
* Conduct audio quality checks (loudness, noise, clipping, distortion, compliance)
* Analyze audio using waveform and spectrogram tools to identify quality issues
* Provide structured feedback for model improvement



**Audio Editing & Technical Proficiency** 



* Perform professional audio editing (segmentation, trimming, noise reduction, enhancement)
* Apply audio restoration techniques to optimize speech samples
* Prepare and validate speech content for training pipelines



**Speech Linguistics & Dataset Validation** 



* Apply phonetics and linguistics expertise to identify speech variations across accents and languages
* Review voice recordings for clarity, consistency, and technical quality
* Support creation and validation of high-quality speech datasets
* Perform audio annotation and labeling for dataset integrity



**Voice AI Project Support** 



* Support TTS, ASR, voice similarity, voice generation, and conversational AI evaluation projects
* Contribute to quality assurance workflows for voice technology projects
* Document findings to inform model improvement



  





 Qualification path
 



  





**Mandatory Qualifications** 




  





***Education / Professional Background***




 One of the following:
 



 Bachelor's degree in Audio Engineering, Sound Engineering, Music Technology, Linguistics, Phonetics, Speech-Language Pathology, Computational Linguistics, or Computer Science (Speech/AI focus)
 



 OR 2+ years professional experience in: audio production, dialogue editing, voice recording, podcast/audio post-production, speech dataset creation, or AI speech projects
 



**Language Requirements** 




 Native-level Danish (C1/C2+) – Required for pronunciation and linguistic accuracy
 



 Professional English (B1+) – Required for technical instructions and documentation
 



***Technical Competency***




 Hands-on experience with at least one professional audio tool: Adobe Audition, iZotope RX, Pro Tools, Reaper, Audacity, Logic Pro, Cubase, or equivalent DAW
 



 Working knowledge of: audio editing/restoration, noise reduction, spectrogram analysis, waveform interpretation, and audio quality assessment
 



  





**Assessment & Verification Requirements** 




 Completion of subject-specific qualification assessment (practical audio/speech evaluation)
 



 Identity verification (IDV) process – Required as soon as possible after application completion

title: Master Thesis: Quality of Service for AI Token Traffic in 6G Networks
description:
**Join our Team**
**About this opportunity:**
 The rapid growth of AI services is creating new types of network traffic. AI inference generates output as streams of discrete tokens, which differ significantly from traditional video or web traffic in terms of traffic patterns, latency requirements, and sensitivity to packet loss. Understanding and supporting this new traffic class is becoming increasingly important as AI workloads move to the network edge and cloud. 3GPP has recognized this trend and initiated studies on how mobile networks can better support AI-related traffic. Several open questions remain around how to characterize token traffic, what QoS requirements different types of AI services have, and whether existing 5G QoS mechanisms are sufficient or need to be extended.
   

  

**What you will do:**
 The goal of this thesis is to investigate the QoS requirements of AI token traffic in mobile networks and evaluate how well existing and potential new mechanisms can support this traffic class. The following steps are envisioned as part of the thesis work:
   

  

* Literature study: Review the current state of the art in AI traffic characterization, 3GPP QoS mechanisms (5QI, PDU Sets, GBR/non-GBR bearers), and related academic work on supporting emerging traffic types in 5G/6G networks.
* AI traffic characterization: Study the properties of token traffic generated by different AI services (e.g., LLM chat, AI agents, neural codecs). Characterize traffic patterns such as token rates, burst behavior, and latency sensitivity using open-source AI models.
* Simulation and evaluation: Develop or extend simulations to model AI token traffic over a mobile network. Evaluate how existing QoS mechanisms perform for this traffic class and identify potential gaps.


**The skills you bring:**
 This project is aimed at students in electrical engineering, computer science, computer engineering, or similar. The following background is preferred:
   

  

* Understanding of mobile network architecture (4G/5G) and QoS concepts
* Familiarity with machine learning concepts, particularly large language models
* Programming experience in Python; experience with C++ is a plus
* Interest in 3GPP standardization and telecom research


**Extent:** 
 1 student, 30hp
   

  

**Location:** 
 Stockholm, Sweden
   

  

**Preferred Starting Date:** 
 Nov 1, 2026
   

  

**Keywords:** 
 5G/6G, AI Traffic, Quality of Service, Large Language Models, Token Communication, Network Simulation, 3GPP
